query: SELECT t."DATE", ROUND(SUM(t."VALUE"), 3) AS "PCT_NEAR_DEFAULT" FROM "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."FHFA_MORTGAGE_PERFORMANCE_TIMESERIES" AS t JOIN "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."FHFA_MORTGAGE_PERFORMANCE_ATTRIBUTES" AS a ON t."VARIABLE" = a."VARIABLE" WHERE t."GEO_ID" = 'geoId/06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") = 2023 AND a."VARIABLE_GROUP" IN ('Percent 90 or More, Days Past Due Date', 'PFORB - Percent in Forbearance', 'Percent in the Process of Foreclosure, Bankruptcy, or Deed in Lieu') AND a."MARKET" = 'All Mortgages' GROUP BY t."DATE" ORDER BY t."DATE"

SELECT "APP_GROUP_ID", CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("TIME") AS DATE) AS "SESSION_START_DAY", COUNT(DISTINCT "USER_ID") AS "COUNT_DISTINCT_USERS" FROM "BRAZE_USER_EVENT_DEMO_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."USERS_BEHAVIORS_APP_SESSIONSTART_VIEW" WHERE CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("TIME") AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-06-07' GROUP BY "APP_GROUP_ID", "SESSION_START_DAY" ORDER BY "SESSION_START_DAY", "COUNT_DISTINCT_USERS" DESC

/* SF041: ERCOT Daily Market Dynamics Report for October 1, 2022 */ WITH hours AS (SELECT CAST('2022-10-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 HOUR' * SEQ4() AS dt FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(24))), spine AS (SELECT 'ERCOT' AS ISO, dt AS DATETIME, 'CDT' AS TIMEZONE, dt + INTERVAL '5 HOUR' AS DATETIME_UTC, 0 AS ONPEAK, CASE WHEN HOUR(dt) BETWEEN 7 AND 22 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS OFFPEAK, CASE WHEN HOUR(dt) BETWEEN 7 AND 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS WEPEAK, 0 AS WDPEAK, CAST(dt AS DATE) AS MARKETDAY FROM hours), dart AS (SELECT DATETIME, DALMP, RTLMP FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."DART_PRICES_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000697078 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01'), load_fcst AS (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE AS LOAD_FORECAST, PUBLISHDATE AS LOAD_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE FROM (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE, PUBLISHDATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATETIME ORDER BY PUBLISHDATE DESC) AS rn FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND DATATYPEID = 19060 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01') WHERE rn = 1), rt_load AS (SELECT DATETIME, RTLOAD FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."DART_LOADS_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01'), wind_fcst AS (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE AS WIND_GEN_FORECAST, PUBLISHDATE AS WIND_GEN_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE FROM (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE, PUBLISHDATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATETIME ORDER BY PUBLISHDATE DESC) AS rn FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND DATATYPEID = 9285 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01') WHERE rn = 1), wind_actual AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', DATETIME) AS DATETIME, AVG(VALUE) AS WIND_GEN FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_GEN_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND DATATYPEID = 16 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', DATETIME)), solar_fcst AS (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE AS SOLAR_GEN_FORECAST, PUBLISHDATE AS SOLAR_GEN_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE FROM (SELECT DATETIME, VALUE, PUBLISHDATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATETIME ORDER BY PUBLISHDATE DESC) AS rn FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND DATATYPEID = 662 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01') WHERE rn = 1), solar_actual AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', DATETIME) AS DATETIME, AVG(VALUE) AS SOLAR_GEN FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_GEN_SAMPLE" WHERE OBJECTID = 10000712973 AND DATATYPEID = 650 AND CAST(DATETIME AS DATE) = '2022-10-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', DATETIME)) SELECT s.ISO, s.DATETIME, s.TIMEZONE, s.DATETIME_UTC, s.ONPEAK, s.OFFPEAK, s.WEPEAK, s.WDPEAK, s.MARKETDAY, 'HB_NORTH' AS PRICE_NODE_NAME, 10000697078 AS PRICE_NODE_ID, d.DALMP, d.RTLMP, 'ERCOT' AS LOAD_ZONE_NAME, 10000712973 AS LOAD_ZONE_ID, lf.LOAD_FORECAST, lf.LOAD_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE, rl.RTLOAD, wf.WIND_GEN_FORECAST, wf.WIND_GEN_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE, wa.WIND_GEN, sf.SOLAR_GEN_FORECAST, sf.SOLAR_GEN_FORECAST_PUBLISH_DATE, sa.SOLAR_GEN, lf.LOAD_FORECAST - wf.WIND_GEN_FORECAST - sf.SOLAR_GEN_FORECAST AS NET_LOAD_FORECAST, rl.RTLOAD - wa.WIND_GEN - sa.SOLAR_GEN AS NET_LOAD_REAL_TIME FROM spine AS s LEFT JOIN dart AS d ON d.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN load_fcst AS lf ON lf.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN rt_load AS rl ON rl.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN wind_fcst AS wf ON wf.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN wind_actual AS wa ON wa.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN solar_fcst AS sf ON sf.DATETIME = s.DATETIME LEFT JOIN solar_actual AS sa ON sa.DATETIME = s.DATETIME ORDER BY s.DATETIME

'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE)) AS first_visit_date FROM all_sessions AS a INNER JOIN visitors_with_txn AS v ON a."fullVisitorId" = v."fullVisitorId" GROUP BY a."fullVisitorId"), first_txn /* First transaction date in Feb for each visitor */ AS (SELECT a."fullVisitorId", MIN(CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(a."date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE)) AS first_txn_date FROM all_sessions AS a INNER JOIN visitors_with_txn AS v ON a."fullVisitorId" = v."fullVisitorId" WHERE NOT a.transactions IS NULL AND a.transactions > 0 GROUP BY a."fullVisitorId"), first_txn_device /* Get device of the first transaction session (use INNER JOIN first_txn AS ft ON a."fullVisitorId" = ft."fullVisitorId" AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(a."date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) = ft.first_txn_date WHERE NOT a.transactions IS NULL AND a.transactions > 0) first_txn AS ft ON fv."fullVisitorId" = ft."fullVisitorId" JOIN first_txn_device AS ftd ON fv."fullVisitorId" = ftd."fullVisitorId" AND ftd.rn = 1 ORDER BY fv."fullVisitorId"

WITH first_valid_orders AS (SELECT "user_id", "order_id" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "user_id", "order_id", "created_at", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "user_id" ORDER BY "created_at" ASC) AS rn FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" WHERE NOT "status" IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')) AS sub WHERE rn = 1), first_order_items AS (SELECT fvo."user_id", p."category", oi."sale_price" FROM first_valid_orders AS fvo JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON fvo."order_id" = oi."order_id" JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id"), category_customer_counts AS (SELECT "category", COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS num_customers FROM first_order_items GROUP BY "category"), top_category AS (SELECT "category" FROM category_customer_counts ORDER BY num_customers DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT SUM(foi."sale_price") AS REVENUE FROM first_order_items AS foi JOIN top_category AS tc ON foi."category" = tc."category"

WITH mentions AS (SELECT CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT("text", 'stackoverflow\.com/questions/([0-9]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1) AS INT) AS question_id FROM "STACKOVERFLOW_PLUS"."HACKERNEWS"."COMMENTS" WHERE "text" LIKE '%stackoverflow.com/questions/%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP("time")) >= 2014) SELECT t.VALUE AS TAG, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM mentions AS m JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW_PLUS"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q ON m.question_id = q."id", LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(q."tags", '|') AS t GROUP BY t.VALUE ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 10

WITH release_versions AS (/* Get all NPM release versions with their ordinals */ /* Deduplicate across snapshots by taking MAX ordinal per Name+Version */ SELECT "Name", "Version", MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("VersionInfo", 'Ordinal') AS INT)) AS ordinal FROM "DEPS_DEV_V1"."DEPS_DEV_V1"."PACKAGEVERSIONS" WHERE "System" = 'NPM' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("VersionInfo", 'IsRelease') AS BOOLEAN) = TRUE GROUP BY "Name", "Version"), highest_release AS (/* For each package, find the version with the highest ordinal */ SELECT "Name", "Version" FROM (SELECT "Name", "Version", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Name" ORDER BY ordinal DESC) AS rn FROM release_versions) WHERE rn = 1), dep_data AS (/* Get distinct dependencies for the highest release versions */ SELECT DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(d."Dependency", 'Name') AS TEXT) AS dep_name, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(d."Dependency", 'Version') AS TEXT) AS dep_version, d."Name" AS source_package FROM "DEPS_DEV_V1"."DEPS_DEV_V1"."DEPENDENCIES" AS d INNER JOIN highest_release AS hr ON d."System" = 'NPM' AND d."Name" = hr."Name" AND d."Version" = hr."Version") SELECT dep_name AS DEP_NAME, dep_version AS DEP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS FREQ FROM dep_data GROUP BY dep_name, dep_version ORDER BY FREQ DESC LIMIT 1

WITH daily AS (SELECT "date", "new_confirmed", "cumulative_confirmed", LAG("cumulative_confirmed") OVER (ORDER BY "date") AS prev_cumulative FROM "COVID19_OPEN_DATA"."COVID19_OPEN_DATA"."COVID19_OPEN_DATA" WHERE "location_key" = 'US'), growth AS (SELECT "date", CASE WHEN prev_cumulative > 0 THEN CAST("new_confirmed" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / prev_cumulative ELSE NULL END AS growth_rate FROM daily WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date") IN (3, 4)) SELECT "date" FROM growth ORDER BY growth_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH top_drg AS (SELECT "drg_definition" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" GROUP BY "drg_definition" ORDER BY SUM("total_discharges") DESC LIMIT 1), city_stats AS (SELECT i."drg_definition" AS "Diagnosis", i."provider_city" AS "City", i."provider_state" AS "State", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i."total_discharges") DESC) AS "City_Rank", ROUND(CAST(SUM(i."average_total_payments" * i."total_discharges") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(i."total_discharges"), 0) AS "Citywise_Avg_Payments" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" AS i INNER JOIN top_drg AS t ON i."drg_definition" = t."drg_definition" GROUP BY i."drg_definition", i."provider_city", i."provider_state") SELECT "Diagnosis", "City", "State", "City_Rank", "Citywise_Avg_Payments" FROM city_stats WHERE "City_Rank" <= 3 ORDER BY "City_Rank"

WITH bike_routes_2016 AS (SELECT "start_station_name", "end_station_name", ROUND("start_station_latitude", 3) AS start_lat, ROUND("start_station_longitude", 3) AS start_lon, ROUND("end_station_latitude", 3) AS end_lat, ROUND("end_station_longitude", 3) AS end_lon, COUNT(*) AS bike_trip_count, AVG("tripduration") AS avg_bike_duration FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."CITIBIKE_TRIPS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2016 GROUP BY "start_station_name", "end_station_name", ROUND("start_station_latitude", 3), ROUND("start_station_longitude", 3), ROUND("end_station_latitude", 3), ROUND("end_station_longitude", 3) ORDER BY bike_trip_count DESC LIMIT 20), taxi_routes AS (SELECT ROUND("pickup_latitude", 3) AS start_lat, ROUND("pickup_longitude", 3) AS start_lon, ROUND("dropoff_latitude", 3) AS end_lat, ROUND("dropoff_longitude", 3) AS end_lon, AVG(CAST(("dropoff_datetime" - "pickup_datetime") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS avg_taxi_duration FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TLC_YELLOW_TRIPS_2016" GROUP BY ROUND("pickup_latitude", 3), ROUND("pickup_longitude", 3), ROUND("dropoff_latitude", 3), ROUND("dropoff_longitude", 3)), bike_faster AS (SELECT b."start_station_name", b.avg_bike_duration FROM bike_routes_2016 AS b INNER JOIN taxi_routes AS t ON b.start_lat = t.start_lat AND b.start_lon = t.start_lon AND b.end_lat = t.end_lat AND b.end_lon = t.end_lon WHERE b.avg_bike_duration < t.avg_taxi_duration) SELECT "start_station_name" AS OUTPUT FROM bike_faster ORDER BY avg_bike_duration DESC LIMIT 1

WITH agg_by_seconds AS (SELECT "trip_seconds", COUNT(*) AS row_cnt, SUM("fare") AS fare_sum, COUNT("fare") AS fare_cnt FROM "CHICAGO"."CHICAGO_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_TRIPS" WHERE NOT "trip_seconds" IS NULL AND "trip_seconds" >= 0 AND "trip_seconds" <= 3600 GROUP BY "trip_seconds"), with_cumulative AS (SELECT "trip_seconds", row_cnt, fare_sum, fare_cnt, SUM(row_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY "trip_seconds" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_end, SUM(row_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY "trip_seconds" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - row_cnt + 1 AS cum_start FROM agg_by_seconds), total AS (SELECT SUM(row_cnt) AS n, SUM(row_cnt) % 6 AS remainder FROM agg_by_seconds), groups /* NTILE boundary: group g contains rows from boundary(g-1)+1 to boundary(g) */ /* where boundary(g) = FLOOR(n/6)*g + LEAST(g, n%6) */ /* boundary(0) = 0 */ AS (SELECT 1 AS grp UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6), group_boundaries AS (SELECT g.grp, FLOOR(CAST(t.n AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 6.0) * (g.grp - 1) + LEAST(g.grp - 1, t.remainder) + 1 AS grp_start, FLOOR(CAST(t.n AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 6.0) * g.grp + LEAST(g.grp, t.remainder) AS grp_end FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN total AS t), expanded AS (SELECT c."trip_seconds", c.row_cnt, c.fare_sum, c.fare_cnt, c.cum_start, c.cum_end, gb.grp AS quantile_group, GREATEST(c.cum_start, gb.grp_start) AS overlap_start, LEAST(c.cum_end, gb.grp_end) AS overlap_end FROM with_cumulative AS c CROSS JOIN group_boundaries AS gb WHERE c.cum_start <= gb.grp_end AND c.cum_end >= gb.grp_start) SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(CAST("trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS min_minutes, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CAST("trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS max_minutes, SUM(overlap_end - overlap_start + 1) AS total_trips, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fare_cnt > 0 THEN CAST(fare_sum * (overlap_end - overlap_start + 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / row_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(overlap_end - overlap_start + 1) AS average_fare FROM expanded GROUP BY quantile_group ORDER BY quantile_group

LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 2) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_2", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 3) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_3", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 4) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_4", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 5) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_5", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 6) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_6", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 7) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_7", ROUND("PRCP_MA_8D" - LAG("PRCP_MA_8D", 8) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "PRCP_MA_DIFF_8", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 1) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_1", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 2) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_2", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 3) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_3", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 4) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_4", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 5) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_5", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 6) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_6", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 7) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_7", ROUND("WDSP_MA_8D" - LAG("WDSP_MA_8D", 8) OVER (ORDER BY "DATE"), 1) AS "WDSP_MA_DIFF_8" FROM with_ma) SELECT * FROM with_lags WHERE "DATE" >= '2019-01-09' ORDER BY "DATE"

/* Find the latitude of the final coordinates for the hurricane that traveled */ /* the second longest distance in the North Atlantic during 2020 */ WITH hurricane_sids AS (/* Identify storms that reached hurricane status (usa_status = 'HU') in NA basin, 2020 */ SELECT DISTINCT "sid" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" WHERE "basin" = 'NA' AND "season" = '2020' AND "usa_status" = 'HU'), track_with_prev AS (/* Get entire track for each hurricane storm, with previous point coordinates */ SELECT h."sid", h."name", h."latitude", h."longitude", h."iso_time", LAG(h."longitude") OVER (PARTITION BY h."sid" ORDER BY h."iso_time") AS prev_lon, LAG(h."latitude") OVER (PARTITION BY h."sid" ORDER BY h."iso_time") AS prev_lat FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" AS h INNER JOIN hurricane_sids AS hs ON h."sid" = hs."sid"), segment_distances AS (/* Calculate distance between consecutive track points */ SELECT "sid", "name", CASE WHEN NOT prev_lat IS NULL THEN ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude"), ST_POINT(prev_lon, prev_lat)) ELSE 0 END AS segment_dist FROM track_with_prev), total_distances AS (/* Sum distances per storm */ SELECT "sid", "name", SUM(segment_dist) AS total_distance FROM segment_distances GROUP BY "sid", "name"), ranked AS (/* Rank by total distance descending */ SELECT "sid", "name", total_distance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance DESC) AS rn FROM total_distances), second_longest AS (/* Get the storm with the second longest distance */ SELECT "sid" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2), final_point AS (/* Get the final coordinates (last record by iso_time) for that storm */ SELECT h."latitude", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY h."iso_time" DESC) AS rn FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" AS h INNER JOIN second_longest AS sl ON h."sid" = sl."sid") SELECT "latitude" AS "OUTPUT" FROM final_point WHERE rn = 1

SELECT "id", "name", "state", ST_ASTEXT(ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude")) AS LOC, ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(-87.6847, 41.8319), ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude")) AS DIST_METERS, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(-87.6847, 41.8319), ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude"))) AS RANK FROM "GHCN_D"."GHCN_D"."GHCND_STATIONS" WHERE ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(-87.6847, 41.8319), ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude")) <= 50000 ORDER BY DIST_METERS

SELECT t."bike_number" AS BIKE_NUMBER, ROUND(CAST(AVG(ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(s1."longitude", s1."latitude"), ST_POINT(s2."longitude", s2."latitude"))) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS AVG_DIST_M, ROUND(SUM(ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(s1."longitude", s1."latitude"), ST_POINT(s2."longitude", s2."latitude"))), 2) AS TOTAL_DIST_M FROM "SAN_FRANCISCO"."SAN_FRANCISCO"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" AS t JOIN "SAN_FRANCISCO"."SAN_FRANCISCO"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s1 ON t."start_station_id" = s1."station_id" JOIN "SAN_FRANCISCO"."SAN_FRANCISCO"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s2 ON t."end_station_id" = s2."station_id" GROUP BY t."bike_number" ORDER BY TOTAL_DIST_M DESC

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 12.0 AS AVG_MONTHLY_COMMITS FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_COMMITS" AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT l."repo_name" FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."LANGUAGES" AS l, LATERAL UNNEST(input => l."language") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'name') AS TEXT) = 'Python') AS python_repos ON c."repo_name" = python_repos."repo_name" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."author", 'date') AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) / POWER(10, 6))) = 2016

WITH trips AS (SELECT t."pickup_location_id", t."dropoff_location_id", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS pickup_ts, TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."dropoff_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS dropoff_ts, t."trip_distance", t."tip_amount", t."total_amount" FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TLC_YELLOW_TRIPS_2016" AS t WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2016-07-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2016-07-08' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."dropoff_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2016-07-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."dropoff_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2016-07-08' AND t."passenger_count" > 5 AND t."trip_distance" >= 10 AND t."tip_amount" >= 0 AND t."tolls_amount" >= 0 AND t."mta_tax" >= 0 AND t."fare_amount" >= 0 AND t."total_amount" >= 0 AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."dropoff_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) > TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) SELECT COALESCE(pz."zone_name", 'Unknown') AS PICKUP_ZONE, COALESCE(dz."zone_name", 'Unknown') AS DROPOFF_ZONE, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(trips.dropoff_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(trips.pickup_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS DURATION_SECONDS, CAST(trips."trip_distance" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(trips.dropoff_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(trips.pickup_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 3600.0) AS SPEED_MPH, (CAST(trips."tip_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / trips."total_amount") * 100 AS TIP_RATE_PCT FROM trips LEFT JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS pz ON trips."pickup_location_id" = pz."zone_id" LEFT JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS dz ON trips."dropoff_location_id" = dz."zone_id" ORDER BY trips."total_amount" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (SELECT z."borough" AS pickup_borough, t."tip_amount", t."total_amount", CASE WHEN t."total_amount" = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(t."tip_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t."total_amount" * 100 END AS tip_rate FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TLC_YELLOW_TRIPS_2016" AS t JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS z ON t."pickup_location_id" = z."zone_id" WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2016-01-08' AND NOT z."borough" IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island') AND t."dropoff_datetime" > t."pickup_datetime" AND t."passenger_count" > 0 AND t."trip_distance" >= 0 AND t."tip_amount" >= 0 AND t."tolls_amount" >= 0 AND t."mta_tax" >= 0 AND t."fare_amount" >= 0 AND t."total_amount" >= 0), categorized AS (SELECT pickup_borough, CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN '0%' WHEN tip_rate > 0 AND tip_rate <= 5 THEN 'up to 5%' WHEN tip_rate > 5 AND tip_rate <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%' WHEN tip_rate > 10 AND tip_rate <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%' WHEN tip_rate > 15 AND tip_rate <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%' WHEN tip_rate > 20 AND tip_rate <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%' WHEN tip_rate > 25 THEN 'more than 25%' END AS tip_category FROM filtered_trips), borough_counts AS (SELECT pickup_borough, COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM categorized GROUP BY pickup_borough), category_counts AS (SELECT pickup_borough, tip_category, COUNT(*) AS category_trips FROM categorized GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category) SELECT cc.pickup_borough AS PICKUP_BOROUGH, cc.tip_category AS TIP_CATEGORY, ROUND(CAST(cc.category_trips AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / bc.total_trips, 6) AS PROPORTION FROM category_counts AS cc JOIN borough_counts AS bc ON cc.pickup_borough = bc.pickup_borough ORDER BY cc.pickup_borough, cc.tip_category

WITH new_users AS (SELECT "id" AS user_id, TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS signup_ts, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS signup_month FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2021), asked_within_30d /* Users who asked at least one question within 30 days of signing up */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.signup_ts, u.signup_month FROM new_users AS u JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q ON q."owner_user_id" = u.user_id WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= u.signup_ts AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) <= u.signup_ts + INTERVAL '30 DAY'), first_question /* For users who asked within 30 days, find their first question */ AS (SELECT a.user_id, a.signup_ts, a.signup_month, MIN(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS first_q_ts FROM asked_within_30d AS a JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q ON q."owner_user_id" = a.user_id WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= a.signup_ts AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) <= a.signup_ts + INTERVAL '30 DAY' GROUP BY a.user_id, a.signup_ts, a.signup_month), answered_after_q /* Users who answered at least one question after their first question */ /* and within 30 days following their first question */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT fq.user_id, fq.signup_month FROM first_question AS fq JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS ans ON ans."owner_user_id" = fq.user_id WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(ans."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) > fq.first_q_ts AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(ans."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) <= fq.first_q_ts + INTERVAL '30 DAY'), monthly_stats /* Monthly aggregation */ AS (SELECT u.signup_month, COUNT(*) AS new_users, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS asked_within_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.user_id) AS answered_after_question_within_30d FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN asked_within_30d AS a ON u.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN answered_after_q AS aa ON u.user_id = aa.user_id GROUP BY u.signup_month) SELECT CAST(signup_month AS DATE) AS SIGNUP_MONTH, new_users AS NEW_USERS, asked_within_30d AS ASKED_WITHIN_30D, answered_after_question_within_30d AS ANSWERED_AFTER_QUESTION_WITHIN_30D, ROUND(CAST(asked_within_30d * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / new_users, 4) AS PCT_ASKED_WITHIN_30D, ROUND(CAST(answered_after_question_within_30d * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / asked_within_30d, 4) AS PCT_ANSWERED_AFTER_FIRST_Q_WITHIN_30D FROM monthly_stats ORDER BY signup_month

DOUBLE PRECISION) AS PRECIPITATION FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2011" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2014" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2015" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2016" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2017" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2018" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2019" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' UNION ALL SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" || ' 00:00:00.000000 UTC', CAST("temp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST("prcp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2020" WHERE "stn" = '725030' AND "mo" = '06' AND "da" = '12' ORDER BY TIMESTAMP

WITH mutation_cases AS (SELECT DISTINCT "case_barcode", "Variant_Type" FROM "TCGA"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."SOMATIC_MUTATION_HG19_DCC_2017_02" WHERE "Hugo_Symbol" = 'CDKN2A' AND "project_short_name" = 'TCGA-BLCA'), gene_expression AS (SELECT "case_barcode", "HGNC_gene_symbol", "normalized_count" FROM "TCGA"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."RNASEQ_HG19_GDC_2017_02" WHERE "HGNC_gene_symbol" IN ('MDM2', 'TP53', 'CDKN1A', 'CCNE1')) SELECT mc."case_barcode", ge."HGNC_gene_symbol", mc."Variant_Type", LOWER(cl."gender") AS "GENDER", cl."vital_status", cl."days_to_death", ge."normalized_count" FROM mutation_cases AS mc JOIN gene_expression AS ge ON mc."case_barcode" = ge."case_barcode" JOIN "TCGA"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."CLINICAL_GDC_2019_06" AS cl ON mc."case_barcode" = cl."case_barcode" ORDER BY mc."case_barcode", ge."HGNC_gene_symbol"

WITH wa_2023 AS (SELECT g."stn" AS STATION_ID, g."wban" AS WBAN_ID, s."name" AS STATION_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN g."prcp" > 0 AND g."prcp" <> 99.99 THEN 1 END) AS RAINY_DAYS_2023 FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2023" AS g JOIN "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" AS s ON g."stn" = s."usaf" AND g."wban" = s."wban" WHERE s."state" = 'WA' GROUP BY g."stn", g."wban", s."name" HAVING RAINY_DAYS_2023 > 150), wa_2022 AS (SELECT g."stn" AS STATION_ID, g."wban" AS WBAN_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN g."prcp" > 0 AND g."prcp" <> 99.99 THEN 1 END) AS RAINY_DAYS_2022 FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2022" AS g JOIN "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" AS s ON g."stn" = s."usaf" AND g."wban" = s."wban" WHERE s."state" = 'WA' GROUP BY g."stn", g."wban") SELECT t23.STATION_ID, t23.STATION_NAME, t23.RAINY_DAYS_2023, t22.RAINY_DAYS_2022 FROM wa_2023 AS t23 JOIN wa_2022 AS t22 ON t23.STATION_ID = t22.STATION_ID AND t23.WBAN_ID = t22.WBAN_ID WHERE t23.RAINY_DAYS_2023 < t22.RAINY_DAYS_2022 ORDER BY t23.RAINY_DAYS_2023 DESC

WITH annotation_patients AS (SELECT "case_barcode", "category" AS categoryName, "classification" AS classificationName FROM "TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."ANNOTATIONS" WHERE "entity_type" = 'Patient' AND ("category" = 'History of unacceptable prior treatment related to a prior/other malignancy' OR "classification" = 'Redaction')), clinical_patients AS (SELECT "case_barcode" FROM "TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."CLINICAL" WHERE "disease_code" = 'BRCA' AND "age_at_diagnosis" <= 30 AND "gender" = 'FEMALE'), joined_patients AS (SELECT COALESCE(c."case_barcode", a."case_barcode") AS case_barcode, a.categoryName, a.classificationName FROM clinical_patients AS c FULL JOIN annotation_patients AS a ON c."case_barcode" = a."case_barcode"), filtered_patients AS (SELECT case_barcode FROM joined_patients WHERE categoryName IS NULL AND classificationName IS NULL) SELECT fp.case_barcode, g."file_gdc_url" FROM filtered_patients AS fp JOIN "TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."GDC_METADATA"."REL14_CASEDATA" AS cd ON fp.case_barcode = cd."case_barcode" JOIN "TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."GDC_METADATA"."REL14_FILEDATA_CURRENT" AS fd ON cd."case_gdc_id" = fd."case_gdc_id" JOIN "TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."GDC_METADATA"."REL14_GDCFILEID_TO_GCSURL_NEW" AS g ON fd."file_gdc_id" = g."file_gdc_id" ORDER BY fp.case_barcode, g."file_gdc_url"

WITH weather AS (SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2008" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2009" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2010" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2011" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2012" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2013" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2014" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2015" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2016" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9 UNION ALL SELECT "year", "mo", "da", "stn", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2017" WHERE "stn" IN ('725030', '744860') AND "temp" <> 9999.9), daily_temp AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || LPAD("mo", 2, '0') || '-' || LPAD("da", 2, '0'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS weather_date, AVG("temp") AS avg_temp FROM weather GROUP BY weather_date), complaints_raw AS (SELECT "complaint_type", CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS complaint_date FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NEW_YORK"."_311_SERVICE_REQUESTS" WHERE CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) >= '2008-01-01' AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) < '2018-01-01'), daily_complaints AS (SELECT complaint_date, "complaint_type", COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM complaints_raw GROUP BY complaint_date, "complaint_type"), daily_totals AS (SELECT complaint_date, SUM(daily_count) AS total_daily FROM daily_complaints GROUP BY complaint_date), daily_with_pct AS (SELECT dc.complaint_date, dc."complaint_type", dc.daily_count, CAST(dc.daily_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / dt.total_daily AS daily_pct FROM daily_complaints AS dc JOIN daily_totals AS dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date), joined AS (SELECT dwp."complaint_type", dwp.daily_count, dwp.daily_pct, t.avg_temp FROM daily_with_pct AS dwp JOIN daily_temp AS t ON dwp.complaint_date = t.weather_date), correlations AS (SELECT "complaint_type", SUM(daily_count) AS TOTAL_COMPLAINTS, COUNT(*) AS VALID_TEMP_DAYS, ROUND(CORR(daily_count, avg_temp), 4) AS CORR_COMPLAINT_COUNT_TEMP, ROUND(CORR(daily_pct, avg_temp), 4) AS CORR_COMPLAINT_PERCENTAGE_TEMP FROM joined GROUP BY "complaint_type" HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000) SELECT "complaint_type" AS "complaint_type", TOTAL_COMPLAINTS, VALID_TEMP_DAYS, CORR_COMPLAINT_COUNT_TEMP, CORR_COMPLAINT_PERCENTAGE_TEMP FROM correlations WHERE ABS(CORR_COMPLAINT_COUNT_TEMP) > 0.5 OR ABS(CORR_COMPLAINT_PERCENTAGE_TEMP) > 0.5 ORDER BY CORR_COMPLAINT_COUNT_TEMP DESC, TOTAL_COMPLAINTS DESC

WITH wind_data AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS dt, CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS wdsp FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2011" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2012" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2013" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2014" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2015" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2016" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2017" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2018" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2019" WHERE "stn" = '744860' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE), CAST("wdsp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2020" WHERE "stn" = '744860'), complaints_raw AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS dt, "complaint_type" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NEW_YORK"."_311_SERVICE_REQUESTS" WHERE CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'), qualifying_types /* Filter to complaint types with > 3000 total requests */ AS (SELECT "complaint_type" FROM complaints_raw GROUP BY "complaint_type" HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000), daily_totals /* Daily total complaints */ AS (SELECT dt, COUNT(*) AS total_complaints FROM complaints_raw GROUP BY dt), daily_type_counts /* Daily complaint counts per qualifying type */ AS (SELECT c.dt, c."complaint_type", COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM complaints_raw AS c INNER JOIN qualifying_types AS q ON c."complaint_type" = q."complaint_type" GROUP BY c.dt, c."complaint_type"), daily_proportions /* Daily complaint proportions */ AS (SELECT dtc.dt, dtc."complaint_type", CAST(dtc.type_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(dt.total_complaints AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS proportion FROM daily_type_counts AS dtc INNER JOIN daily_totals AS dt ON dtc.dt = dt.dt), correlations /* Join with wind data and compute correlations */ AS (SELECT dp."complaint_type", ROUND(CORR(dp.proportion, w.wdsp), 4) AS CORRELATION FROM daily_proportions AS dp INNER JOIN wind_data AS w ON dp.dt = w.dt GROUP BY dp."complaint_type") /* Get the strongest positive and negative correlations */ SELECT "complaint_type", CORRELATION FROM (SELECT "complaint_type", CORRELATION FROM correlations ORDER BY CORRELATION DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT "complaint_type", CORRELATION FROM (SELECT "complaint_type", CORRELATION FROM correlations ORDER BY CORRELATION ASC LIMIT 1)

WITH bourbon_sales AS (SELECT REPLACE("zip_code", '.0', '') AS zip_code, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date") AS month, SUM("sale_dollars") AS total_sales FROM "IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES_PLUS"."IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES"."SALES" WHERE UPPER("county") = 'DUBUQUE' AND LOWER("category_name") LIKE '%bourbon%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2022 GROUP BY REPLACE("zip_code", '.0', ''), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date")), zip_total_sales AS (SELECT zip_code, SUM(total_sales) AS annual_total FROM bourbon_sales GROUP BY zip_code), zip_ranked AS (SELECT zip_code, annual_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY annual_total DESC) AS rnk FROM zip_total_sales), third_zip AS (SELECT zip_code FROM zip_ranked WHERE rnk = 3), population_21plus AS (SELECT "zipcode" AS zip_code, SUM("population") AS pop_21plus FROM "IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES_PLUS"."CENSUS_BUREAU_USA"."POPULATION_BY_ZIP_2010" WHERE "minimum_age" >= 21 GROUP BY "zipcode") SELECT bs.zip_code AS ZIP_CODE, bs.month AS MONTH, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p.pop_21plus, 2) AS PER_CAPITA_SALES FROM bourbon_sales AS bs JOIN third_zip AS tz ON bs.zip_code = tz.zip_code JOIN population_21plus AS p ON bs.zip_code = p.zip_code ORDER BY bs.month

WITH nearest_station AS (SELECT s."id" AS station_id FROM "NEW_YORK_GHCN"."GHCN_D"."GHCND_STATIONS" AS s JOIN "NEW_YORK_GHCN"."GHCN_D"."GHCND_2016" AS w ON s."id" = w."id" WHERE w."element" = 'PRCP' AND w."qflag" IS NULL AND CAST(ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(s."longitude", s."latitude"), ST_POINT(-74.0060, 40.7128)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000 <= 50 GROUP BY s."id", s."longitude", s."latitude" ORDER BY ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT(s."longitude", s."latitude"), ST_POINT(-74.0060, 40.7128)) LIMIT 1), weather AS (SELECT w."date" AS weather_date, CAST(w."value" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 10.0 AS precip_mm FROM "NEW_YORK_GHCN"."GHCN_D"."GHCND_2016" AS w JOIN nearest_station AS ns ON w."id" = ns.station_id WHERE w."element" = 'PRCP' AND w."qflag" IS NULL), daily_trips AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS trip_date, COUNT(*) AS num_trips FROM "NEW_YORK_GHCN"."NEW_YORK"."CITIBIKE_TRIPS" WHERE CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' GROUP BY trip_date) SELECT CASE WHEN w.precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS RAIN_STATUS, AVG(dt.num_trips) AS AVG_DAILY_TRIPS FROM daily_trips AS dt JOIN weather AS w ON dt.trip_date = w.weather_date GROUP BY RAIN_STATUS ORDER BY RAIN_STATUS

WITH sp_1995 AS (SELECT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_upper, COUNT(*) AS cnt_1995 FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_1995" WHERE "status" <> 'Dead' AND NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' GROUP BY UPPER("spc_latin")), sp_2015 AS (SELECT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_upper, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2015 FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_2015" WHERE "status" = 'Alive' AND NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' GROUP BY UPPER("spc_latin")), ts AS (SELECT UPPER("species_scientific_name") AS species_upper, "fall_color" FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_SPECIES") SELECT ts."fall_color", SUM(COALESCE(sp_2015.cnt_2015, 0) - COALESCE(sp_1995.cnt_1995, 0)) AS change FROM ts LEFT JOIN sp_1995 ON ts.species_upper = sp_1995.species_upper LEFT JOIN sp_2015 ON ts.species_upper = sp_2015.species_upper WHERE NOT sp_1995.species_upper IS NULL OR NOT sp_2015.species_upper IS NULL GROUP BY ts."fall_color" ORDER BY change DESC

WITH census_1995 AS (SELECT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_latin_upper, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT "status" IN ('Dead', 'Stump', 'Shaft', 'Planting Space') THEN 1 END) AS alive_1995, COUNT(CASE WHEN "status" = 'Dead' THEN 1 END) AS dead_1995 FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_1995" WHERE NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' AND NOT "status" IN ('Stump', 'Shaft', 'Planting Space') GROUP BY UPPER("spc_latin")), census_2005 AS (SELECT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_latin_upper, COUNT(CASE WHEN "status" <> 'Dead' THEN 1 END) AS alive_2005, COUNT(CASE WHEN "status" = 'Dead' THEN 1 END) AS dead_2005 FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_2005" WHERE NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' GROUP BY UPPER("spc_latin")), census_2015 AS (SELECT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_latin_upper, COUNT(CASE WHEN "status" = 'Alive' THEN 1 END) AS alive_2015, COUNT(CASE WHEN "status" = 'Dead' THEN 1 END) AS dead_2015 FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_2015" WHERE NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' AND "status" IN ('Alive', 'Dead') GROUP BY UPPER("spc_latin")), common_names AS (SELECT DISTINCT UPPER("spc_latin") AS species_latin_upper, "spc_common" AS common_name FROM "NEW_YORK"."NEW_YORK"."TREE_CENSUS_2015" WHERE NOT "spc_latin" IS NULL AND "spc_latin" <> '' AND "status" IN ('Alive', 'Dead')), all_species AS (SELECT species_latin_upper FROM census_1995 UNION SELECT species_latin_upper FROM census_2005 UNION SELECT species_latin_upper FROM census_2015), combined AS (SELECT a.species_latin_upper, cn.common_name, COALESCE(c1.alive_1995, 0) + COALESCE(c1.dead_1995, 0) AS total_1995, COALESCE(c1.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_1995, COALESCE(c1.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_1995, COALESCE(c2.alive_2005, 0) + COALESCE(c2.dead_2005, 0) AS total_2005, COALESCE(c2.alive_2005, 0) AS alive_2005, COALESCE(c2.dead_2005, 0) AS dead_2005, COALESCE(c3.alive_2015, 0) + COALESCE(c3.dead_2015, 0) AS total_2015, COALESCE(c3.alive_2015, 0) AS alive_2015, COALESCE(c3.dead_2015, 0) AS dead_2015 FROM all_species AS a LEFT JOIN census_1995 AS c1 ON a.species_latin_upper = c1.species_latin_upper LEFT JOIN census_2005 AS c2 ON a.species_latin_upper = c2.species_latin_upper LEFT JOIN census_2015 AS c3 ON a.species_latin_upper = c3.species_latin_upper LEFT JOIN common_names AS cn ON a.species_latin_upper = cn.species_latin_upper) SELECT species_latin_upper, common_name, total_1995, alive_1995, dead_1995, total_2005, alive_2005, dead_2005, total_2015, alive_2015, dead_2015, total_2015 - total_1995 AS growth_total_1995_2015, alive_2015 - alive_1995 AS growth_alive_1995_2015, dead_2015 - dead_1995 AS growth_dead_1995_2015 FROM combined ORDER BY growth_total_1995_2015 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH bls_avg AS (SELECT AVG("percent_white") AS avg_white, AVG("percent_black_or_african_american") AS avg_black, AVG("percent_asian") AS avg_asian, AVG("percent_hispanic_or_latino") AS avg_hispanic FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."BLS"."CPSAAT18" WHERE "year" = 2021 AND ("subsector" IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services') OR "industry_group" = 'Computer systems design and related services')), google_hire AS (SELECT "race_asian", "race_black", "race_hispanic_latinx", "race_white" FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."GOOGLE_DEI"."DAR_NON_INTERSECTIONAL_HIRING" WHERE "workforce" = 'overall' AND "report_year" = 2021), diffs AS (SELECT 'asian' AS race, ABS(g."race_asian" - b.avg_asian) AS diff FROM google_hire AS g, bls_avg AS b UNION ALL SELECT 'black', ABS(g."race_black" - b.avg_black) FROM google_hire AS g, bls_avg AS b UNION ALL SELECT 'hispanic_or_latino', ABS(g."race_hispanic_latinx" - b.avg_hispanic) FROM google_hire AS g, bls_avg AS b UNION ALL SELECT 'white', ABS(g."race_white" - b.avg_white) FROM google_hire AS g, bls_avg AS b) SELECT race, diff FROM diffs ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 3

WITH bridge_ways AS (SELECT DISTINCT w."id" FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_BOUNDARIES"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_WAYS" AS w, LATERAL UNNEST(input => w."all_tags") AS t(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(t.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'bridge'), california_highways AS (SELECT DISTINCT w."id", w."geometry", w."nodes" FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_BOUNDARIES"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_WAYS" AS w, "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_BOUNDARIES"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."STATES" AS s, LATERAL UNNEST(input => w."all_tags") AS t(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE s."state_name" = 'California' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(t.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'highway' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(t.value, 'value') AS TEXT) IN ('motorway', 'trunk', 'primary', 'secondary', 'residential') AND ST_INTERSECTS(CAST(w."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY), CAST(s."state_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY)) AND w."id" <> ALL (SELECT "id" FROM bridge_ways)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS NUM_OVERLAPPING_WAYS FROM california_highways AS w1 JOIN california_highways AS w2 ON w1."id" < w2."id" AND ST_INTERSECTS(CAST(w1."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY), CAST(w2."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY)) AND NOT w1."nodes" && w2."nodes"

SELECT ROUND(MAX(CAST(HAVERSINE("start_station_latitude", "start_station_longitude", "end_station_latitude", "end_station_longitude") * 1000 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / "duration_sec"), 1) AS "MAX_VELOCITY" FROM "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" AS t JOIN "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO" AS s ON t."start_station_id" = CAST(s."station_id" AS INT) WHERE s."region_id" = 14 AND HAVERSINE("start_station_latitude", "start_station_longitude", "end_station_latitude", "end_station_longitude") * 1000 > 1000 AND "duration_sec" > 0

SELECT b."country_name", b."net_migration" FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."BIRTH_DEATH_GROWTH_RATES" AS b JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."COUNTRY_NAMES_AREA" AS c ON b."country_code" = c."country_code" WHERE b."year" = 2017 AND c."country_area" > 500 ORDER BY b."net_migration" DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT SUBSTRING(a."geo_id" FROM 6) AS TRACT_CODE FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2015_5YR" AS a INNER JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2018_5YR" AS b ON a."geo_id" = b."geo_id" WHERE a."geo_id" LIKE '06%' AND NOT a."median_income" IS NULL AND NOT b."median_income" IS NULL ORDER BY (b."median_income" - a."median_income") DESC LIMIT 1

WITH license_counts AS (SELECT "System", CAST(f.value AS TEXT) AS "License", COUNT(DISTINCT "Name") AS package_count FROM "DEPS_DEV_V1"."DEPS_DEV_V1"."PACKAGEVERSIONS", LATERAL UNNEST(input => "Licenses") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) GROUP BY "System", CAST(f.value AS TEXT)), ranked AS (SELECT "System", "License", package_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "System" ORDER BY package_count DESC) AS rn FROM license_counts) SELECT "System", "License" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "System"

WITH nearby_zips AS (/* Step 1: Find zip codes within 5 miles (8046.72 meters) of the target point */ SELECT z."zip_code", CAST(z."zip_code_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY) AS zip_geog FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" AS z WHERE ST_DISTANCE(CAST(z."zip_code_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_POINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)) <= 8046.72), tract_zip_overlap AS (/* Step 2: Calculate proportional overlap between each census tract and nearby zip codes */ SELECT z."zip_code", c."total_pop", c."income_per_capita", CAST(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(CAST(t."tract_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY), z.zip_geog)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ST_AREA(CAST(t."tract_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY)), 0) AS proportion FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."GEO_CENSUS_TRACTS"."CENSUS_TRACTS_WASHINGTON" AS t JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2017_5YR" AS c ON t."geo_id" = c."geo_id" JOIN nearby_zips AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(CAST(t."tract_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY), z.zip_geog) WHERE c."total_pop" > 0) /* Step 3: Aggregate per zip code */ SELECT "zip_code", ROUND(SUM("total_pop" * proportion), 1) AS zip_population, ROUND(CAST(SUM("income_per_capita" * "total_pop" * proportion) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM("total_pop" * proportion), 1) AS average_income FROM tract_zip_overlap GROUP BY "zip_code" ORDER BY average_income DESC

WITH top_requests AS (SELECT "block_timestamp", "oracle_request_id", "decoded_result" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BAND"."ORACLE_REQUESTS" WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("request", 'oracle_script_id') = 3 ORDER BY "block_timestamp" DESC, "oracle_request_id" DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT r."block_timestamp" AS BLOCK_TIMESTAMP, r."oracle_request_id" AS ORACLE_REQUEST_ID, CAST(sym.VALUE AS VARCHAR) AS SYMBOL, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(CAST(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(r."decoded_result", 'result') AS VARCHAR) AS JSON), 'rates')[sym.INDEX] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(CAST(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(r."decoded_result", 'calldata') AS VARCHAR) AS JSON), 'multiplier') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ADJUSTED_RATE FROM top_requests AS r, LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(CAST(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(r."decoded_result", 'calldata') AS VARCHAR) AS JSON), 'symbols')) AS sym(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) ORDER BY r."block_timestamp" DESC, r."oracle_request_id" DESC

WITH person_agg AS (SELECT "consecutive_number", COUNT(DISTINCT "person_number") AS distinct_person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN "injury_severity" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_count FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."PERSON_2016" GROUP BY "consecutive_number" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "person_number") > 1), vehicle_body AS (SELECT "consecutive_number", "body_type" FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."VEHICLE_2016" WHERE "vehicle_number" = 1), speed_agg AS (SELECT "consecutive_number", AVG(ABS("travel_speed" - "speed_limit")) AS avg_abs_speed_diff FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."VEHICLE_2016" WHERE "travel_speed" <= 151 AND NOT "travel_speed" IN (997, 998, 999) AND "speed_limit" <= 80 AND NOT "speed_limit" IN (98, 99) GROUP BY "consecutive_number") SELECT a."state_number", a."consecutive_number", CAST(vb."body_type" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS vehicle_body_type, a."number_of_drunk_drivers", a."day_of_week", a."hour_of_crash", CASE WHEN a."work_zone" = 'None' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS work_zone_indicator, s.avg_abs_speed_diff, CASE WHEN NOT s.avg_abs_speed_diff IS NULL THEN CAST(LEAST(FLOOR(CAST(s.avg_abs_speed_diff AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 20), 4) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE NULL END AS avg_speed_diff_bin, CASE WHEN p.fatal_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label_more_than_one_fatality FROM person_agg AS p JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."ACCIDENT_2016" AS a ON p."consecutive_number" = a."consecutive_number" LEFT JOIN vehicle_body AS vb ON p."consecutive_number" = vb."consecutive_number" LEFT JOIN speed_agg AS s ON p."consecutive_number" = s."consecutive_number" ORDER BY a."consecutive_number"

WITH series_all AS (SELECT "SeriesInstanceUID", "SeriesNumber", "StudyInstanceUID", "PatientID", "SOPInstanceUID", "ImageOrientationPatient", "PixelSpacing", "ImagePositionPatient", "Rows", "Columns", "SliceThickness", "Exposure", "instance_size", CAST(CAST("ImageOrientationPatient" AS JSON)[0] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS iop0, CAST(CAST("ImageOrientationPatient" AS JSON)[1] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS iop1, CAST(CAST("ImageOrientationPatient" AS JSON)[3] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS iop3, CAST(CAST("ImageOrientationPatient" AS JSON)[4] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS iop4, CAST(CAST("ImagePositionPatient" AS JSON)[2] AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS z_position, CAST(CAST("ImagePositionPatient" AS JSON)[0] AS TEXT) || ',' || CAST(CAST("ImagePositionPatient" AS JSON)[1] AS TEXT) AS xy_pos FROM "IDC"."IDC_V17"."DICOM_ALL" WHERE "Modality" = 'CT' AND "collection_id" <> 'nlst' AND NOT "ImageType" LIKE '%LOCALIZER%' AND NOT "TransferSyntaxUID" IN ('1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.70', '1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.51') AND NOT "ImagePositionPatient" IS NULL AND NOT "ImageOrientationPatient" IS NULL AND NOT "PixelSpacing" IS NULL), geometry AS (SELECT "SeriesInstanceUID", MAX("SeriesNumber") AS "SERIES_NUMBER", MAX("StudyInstanceUID") AS "STUDY_INSTANCE_UID", MAX("PatientID") AS "PATIENT_ID", MAX(iop0 * iop4 - iop1 * iop3) AS "MAX_DOT_PRODUCT", COUNT(DISTINCT "SOPInstanceUID") AS "SOP_INSTANCE_COUNT", COUNT(DISTINCT "SliceThickness") AS "DISTINCT_SLICE_THICKNESS_COUNT", COUNT(DISTINCT "Exposure") AS "DISTINCT_EXPOSURE_COUNT", MAX(CAST("Exposure" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "MAX_EXPOSURE", MIN(CAST("Exposure" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "MIN_EXPOSURE", CAST(SUM("instance_size") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (1024 * 1024) AS "SERIES_SIZE_MIB" FROM series_all GROUP BY "SeriesInstanceUID" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "ImageOrientationPatient") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "PixelSpacing") = 1 AND CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "SOPInstanceUID") AS VARCHAR) = CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "ImagePositionPatient") AS VARCHAR) AND COUNT(DISTINCT "Rows") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "Columns") = 1 AND ABS(1.0 - MAX(iop0 * iop4 - iop1 * iop3)) < 0.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT xy_pos) = 1), z_ordered AS (SELECT sa."SeriesInstanceUID", sa.z_position, sa.z_position - LAG(sa.z_position) OVER (PARTITION BY sa."SeriesInstanceUID" ORDER BY sa.z_position) AS z_diff FROM series_all AS sa INNER JOIN geometry AS g ON sa."SeriesInstanceUID" = g."SeriesInstanceUID"), z_stats AS (SELECT "SeriesInstanceUID", MAX(z_diff) AS "MAX_SLICE_INTERVAL_DIFF", MIN(z_diff) AS "MIN_SLICE_INTERVAL_DIFF", MAX(z_diff) - MIN(z_diff) AS "SLICE_INTERVAL_TOLERANCE" FROM z_ordered WHERE NOT z_diff IS NULL GROUP BY "SeriesInstanceUID") SELECT g."SeriesInstanceUID" AS "SERIES_INSTANCE_UID", g."SERIES_NUMBER", g."STUDY_INSTANCE_UID", g."PATIENT_ID", g."MAX_DOT_PRODUCT", g."SOP_INSTANCE_COUNT", g."DISTINCT_SLICE_THICKNESS_COUNT", z."MAX_SLICE_INTERVAL_DIFF", z."MIN_SLICE_INTERVAL_DIFF", z."SLICE_INTERVAL_TOLERANCE", g."DISTINCT_EXPOSURE_COUNT", g."MAX_EXPOSURE", g."MIN_EXPOSURE", g."MAX_EXPOSURE" - g."MIN_EXPOSURE" AS "EXPOSURE_RANGE", g."SERIES_SIZE_MIB" FROM geometry AS g LEFT JOIN z_stats AS z ON g."SeriesInstanceUID" = z."SeriesInstanceUID" ORDER BY z."SLICE_INTERVAL_TOLERANCE" DESC, (g."MAX_EXPOSURE" - g."MIN_EXPOSURE") DESC, g."SeriesInstanceUID" DESC

SELECT z."city" AS "city", z."zip_code" AS "zip_code", z."state_code" AS "STATE", COUNT(DISTINCT h."sid") AS "HURRICANE_COUNT", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT h."name", ', ' ORDER BY h."name") AS "HURRICANE_NAMES" FROM "NOAA_DATA_PLUS"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" AS h, "NOAA_DATA_PLUS"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" AS z WHERE h."name" <> 'NOT_NAMED' AND h."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND h."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(h."longitude", h."latitude"), CAST(z."zip_code_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY)) GROUP BY z."city", z."zip_code", z."state_code" ORDER BY "HURRICANE_COUNT" DESC

SELECT g."state_name", SUM(c."employed_wholesale_trade" * 0.38) AS TOTAL_WHOLESALE_VULNERABLE, SUM(c."employed_manufacturing" * 0.41) AS TOTAL_MANUFACTURING_VULNERABLE, SUM(c."employed_wholesale_trade" * 0.38) + SUM(c."employed_manufacturing" * 0.41) AS TOTAL_VULNERABLE_WORKERS FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."ZIP_CODES_2015_5YR" AS a JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."ZIP_CODES_2018_5YR" AS b ON a."geo_id" = b."geo_id" JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."ZIP_CODES_2017_5YR" AS c ON a."geo_id" = c."geo_id" JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" AS g ON a."geo_id" = g."zip_code" WHERE NOT a."median_income" IS NULL AND NOT b."median_income" IS NULL GROUP BY g."state_name" ORDER BY TOTAL_VULNERABLE_WORKERS DESC

WITH representation AS (SELECT '2021 Google Workforce Representation' AS data_source, "race_asian", "race_black", "race_hispanic_latinx", "race_white", "gender_us_women", "gender_us_men" FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."GOOGLE_DEI"."DAR_NON_INTERSECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION" WHERE "report_year" = 2021 AND "workforce" = 'overall'), hiring AS (SELECT '2021 Google Hiring' AS data_source, "race_asian", "race_black", "race_hispanic_latinx", "race_white", "gender_us_women", "gender_us_men" FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."GOOGLE_DEI"."DAR_NON_INTERSECTIONAL_HIRING" WHERE "report_year" = 2021 AND "workforce" = 'overall'), bls AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "subsector" = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' THEN '2021 BLS Industry - Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' WHEN "industry_group" = 'Computer systems design and related services' THEN '2021 BLS Industry - Computer systems design and related services' END AS data_source, "percent_asian" AS race_asian, "percent_black_or_african_american" AS race_black, "percent_hispanic_or_latino" AS race_hispanic_latinx, "percent_white" AS race_white, "percent_women" AS gender_us_women, 1 - "percent_women" AS gender_us_men FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."BLS"."CPSAAT18" WHERE "year" = 2021 AND ("subsector" = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' OR "industry_group" = 'Computer systems design and related services')) SELECT * FROM representation UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hiring UNION ALL SELECT * FROM bls ORDER BY CASE data_source WHEN '2021 Google Workforce Representation' THEN 1 WHEN '2021 Google Hiring' THEN 2 WHEN '2021 BLS Industry - Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' THEN 3 WHEN '2021 BLS Industry - Computer systems design and related services' THEN 4 END

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS MONTH, COUNT(*) AS MOTOR_VEHICLE_THEFT_COUNT FROM "CHICAGO"."CHICAGO_CRIME"."CRIME" WHERE "year" = 2016 AND "primary_type" = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT' GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MOTOR_VEHICLE_THEFT_COUNT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d."targetId" AS TARGET_ID, d."datasourceId" AS "datasourceId", t."approvedSymbol" AS APPROVED_SYMBOL, o."score" AS OVERALL_SCORE FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_2"."OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM"."ASSOCIATIONBYDATASOURCEDIRECT" AS d JOIN "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_2"."OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM"."ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLDIRECT" AS o ON d."targetId" = o."targetId" AND d."diseaseId" = o."diseaseId" JOIN "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_2"."OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM"."TARGETS" AS t ON d."targetId" = t."id" WHERE d."diseaseId" = 'EFO_0000676' AND d."datasourceId" = 'impc' ORDER BY o."score" DESC LIMIT 1

WITH timberland_latest AS (SELECT "state_code", MAX("evaluation_group") AS latest_eval_group FROM "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."ESTIMATED_TIMBERLAND_ACRES" WHERE "evaluation_type" = 'EXPCURR' GROUP BY "state_code"), timberland_totals AS (SELECT 'Timberland' AS "CATEGORY", t."state_code" AS "STATE_CODE", t."evaluation_group" AS "EVALUATION_GROUP", t."state_name" AS "STATE_NAME", SUM(t."macroplot_acres" + t."subplot_acres") AS "TOTAL_ACRES" FROM "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."ESTIMATED_TIMBERLAND_ACRES" AS t JOIN timberland_latest AS tl ON t."state_code" = tl."state_code" AND t."evaluation_group" = tl.latest_eval_group WHERE t."evaluation_type" = 'EXPCURR' GROUP BY t."state_code", t."evaluation_group", t."state_name" ORDER BY "TOTAL_ACRES" DESC LIMIT 1), forestland_latest AS (SELECT "state_code", MAX("evaluation_group") AS latest_eval_group FROM "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."ESTIMATED_FORESTLAND_ACRES" WHERE "evaluation_type" = 'EXPCURR' GROUP BY "state_code"), forestland_totals AS (SELECT 'Forestland' AS "CATEGORY", f."state_code" AS "STATE_CODE", f."evaluation_group" AS "EVALUATION_GROUP", f."state_name" AS "STATE_NAME", SUM(f."macroplot_acres" + f."subplot_acres") AS "TOTAL_ACRES" FROM "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."ESTIMATED_FORESTLAND_ACRES" AS f JOIN forestland_latest AS fl ON f."state_code" = fl."state_code" AND f."evaluation_group" = fl.latest_eval_group WHERE f."evaluation_type" = 'EXPCURR' GROUP BY f."state_code", f."evaluation_group", f."state_name" ORDER BY "TOTAL_ACRES" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM timberland_totals UNION ALL SELECT * FROM forestland_totals

WITH date_range AS (SELECT CAST('2018-08-30' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * SEQ4() AS "DATE" FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(32))), daily_counts AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS dt, SUM(CASE WHEN "trace_address" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS external_daily, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT "trace_address" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contract_daily FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" WHERE "trace_type" = 'create' AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2018-08-30' AND '2018-09-30' GROUP BY dt) SELECT dr."DATE", SUM(COALESCE(dc.external_daily, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY dr."DATE") AS "EXTERNAL_USER_CUMULATIVE_CONTRACTS", SUM(COALESCE(dc.contract_daily, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY dr."DATE") AS "CONTRACT_CREATOR_CUMULATIVE_CONTRACTS" FROM date_range AS dr LEFT JOIN daily_counts AS dc ON dr."DATE" = dc.dt ORDER BY dr."DATE"

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT_PER_MONTH, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "block_timestamp") IN (1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12) THEN 31 * 24 * 3600 WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "block_timestamp") IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 * 24 * 3600 WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "block_timestamp") = 2 THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp") % 4 = 0 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp") % 100 <> 0 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp") % 400 = 0) THEN 29 * 24 * 3600 ELSE 28 * 24 * 3600 END END AS DECIMAL), 6) AS TXN_PER_SECOND, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp") AS YEAR, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "block_timestamp") AS MONTH FROM "GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN"."GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN_POLYGON_MAINNET_US"."TRANSACTIONS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp") = 2023 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp"), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "block_timestamp") ORDER BY TXN_COUNT_PER_MONTH DESC

SELECT p."country_name" AS COUNTRY, SUM(c."confirmed") AS TOTAL_CONFIRMED_CASES, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c."confirmed") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p."value" * 100000, 2) AS CASES_PER_100K FROM "COVID19_JHU_WORLD_BANK"."COVID19_JHU_CSSE"."SUMMARY" AS c JOIN "COVID19_JHU_WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_WDI"."INDICATORS_DATA" AS p ON (CASE WHEN c."country_region" = 'US' THEN 'United States' WHEN c."country_region" = 'Iran' THEN 'Iran, Islamic Rep.' ELSE c."country_region" END) = p."country_name" WHERE c."country_region" IN ('US', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran') AND c."date" = '2020-04-20' AND p."indicator_code" = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND p."year" = 2020 GROUP BY p."country_name", p."value" ORDER BY CASES_PER_100K DESC

SELECT p."country_code" AS "country_code", p."country" AS "country_name", p."year_2018" AS "population_2018", COALESCE(c."cumulative_confirmed", 0) AS "cumulative_confirmed_2020_06_30", CAST(ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(c."cumulative_confirmed", 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p."year_2018" * 100, 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS "pct_population_confirmed" FROM "COVID19_OPEN_WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_GLOBAL_POPULATION"."POPULATION_BY_COUNTRY" AS p LEFT JOIN "COVID19_OPEN_WORLD_BANK"."COVID19_OPEN_DATA"."COVID19_OPEN_DATA" AS c ON p."country_code" = c."iso_3166_1_alpha_3" AND c."aggregation_level" = 0 AND c."date" = '2020-06-30' WHERE NOT p."year_2018" IS NULL ORDER BY "pct_population_confirmed" DESC

WITH year_avg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("date" AS DATE)) AS yr, AVG(CAST("symptom_anosmia" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_anosmia FROM "COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."SYMPTOM_SEARCH_SUB_REGION_2_WEEKLY" WHERE "sub_region_1" = 'New York' AND "sub_region_2" IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County') AND "date" >= '2019-01-01' AND "date" <= '2020-12-31' GROUP BY yr) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_anosmia END), 5) AS avg_symptom_Anosmia_2019, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_anosmia END), 5) AS avg_symptom_Anosmia_2020, ROUND(CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_anosmia END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_anosmia END)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_anosmia END) * 100, 2) AS avg_increase FROM year_avg

WITH period_2019 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST("symptom_anxiety" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_symptom_Anxiety_2019, AVG(CAST("symptom_depression" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_symptom_Depression_2019 FROM "COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."SYMPTOM_SEARCH_COUNTRY_WEEKLY" WHERE "country_region" = 'United States' AND "date" >= '2019-01-01' AND "date" < '2020-01-01'), period_2020 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST("symptom_anxiety" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_symptom_Anxiety_2020, AVG(CAST("symptom_depression" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_symptom_Depression_2020 FROM "COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."COVID19_SYMPTOM_SEARCH"."SYMPTOM_SEARCH_COUNTRY_WEEKLY" WHERE "country_region" = 'United States' AND "date" >= '2020-01-01' AND "date" < '2021-01-01') SELECT p19.avg_symptom_Anxiety_2019, p20.avg_symptom_Anxiety_2020, CAST((p20.avg_symptom_Anxiety_2020 - p19.avg_symptom_Anxiety_2019) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p19.avg_symptom_Anxiety_2019 * 100 AS percent_increase_anxiety, p19.avg_symptom_Depression_2019, p20.avg_symptom_Depression_2020, CAST((p20.avg_symptom_Depression_2020 - p19.avg_symptom_Depression_2019) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p19.avg_symptom_Depression_2019 * 100 AS percent_increase_depression FROM period_2019 AS p19 CROSS JOIN period_2020 AS p20

WITH long_trades AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p.value, 'PartyID') AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN 'feeling-lucky' WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p.value, 'PartyID') AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN 'momentum' END AS strategy_group, GREATEST(0, t."LastPx" - t."StrikePrice") AS intrinsic_value FROM "CYMBAL_INVESTMENTS"."CYMBAL_INVESTMENTS"."TRADE_CAPTURE_REPORT" AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."Sides") AS s(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(s.value, 'PartyIDs')) AS p(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(s.value, 'Side') AS VARCHAR) = 'LONG' AND (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p.value, 'PartyID') AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'LUCKY%' OR CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p.value, 'PartyID') AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'MOMO%')) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN strategy_group = 'feeling-lucky' THEN intrinsic_value END) - AVG(CASE WHEN strategy_group = 'momentum' THEN intrinsic_value END) AS DIFF FROM long_trades

WITH inputs AS (SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(i."addresses", ',') AS address, i."type" AS type, -i."value" AS amount FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."INPUTS" AS i INNER JOIN "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."TRANSACTIONS" AS t ON i."transaction_hash" = t."hash" WHERE t."block_timestamp_month" = '2023-04-01'), outputs AS (SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(o."addresses", ',') AS address, o."type" AS type, o."value" AS amount FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."OUTPUTS" AS o INNER JOIN "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."TRANSACTIONS" AS t ON o."transaction_hash" = t."hash" WHERE t."block_timestamp_month" = '2023-04-01'), combined AS (SELECT address, type, amount FROM inputs UNION ALL SELECT address, type, amount FROM outputs), balances AS (SELECT address, type, SUM(amount) AS balance FROM combined GROUP BY address, type) SELECT 'HIGHEST' AS extreme, address, type, balance FROM balances WHERE balance = (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM balances) UNION ALL SELECT 'LOWEST' AS extreme, address, type, balance FROM balances WHERE balance = (SELECT MIN(balance) FROM balances)

WITH small_dollar AS (SELECT i."cmte_id", SUM(i."transaction_amt") AS TOTAL_SMALL_DONATIONS FROM "FEC"."FEC"."INDIVIDUALS_2016" AS i WHERE i."transaction_amt" > 0 AND i."transaction_amt" < 200 GROUP BY i."cmte_id" HAVING SUM(i."transaction_amt") > 0 AND SUM(i."transaction_amt") < 200), committee_candidates AS (SELECT cc."cmte_id", COUNT(DISTINCT cc."cand_id") AS num_candidates, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ca."cand_name", ', ' ORDER BY ca."cand_name") AS candidate_names FROM "FEC"."FEC"."CANDIDATE_COMMITTEE_2016" AS cc JOIN "FEC"."FEC"."CANDIDATE_2016" AS ca ON cc."cand_id" = ca."cand_id" GROUP BY cc."cmte_id") SELECT c."cmte_nm", ccand.num_candidates, ccand.candidate_names, sd.TOTAL_SMALL_DONATIONS FROM small_dollar AS sd JOIN "FEC"."FEC"."COMMITTEE_2016" AS c ON sd."cmte_id" = c."cmte_id" JOIN committee_candidates AS ccand ON sd."cmte_id" = ccand."cmte_id" ORDER BY c."cmte_nm"

SELECT k."approvedSymbol" AS TARGET_SYMBOL, m."name" AS DRUG_NAME, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'element', 'url') AS TEXT) AS CLINICAL_TRIAL_REFERENCE_URL FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."KNOWNDRUGSAGGREGATED" AS k JOIN "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."MOLECULE" AS m ON k."drugId" = m."id", LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(k."urls", 'list')) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE k."diseaseId" = 'EFO_0007416' AND k."status" = 'Completed' ORDER BY TARGET_SYMBOL

WITH daily_counts AS (SELECT "year", "month", "day", COUNT(*) AS daily_sightings FROM "GBIF"."GBIF"."OCCURRENCES" WHERE "species" = 'Sterna paradisaea' AND "decimallatitude" > 40 AND "month" >= 2 AND NOT "year" IS NULL AND NOT "month" IS NULL AND NOT "day" IS NULL GROUP BY "year", "month", "day" HAVING COUNT(*) > 10), earliest_per_year AS (SELECT "year", MIN(DATE_FROM_PARTS("year", "month", "day")) AS earliest_date FROM daily_counts GROUP BY "year") SELECT "year" AS OUTPUT FROM earliest_per_year ORDER BY DAY_OF_YEAR(earliest_date) LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (SELECT t."pickup_location_id", t."tip_amount", t."total_amount" FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TLC_YELLOW_TRIPS_2016" AS t WHERE t."pickup_datetime" >= 1451606400000000 AND t."pickup_datetime" < 1452211200000000 AND t."dropoff_datetime" >= 1451606400000000 AND t."dropoff_datetime" < 1452211200000000 AND t."dropoff_datetime" > t."pickup_datetime" AND t."passenger_count" > 0 AND t."trip_distance" >= 0 AND t."tip_amount" >= 0 AND t."tolls_amount" >= 0 AND t."mta_tax" >= 0 AND t."fare_amount" >= 0 AND t."total_amount" >= 0), trips_with_borough AS (SELECT z."borough" AS pickup_borough, CASE WHEN ft."total_amount" = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ft."tip_amount" * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / ft."total_amount" END AS tip_rate FROM filtered_trips AS ft JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS z ON ft."pickup_location_id" = z."zone_id") SELECT pickup_borough, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_no_tip FROM trips_with_borough GROUP BY pickup_borough ORDER BY percentage_no_tip DESC

/* sf_bq100: Top 10 most frequently used packages from Go import statements */ /* Approach: Extract import blocks enclosed in parentheses, split by newlines, */ /* extract double-quoted package names, count frequency, remove quotes */ SELECT REPLACE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(line.VALUE AS TEXT), '"[^"]+"', 0), '"', '') AS package, COUNT(*) AS f0_ FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_CONTENTS", LATERAL UNNEST(input => SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT("content", 'import\s*\([^)]+\)', 1, 1, 's', 0), '
')) AS line(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE ("content" LIKE '%import (%' OR "content" LIKE '%import(%') AND NOT REGEXP_EXTRACT("content", 'import\s*\([^)]+\)', 1, 1, 's', 0) IS NULL AND NOT REPLACE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(line.VALUE AS TEXT), '"[^"]+"', 0), '"', '') IS NULL GROUP BY package ORDER BY f0_ DESC, package ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT package_name AS "PACKAGE_NAME", COUNT(*) AS "IMPORT_COUNT" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(value) LIKE 'import static %' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(value), '^import\s+static\s+', '', 'g'), '\.[^.]+;\s*$', '', 'g'), '\.[^.]+$', '', 'g') /* Static import: strip 'import static ', then remove last TWO dot-segments (class.method) */ ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(value), '^import\s+', '', 'g'), '\.[^.]+;\s*$', '', 'g') /* Regular import: strip 'import ', then remove last ONE dot-segment (class) */ END AS package_name FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_CONTENTS", LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE("content", '
') WHERE "sample_path" LIKE '%.java' AND TRIM(value) LIKE 'import %') AS sub WHERE NOT package_name IS NULL AND package_name <> '' GROUP BY package_name ORDER BY "IMPORT_COUNT" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH variant_stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_variants, SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(alt.value, 'AC') AS INT)) AS sum_ac, SUM(CAST("AN" AS INT)) AS sum_an FROM "GNOMAD"."GNOMAD"."V3_GENOMES__CHR1", LATERAL UNNEST(input => "alternate_bases") AS alt(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE "start_position" BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852), gene_symbols AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(vep.value, 'SYMBOL') AS TEXT) AS gene_symbol FROM "GNOMAD"."GNOMAD"."V3_GENOMES__CHR1", LATERAL UNNEST(input => "alternate_bases") AS alt(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(alt.value, 'vep')) AS vep(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE "start_position" BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852 AND NOT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(vep.value, 'SYMBOL') AS TEXT) IS NULL AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(vep.value, 'SYMBOL') AS TEXT) <> 'None') SELECT ROUND(CAST((55064852 - 55039447) / CAST(vs.num_variants AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS BURDEN_OF_MUTATION, vs.num_variants AS NUM_VARIANTS, vs.sum_ac AS SUM_AC, vs.sum_an AS SUM_AN, (SELECT STRING_AGG(gene_symbol, ', ' ORDER BY gene_symbol) FROM gene_symbols) AS GENES FROM variant_stats AS vs

WITH state_population AS (/* Aggregate zip-level population to state level using zipcode_area mapping */ SELECT za."state_name", SUM(p."population") AS POPULATION_2010 FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."CENSUS_BUREAU_USA"."POPULATION_BY_ZIP_2000" AS p JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."UTILITY_US"."ZIPCODE_AREA" AS za ON p."zipcode" = za."zipcode" WHERE p."minimum_age" IS NULL AND p."maximum_age" IS NULL AND p."gender" = '' AND NOT za."state_name" LIKE '%,%' GROUP BY za."state_name"), distracted_accidents_2015 AS (SELECT 2015 AS YEAR, a."state_name", COUNT(DISTINCT a."consecutive_number") AS ACCIDENTS FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."ACCIDENT_2015" AS a JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."DISTRACT_2015" AS d ON a."state_number" = d."state_number" AND a."consecutive_number" = d."consecutive_number" WHERE NOT d."driver_distracted_by_name" IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported') GROUP BY a."state_name"), distracted_accidents_2016 AS (SELECT 2016 AS YEAR, a."state_name", COUNT(DISTINCT a."consecutive_number") AS ACCIDENTS FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."ACCIDENT_2016" AS a JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."DISTRACT_2016" AS d ON a."state_number" = d."state_number" AND a."consecutive_number" = d."consecutive_number" WHERE NOT d."driver_distracted_by_name" IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported') GROUP BY a."state_name"), combined AS (SELECT * FROM distracted_accidents_2015 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM distracted_accidents_2016), rated AS (SELECT c.YEAR, c."state_name", c.ACCIDENTS, sp.POPULATION_2010, ROUND(CAST(c.ACCIDENTS * 100000.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / sp.POPULATION_2010, 1) AS ACCIDENTS_PER_100K, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.YEAR ORDER BY CAST(c.ACCIDENTS * 100000.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / sp.POPULATION_2010 DESC) AS YEAR_RANK FROM combined AS c JOIN state_population AS sp ON c."state_name" = sp."state_name") SELECT YEAR, "state_name", ACCIDENTS, POPULATION_2010, ACCIDENTS_PER_100K, YEAR_RANK FROM rated WHERE YEAR_RANK <= 5 ORDER BY YEAR, YEAR_RANK

WITH longest_ref AS (SELECT "name" AS REFERENCE_NAME, "length" AS REFERENCE_LENGTH FROM "GENOMICS_CANNABIS"."GENOMICS_CANNABIS"."MNPR01_REFERENCE_201703" ORDER BY "length" DESC LIMIT 1), variant_with_gt AS (SELECT v."reference_name", v."start", v."end", MAX(CAST(g.VALUE AS INT)) AS max_genotype FROM "GENOMICS_CANNABIS"."GENOMICS_CANNABIS"."MNPR01_201703" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.VALUE, 'genotype')) AS g(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE v."reference_name" = (SELECT REFERENCE_NAME FROM longest_ref) GROUP BY v."reference_name", v."start", v."end"), variant_count AS (SELECT "reference_name", COUNT(*) AS VARIANT_COUNT FROM variant_with_gt WHERE max_genotype > 0 GROUP BY "reference_name") SELECT lr.REFERENCE_NAME, ROUND(CAST(vc.VARIANT_COUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / lr.REFERENCE_LENGTH, 6) AS VARIANT_DENSITY, vc.VARIANT_COUNT, lr.REFERENCE_LENGTH FROM longest_ref AS lr JOIN variant_count AS vc ON lr.REFERENCE_NAME = vc."reference_name"

WITH base_accidents AS (SELECT "consecutive_number" FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."PERSON_2015" WHERE "month_of_crash" BETWEEN 1 AND 8 GROUP BY "consecutive_number" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "person_number") > 1), severe_accidents AS (SELECT p."consecutive_number" FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."PERSON_2015" AS p JOIN base_accidents AS b ON p."consecutive_number" = b."consecutive_number" WHERE p."injury_severity" = 4 GROUP BY p."consecutive_number" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM severe_accidents) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_accidents) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS PERCENT_WITH_MORE_THAN_ONE_SEVERE_INJURY

WITH wages_1998 AS (SELECT AVG("avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries") AS avg_wkly_wage FROM (SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_1998_Q1" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_1998_Q2" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_1998_Q3" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_1998_Q4" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003')), wages_2017 AS (SELECT AVG("avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries") AS avg_wkly_wage FROM (SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2017_Q1" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2017_Q2" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2017_Q3" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003' UNION ALL SELECT "avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries" FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2017_Q4" WHERE "area_fips" = '42003')), cpi_1998 AS (SELECT CAST("value" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS cpi_value FROM "BLS"."BLS"."CPI_U" WHERE "series_id" = 'CUUSA104SA0' AND "year" = '1998' AND "period" = 'S03'), cpi_2017 AS (SELECT CAST("value" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS cpi_value FROM "BLS"."BLS"."CPI_U" WHERE "series_id" = 'CUUSA104SA0' AND "year" = '2017' AND "period" = 'S03') SELECT ROUND(CAST((w2017.avg_wkly_wage - w1998.avg_wkly_wage) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / w1998.avg_wkly_wage * 100, 2) AS WAGES_GROWTH_PCT, ROUND(CAST((c2017.cpi_value - c1998.cpi_value) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c1998.cpi_value * 100, 2) AS CPI_GROWTH_PCT, CASE WHEN CAST((w2017.avg_wkly_wage - w1998.avg_wkly_wage) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / w1998.avg_wkly_wage >= CAST((c2017.cpi_value - c1998.cpi_value) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c1998.cpi_value THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS WAGES_KEPT_PACE_WITH_INFLATION FROM wages_1998 AS w1998 CROSS JOIN wages_2017 AS w2017 CROSS JOIN cpi_1998 AS c1998 CROSS JOIN cpi_2017 AS c2017
