WITH year_2000 AS (SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2000_Q1" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2000_Q2" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2000_Q3" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2000_Q4" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5), year_2018 AS (SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2018_Q1" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2018_Q2" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2018_Q3" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5 UNION ALL SELECT "area_fips", "month3_emplvl_1012_construction" AS emp FROM "BLS"."BLS_QCEW"."_2018_Q4" WHERE "area_fips" LIKE '49%' AND LENGTH("area_fips") = 5), avg_2000 AS (SELECT "area_fips", AVG(emp) AS avg_emp_2000 FROM year_2000 GROUP BY "area_fips"), avg_2018 AS (SELECT "area_fips", AVG(emp) AS avg_emp_2018 FROM year_2018 GROUP BY "area_fips") SELECT c."county_name" AS county, CAST((a18.avg_emp_2018 - a00.avg_emp_2000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / a00.avg_emp_2000 * 100 AS increase_rate FROM avg_2000 AS a00 JOIN avg_2018 AS a18 ON a00."area_fips" = a18."area_fips" JOIN "BLS"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."COUNTIES" AS c ON a00."area_fips" = c."geo_id" WHERE NOT a00.avg_emp_2000 IS NULL AND a00.avg_emp_2000 > 0 AND NOT a18.avg_emp_2018 IS NULL ORDER BY increase_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH epa AS (SELECT ROUND("latitude", 2) AS lat, ROUND("longitude", 2) AS lon, AVG("arithmetic_mean") AS arithmetic_mean FROM "OPENAQ"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."PM25_NONFRM_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "parameter_name" = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass' AND "units_of_measure" = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 1990 GROUP BY ROUND("latitude", 2), ROUND("longitude", 2)), oaq AS (SELECT "city", "value", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS ts, ROUND("latitude", 2) AS lat, ROUND("longitude", 2) AS lon FROM "OPENAQ"."OPENAQ"."GLOBAL_AIR_QUALITY" WHERE "pollutant" = 'pm25' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2020) SELECT oaq."city" AS city, epa.arithmetic_mean, oaq."value" AS value, CAST(oaq.ts AS DATE) AS timestamp, epa.arithmetic_mean - oaq."value" AS f0_ FROM epa JOIN oaq ON epa.lat = oaq.lat AND epa.lon = oaq.lon ORDER BY f0_ DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT "country_name" AS OUTPUT FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL"."MIDYEAR_POPULATION_AGESPECIFIC" WHERE "year" = 2017 GROUP BY "country_name" ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "age" < 25 THEN "population" ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM("population") DESC LIMIT 1

WITH all_storms AS (SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2010" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2011" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2012" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2013" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2014" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2015" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2016" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2017" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2018" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2019" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2020" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2021" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2022" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2023" UNION ALL SELECT "damage_property", "event_begin_time" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_2024"), top100 AS (SELECT "damage_property", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("event_begin_time" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS event_month FROM all_storms ORDER BY "damage_property" DESC LIMIT 100), month_counts AS (SELECT event_month, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM top100 GROUP BY event_month) SELECT event_count AS EVENTS_IN_MOST_AFFECTED_MONTH FROM month_counts ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1

WITH discharge_by_age AS (SELECT a12."Description" AS age_group, a12."Code" AS age_code, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT d."Icd10Code") AS DECIMAL), 6) AS avg_deaths FROM "DEATH"."DEATH"."DEATHRECORDS" AS d JOIN "DEATH"."DEATH"."ICD10CODE" AS i ON d."Icd10Code" = i."Code" JOIN "DEATH"."DEATH"."AGERECODE12" AS a12 ON d."AgeRecode12" = a12."Code" WHERE d."Race" = 1 AND LOWER(i."Description") LIKE '%discharge%' AND NOT i."Description" LIKE '%Urethral discharge%' AND NOT i."Description" LIKE '%Discharge of firework%' AND NOT i."Description" LIKE '%Legal intervention involving firearm discharge%' GROUP BY a12."Code", a12."Description"), vehicle_by_age AS (SELECT a12."Description" AS age_group, a12."Code" AS age_code, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT d."Icd10Code") AS DECIMAL), 6) AS avg_deaths FROM "DEATH"."DEATH"."DEATHRECORDS" AS d JOIN "DEATH"."DEATH"."ICD10CODE" AS i ON d."Icd10Code" = i."Code" JOIN "DEATH"."DEATH"."AGERECODE12" AS a12 ON d."AgeRecode12" = a12."Code" WHERE d."Race" = 1 AND LOWER(i."Description") LIKE '%vehicle%' GROUP BY a12."Code", a12."Description") SELECT COALESCE(dc.age_group, vc.age_group) AS "Age Group", dc.avg_deaths AS "Avg Deaths - Discharge Codes", vc.avg_deaths AS "Avg Deaths - Vehicle Codes", ROUND(dc.avg_deaths - vc.avg_deaths, 6) AS "Difference (Discharge - Vehicle)" FROM discharge_by_age AS dc FULL OUTER JOIN vehicle_by_age AS vc ON dc.age_code = vc.age_code ORDER BY COALESCE(dc.age_code, vc.age_code)

WITH hurricane_sids AS (/* Identify storms that reached hurricane status (usa_status = 'HU') in 2020 North Atlantic */ SELECT DISTINCT "sid" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" WHERE "season" = '2020' AND "basin" = 'NA' AND "usa_status" = 'HU'), track_with_segments AS (/* Get all track points for those hurricanes with segment distances */ SELECT h."sid", h."iso_time", h."latitude", h."longitude", h."usa_wind", LAG(h."latitude") OVER (PARTITION BY h."sid" ORDER BY h."iso_time") AS prev_lat, LAG(h."longitude") OVER (PARTITION BY h."sid" ORDER BY h."iso_time") AS prev_lon FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HURRICANES"."HURRICANES" AS h INNER JOIN hurricane_sids AS hs ON h."sid" = hs."sid"), track_with_distance AS (SELECT "sid", "iso_time", "latitude", "longitude", "usa_wind", CASE WHEN NOT prev_lat IS NULL THEN CAST(ST_DISTANCE(ST_POINT("longitude", "latitude"), ST_POINT(prev_lon, prev_lat)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000.0 ELSE NULL END AS segment_km FROM track_with_segments), total_distances AS (/* Total travel distance per storm */ SELECT "sid", SUM(COALESCE(segment_km, 0)) AS total_distance_km FROM track_with_distance GROUP BY "sid"), ranked AS (/* Rank storms by total distance descending */ SELECT "sid", total_distance_km, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_km DESC) AS rn FROM total_distances), third_longest AS (/* Get the third longest */ SELECT "sid" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 3) /* Output the track with cumulative distance and wind for the third longest hurricane */ SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_POINT(td."longitude", td."latitude")) AS "GEOM", CASE WHEN td.segment_km IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUM(COALESCE(td.segment_km, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY td."sid" ORDER BY td."iso_time" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) END AS "CUMULATIVE_DISTANCE", td."usa_wind" FROM track_with_distance AS td INNER JOIN third_longest AS tl ON td."sid" = tl."sid" ORDER BY td."iso_time"

SELECT s."FIPS" AS geo_id, s."SNAP_All_Participation_Households" AS snap_total, (a."income_less_10000" + a."income_10000_14999" + a."income_15000_19999") AS households_under_20, CAST((a."income_less_10000" + a."income_10000_14999" + a."income_15000_19999") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s."SNAP_All_Participation_Households" AS under_20_snap_ratio FROM "SDOH"."SDOH_SNAP_ENROLLMENT"."SNAP_ENROLLMENT" AS s JOIN "SDOH"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."COUNTY_2017_5YR" AS a ON s."FIPS" = a."geo_id" WHERE s."Date" = '2017-01-01' AND s."SNAP_All_Participation_Households" > 0 ORDER BY snap_total DESC LIMIT 10

WITH earliest_answers AS (SELECT "parent_id", MIN("creation_date") AS earliest_answer_date FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" GROUP BY "parent_id"), question_stats AS (SELECT DAYNAME(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(q."creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS DAY_OF_WEEK, CASE WHEN NOT ea.earliest_answer_date IS NULL AND CAST((ea.earliest_answer_date - q."creation_date") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000.0 <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS answered_within_hour FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q LEFT JOIN earliest_answers AS ea ON q."id" = ea."parent_id"), day_pct AS (SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK, ROUND(CAST(CAST(100.0 * SUM(answered_within_hour) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 6) AS PCT_WITHIN_1H FROM question_stats GROUP BY DAY_OF_WEEK), ranked AS (SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK, PCT_WITHIN_1H, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PCT_WITHIN_1H DESC) AS rn FROM day_pct) SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK, PCT_WITHIN_1H FROM ranked WHERE rn = 3

/* sf_bq124: Count alive patients with Diabetes or Hypertension diagnosis */ /* and at least 7 distinct active medications */ WITH alive_patients AS (SELECT "id" AS patient_id FROM "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."PATIENT" WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("deceased", 'dateTime') IS NULL), diabetes_or_hypertension_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) AS patient_id FROM "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."CONDITION" WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("code", 'coding', '0', 'display') AS TEXT) IN ('Diabetes', 'Hypertension')), patients_with_7_plus_active_meds AS (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) AS patient_id FROM "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."MEDICATION_REQUEST" WHERE "status" = 'active' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("medication", 'codeableConcept', 'coding', '0', 'code') AS TEXT)) >= 7) SELECT COUNT(*) AS OUTPUT FROM alive_patients AS a JOIN diabetes_or_hypertension_patients AS d ON a.patient_id = d.patient_id JOIN patients_with_7_plus_active_meds AS m ON a.patient_id = m.patient_id

SELECT o."artist_display_name", o."title", o."object_end_date", o."medium", i."original_image_url" FROM "THE_MET"."THE_MET"."OBJECTS" AS o JOIN "THE_MET"."THE_MET"."IMAGES" AS i ON o."object_id" = i."object_id" WHERE o."department" = 'Photographs' AND o."object_name" LIKE '%Photograph%' AND o."object_end_date" <= 1839 AND o."artist_display_name" <> 'Unknown' ORDER BY o."title", i."original_image_url"

WITH denmark AS (SELECT ST_COLLECT(CAST("geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY)) AS geom FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" AS pf, LATERAL UNNEST(input => pf."all_tags") AS tag(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE pf."feature_type" = 'multipolygons' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(tag.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'wikidata' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(tag.value, 'value') AS TEXT) = 'Q35'), bus_stops_in_denmark AS (SELECT pp."osm_id", pp."all_tags" FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES_POINTS" AS pp, LATERAL UNNEST(input => pp."all_tags") AS f_hw(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), denmark AS d WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f_hw.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'highway' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f_hw.value, 'value') AS TEXT) = 'bus_stop' AND ST_INTERSECTS(d.geom, CAST(pp."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY))), bus_stops_with_network AS (SELECT bs."osm_id", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f_net.value, 'value') AS TEXT) AS network FROM bus_stops_in_denmark AS bs, LATERAL UNNEST(input => bs."all_tags") AS f_net(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f_net.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'network') SELECT network, COUNT(*) AS bus_stop_count FROM bus_stops_with_network GROUP BY network ORDER BY bus_stop_count DESC

SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS date FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ZILLIQA"."TRANSACTIONS" WHERE CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) < '2022-01-01' GROUP BY date ORDER BY SUM("amount") DESC LIMIT 1

WITH all_txns AS (/* Regular transactions */ SELECT "id" AS tx_id, "sender" AS from_addr, "to_addr" AS to_addr, "block_timestamp" AS ts FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ZILLIQA"."TRANSACTIONS" WHERE "success" = TRUE UNION ALL /* Contract transitions */ SELECT "transaction_id" AS tx_id, "addr" AS from_addr, "recipient" AS to_addr, "block_timestamp" AS ts FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ZILLIQA"."TRANSITIONS" WHERE "accepted" = TRUE), outgoing_counts /* Count outgoing transactions per address (to filter out exchanges/mixers) */ AS (SELECT from_addr, COUNT(*) AS outgoing_cnt FROM all_txns GROUP BY from_addr), two_hop_paths /* Find 2-hop paths: source -> intermediate -> destination */ AS (SELECT hop1.from_addr AS source, hop1.to_addr AS intermediate, hop2.to_addr AS destination, hop1.tx_id AS tx1_id, hop2.tx_id AS tx2_id, hop1.ts AS ts1, hop2.ts AS ts2 FROM all_txns AS hop1 JOIN all_txns AS hop2 ON hop1.to_addr = hop2.from_addr WHERE hop1.from_addr = 'zil1jrpjd8pjuv50cfkfr7eu6yrm3rn5u8rulqhqpz' AND hop2.to_addr = 'zil19nmxkh020jnequql9kvqkf3pkwm0j0spqtd26e' AND hop2.ts > hop1.ts) SELECT p.source || ' --(tx ' || LEFT(p.tx1_id, 5) || '..)--> ' || p.intermediate || ' --(tx ' || LEFT(p.tx2_id, 5) || '..)--> ' || p.destination AS PATH FROM two_hop_paths AS p JOIN outgoing_counts AS oc ON p.intermediate = oc.from_addr WHERE oc.outgoing_cnt <= 50 ORDER BY PATH

SELECT za."zipcode_geom", za."area_land_meters", za."area_water_meters", za."latitude", za."longitude", za."state_code", za."state_name", za."city", za."county", SUM(p."population") AS TOTAL_POPULATION FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_USA"."UTILITY_US"."ZIPCODE_AREA" AS za JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_USA"."CENSUS_BUREAU_USA"."POPULATION_BY_ZIP_2010" AS p ON za."zipcode" = p."zipcode" WHERE p."gender" IN ('male', 'female') AND p."minimum_age" IS NULL AND p."maximum_age" IS NULL AND ST_DWITHIN(CAST(za."zipcode_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_POINT(-122.3321, 47.6062), 10000) GROUP BY za."zipcode_geom", za."area_land_meters", za."area_water_meters", za."latitude", za."longitude", za."state_code", za."state_name", za."city", za."county"

WITH kirp_cases AS (SELECT c."case_barcode", c."clinical_stage", ABS(HASH(c."case_barcode") % 10) AS split_val FROM "TCGA_HG38_DATA_V0"."TCGA_BIOCLIN_V0"."CLINICAL" AS c WHERE c."disease_code" = 'KIRP' AND NOT c."clinical_stage" IS NULL), gene_expr AS (SELECT r."case_barcode", MAX(CASE WHEN r."gene_name" = 'MT-CO1' THEN r."HTSeq__FPKM_UQ" END) AS co1, MAX(CASE WHEN r."gene_name" = 'MT-CO2' THEN r."HTSeq__FPKM_UQ" END) AS co2, MAX(CASE WHEN r."gene_name" = 'MT-CO3' THEN r."HTSeq__FPKM_UQ" END) AS co3 FROM "TCGA_HG38_DATA_V0"."TCGA_HG38_DATA_V0"."RNASEQ_GENE_EXPRESSION" AS r WHERE r."project_short_name" = 'TCGA-KIRP' AND r."gene_name" IN ('MT-CO1', 'MT-CO2', 'MT-CO3') GROUP BY r."case_barcode"), all_cases AS (SELECT kc."case_barcode", kc."clinical_stage", kc.split_val, ge.co1, ge.co2, ge.co3 FROM kirp_cases AS kc INNER JOIN gene_expr AS ge ON kc."case_barcode" = ge."case_barcode"), train_set AS (SELECT * FROM all_cases WHERE split_val <> 9), test_set AS (SELECT * FROM all_cases WHERE split_val = 9), stage_centroids AS (SELECT "clinical_stage", AVG(co1) AS avg_co1, AVG(co2) AS avg_co2, AVG(co3) AS avg_co3 FROM train_set GROUP BY "clinical_stage"), distances AS (SELECT te."case_barcode", sc."clinical_stage" AS predicted_stage, SQRT(COALESCE(POWER(te.co1 - sc.avg_co1, 2), 0) + COALESCE(POWER(te.co2 - sc.avg_co2, 2), 0) + COALESCE(POWER(te.co3 - sc.avg_co3, 2), 0)) AS distance FROM test_set AS te CROSS JOIN stage_centroids AS sc), ranked AS (SELECT "case_barcode", predicted_stage, distance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "case_barcode" ORDER BY distance) AS rn FROM distances) SELECT "case_barcode" AS case_barcode, predicted_stage AS predicted_stage FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY case_barcode

WITH combined AS (/* Historical win rows (2014-2017) */ SELECT h."season", 'win' AS "label", h."win_seed" AS "seed", h."win_school_ncaa" AS "school_ncaa", h."lose_seed" AS "opponent_seed", h."lose_school_ncaa" AS "opponent_school_ncaa" FROM "NCAA_INSIGHTS"."NCAA"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TOURNAMENT_GAMES" AS h WHERE h."season" >= 2014 UNION ALL /* Historical loss rows (2014-2017) */ SELECT h."season", 'loss' AS "label", h."lose_seed" AS "seed", h."lose_school_ncaa" AS "school_ncaa", h."win_seed" AS "opponent_seed", h."win_school_ncaa" AS "opponent_school_ncaa" FROM "NCAA_INSIGHTS"."NCAA"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TOURNAMENT_GAMES" AS h WHERE h."season" >= 2014 UNION ALL /* 2018 tournament results (already has label, seed, school_ncaa, opponent_seed, opponent_school_ncaa) */ SELECT t."season", t."label", t."seed", t."school_ncaa", t."opponent_seed", t."opponent_school_ncaa" FROM "NCAA_INSIGHTS"."NCAA"."_2018_TOURNAMENT_RESULTS" AS t) SELECT c."season", c."label", c."seed", c."school_ncaa", ft."pace_rank", ft."poss_40min", ft."pace_rating", ft."efficiency_rank", ft."pts_100poss", ft."efficiency_rating", c."opponent_seed", c."opponent_school_ncaa", fo."pace_rank" AS "opp_pace_rank", fo."poss_40min" AS "opp_poss_40min", fo."pace_rating" AS "opp_pace_rating", fo."efficiency_rank" AS "opp_efficiency_rank", fo."pts_100poss" AS "opp_pts_100poss", fo."efficiency_rating" AS "opp_efficiency_rating", fo."pace_rank" - ft."pace_rank" AS "pace_rank_diff", fo."poss_40min" - ft."poss_40min" AS "pace_stat_diff", fo."pace_rating" - ft."pace_rating" AS "pace_rating_diff", fo."efficiency_rank" - ft."efficiency_rank" AS "eff_rank_diff", fo."pts_100poss" - ft."pts_100poss" AS "eff_stat_diff", fo."efficiency_rating" - ft."efficiency_rating" AS "eff_rating_diff" FROM combined AS c LEFT JOIN "NCAA_INSIGHTS"."NCAA"."FEATURE_ENGINEERING" AS ft ON c."school_ncaa" = ft."team" AND c."season" = ft."season" LEFT JOIN "NCAA_INSIGHTS"."NCAA"."FEATURE_ENGINEERING" AS fo ON c."opponent_school_ncaa" = fo."team" AND c."season" = fo."season"

SELECT "Ensembl_gene_id_v", VAR_SAMP("fpkm_uq_unstranded") AS VAR_FPKM FROM "TCGA"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."RNASEQ_HG38_GDC_R35" WHERE "project_short_name" = 'TCGA-BRCA' AND "sample_type_name" = 'Solid Tissue Normal' AND "gene_type" = 'protein_coding' GROUP BY "Ensembl_gene_id_v" ORDER BY VAR_FPKM DESC LIMIT 5

WITH paad_patients /* Step 1: Get distinct PAAD patients who have PASS-filtered mutations */ /* (INNER JOIN between MAF and clinical follow-up ensures data integrity) */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT m."ParticipantBarcode" AS patient_id FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" AS m JOIN "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_CLINICAL_PANCAN_PATIENT_WITH_FOLLOWUP" AS c ON m."ParticipantBarcode" = c."bcr_patient_barcode" WHERE c."acronym" = 'PAAD' AND m."FILTER" = 'PASS'), kras_mutants /* Step 2: Identify patients with KRAS PASS mutations */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" AS patient_id FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Hugo_Symbol" = 'KRAS' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), tp53_mutants /* Step 3: Identify patients with TP53 PASS mutations */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" AS patient_id FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Hugo_Symbol" = 'TP53' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), patient_status /* Step 4: Classify each PAAD patient by KRAS and TP53 mutation status */ AS (SELECT p.patient_id, CASE WHEN NOT k.patient_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_kras, CASE WHEN NOT t.patient_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_tp53 FROM paad_patients AS p LEFT JOIN kras_mutants AS k ON p.patient_id = k.patient_id LEFT JOIN tp53_mutants AS t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id), contingency /* Step 5: Build the 2x2 observed contingency table */ AS (SELECT has_kras, has_tp53, COUNT(*) AS observed FROM patient_status GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53), totals /* Step 6: Compute row totals, column totals, and grand total */ AS (SELECT c.*, SUM(observed) OVER (PARTITION BY has_kras) AS kras_row_total, SUM(observed) OVER (PARTITION BY has_tp53) AS tp53_col_total, SUM(observed) OVER () AS grand_total FROM contingency AS c), chi_sq_components /* Step 7: Compute expected values and chi-squared components */ AS (SELECT has_kras, has_tp53, observed, CAST((kras_row_total * tp53_col_total * 1.0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / grand_total AS expected, grand_total FROM totals), chi_squared /* Step 8: Compute the final chi-squared statistic */ AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(POWER(observed - expected, 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / expected) AS chi_squared_stat FROM chi_sq_components), summary_counts /* Step 9: Extract summary counts */ AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Patients, SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KRAS_and_TP53_Mutated_Count, SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KRAS_only_Count, SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TP53_only_Count, SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Neither_Mutated_Count FROM patient_status) SELECT s.Total_Patients, s.KRAS_and_TP53_Mutated_Count, s.KRAS_only_Count, s.TP53_only_Count, s.Neither_Mutated_Count, CAST(s.KRAS_and_TP53_Mutated_Count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.Total_Patients AS KRAS_and_TP53_Mutated_Frequency, CAST(s.KRAS_only_Count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.Total_Patients AS KRAS_only_Frequency, CAST(s.TP53_only_Count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.Total_Patients AS TP53_only_Frequency, CAST(s.Neither_Mutated_Count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.Total_Patients AS Neither_Mutated_Frequency, c.chi_squared_stat AS Chi_Squared_Stat FROM summary_counts AS s CROSS JOIN chi_squared AS c

WITH patient_expr AS (SELECT e."ParticipantBarcode", c."icd_o_3_histology", AVG(LOG(10, e."normalized_count" + 1)) AS avg_expr FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."EBPP_ADJUSTPANCAN_ILLUMINAHISEQ_RNASEQV2_GENEXP_FILTERED" AS e JOIN "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."CLINICAL_PANCAN_PATIENT_WITH_FOLLOWUP_FILTERED" AS c ON e."ParticipantBarcode" = c."bcr_patient_barcode" WHERE e."Symbol" = 'IGF2' AND e."Study" = 'LGG' AND NOT e."normalized_count" IS NULL AND NOT c."icd_o_3_histology" LIKE '[%]' GROUP BY e."ParticipantBarcode", c."icd_o_3_histology"), valid_groups AS (SELECT "icd_o_3_histology" FROM patient_expr GROUP BY "icd_o_3_histology" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), filtered_patients AS (SELECT p.* FROM patient_expr AS p INNER JOIN valid_groups AS g ON p."icd_o_3_histology" = g."icd_o_3_histology"), ranked AS (SELECT "ParticipantBarcode", "icd_o_3_histology", avg_expr, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_expr) AS rank_val FROM filtered_patients), group_stats AS (SELECT "icd_o_3_histology", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ni, SUM(CAST(rank_val AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS Si, SUM(POWER(CAST(rank_val AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 2)) AS Qi FROM ranked GROUP BY "icd_o_3_histology"), totals AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS N FROM ranked), h_calc AS (SELECT t.N, SUM(CAST(POWER(g.Si, 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / g.ni) AS sum_si2_over_ni, SUM(g.Si) AS sum_si, SUM(g.Qi) AS sum_qi FROM group_stats AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t GROUP BY t.N) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_stats) AS NGROUPS, h.N AS NSAMPLES, CAST((h.N - 1.0) * (h.sum_si2_over_ni - CAST(POWER(h.sum_si, 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / h.N) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (h.sum_qi - CAST(POWER(h.sum_si, 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / h.N) AS HSCORE FROM h_calc AS h ORDER BY NGROUPS DESC, NSAMPLES DESC, HSCORE DESC

WITH expr /* Step 1: Get all DRG2 expression values for LGG participants */ AS (SELECT "ParticipantBarcode", LOG(10, "normalized_count" + 1) AS log_expr FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."EBPP_ADJUSTPANCAN_ILLUMINAHISEQ_RNASEQV2_GENEXP_FILTERED" WHERE "Symbol" = 'DRG2' AND "Study" = 'LGG'), tp53_mutated /* Step 2: Get participants with TP53 PASS mutations in LGG */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Hugo_Symbol" = 'TP53' AND "Study" = 'LGG' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), totals /* Step 3: Compute total sums (S_total, Q_total, N_total) */ AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS N_total, SUM(log_expr) AS S_total, SUM(log_expr * log_expr) AS Q_total FROM expr), mutated_stats /* Step 4: Compute mutated sums (S_y, Q_y, N_y) */ AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS N_y, SUM(e.log_expr) AS S_y, SUM(e.log_expr * e.log_expr) AS Q_y FROM expr AS e INNER JOIN tp53_mutated AS m ON e."ParticipantBarcode" = m."ParticipantBarcode"), t_calc /* Step 5: Compute all stats and t-score */ AS (SELECT ms.N_y, ms.S_y, ms.Q_y, t.N_total - ms.N_y AS N_n, t.S_total - ms.S_y AS S_n, t.Q_total - ms.Q_y AS Q_n, CAST(ms.S_y /* Mean for mutated */ AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / ms.N_y AS g_y, CAST((t.S_total - ms.S_y) /* Mean for non-mutated */ AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (t.N_total - ms.N_y) AS g_n, CAST((ms.Q_y - CAST((ms.S_y * ms.S_y) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / ms.N_y) /* Variance for mutated: (Q_y - S_y^2/N_y) / (N_y - 1) */ AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (ms.N_y - 1) AS var_y, CAST(((t.Q_total - ms.Q_y) - CAST(((t.S_total - ms.S_y) * (t.S_total - ms.S_y)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (t.N_total - ms.N_y)) /* Variance for non-mutated: (Q_n - S_n^2/N_n) / (N_n - 1) */ AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (t.N_total - ms.N_y - 1) AS var_n FROM mutated_stats AS ms CROSS JOIN totals AS t) SELECT CASE WHEN N_y >= 10 AND N_n >= 10 AND var_y > 0 AND var_n > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(CAST((g_y - g_n) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SQRT(CAST(var_y AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / N_y + CAST(var_n AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / N_n) AS DECIMAL), 2) ELSE NULL END AS TSCORE FROM t_calc

/* Compute T-score for DRG2 expression difference between LGG patients with/without TP53 mutation */ /* Uses Welch's t-test: T = (mean_y - mean_n) / sqrt(var_y/n_y + var_n/n_n) */ /* y = WITH TP53 mutation, n = WITHOUT TP53 mutation */ WITH tp53_patients AS (/* Identify LGG patients with TP53 mutations (PASS filter) */ SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Study" = 'LGG' AND "Hugo_Symbol" = 'TP53' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), lgg_samples AS (/* All LGG tumor sample barcodes in MC3_MAF */ SELECT DISTINCT "Tumor_SampleBarcode" FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Study" = 'LGG'), patient_expr AS (/* For each patient, compute average log10(normalized_count + 1) of DRG2 */ /* Only using samples present in MC3_MAF for LGG */ SELECT e."ParticipantBarcode", AVG(LOG(10, e."normalized_count" + 1)) AS avg_log_expr, CASE WHEN NOT tp53."ParticipantBarcode" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_tp53 FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_1"."PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED"."EBPP_ADJUSTPANCAN_ILLUMINAHISEQ_RNASEQV2_GENEXP_FILTERED" AS e INNER JOIN lgg_samples AS ls ON e."SampleBarcode" = ls."Tumor_SampleBarcode" LEFT JOIN tp53_patients AS tp53 ON e."ParticipantBarcode" = tp53."ParticipantBarcode" WHERE e."Symbol" = 'DRG2' AND e."Study" = 'LGG' GROUP BY e."ParticipantBarcode", CASE WHEN NOT tp53."ParticipantBarcode" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), group_stats AS (/* Compute group-level statistics */ SELECT has_tp53, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(avg_log_expr) AS mean_expr, VAR_SAMP(avg_log_expr) AS var_expr FROM patient_expr GROUP BY has_tp53) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN n END) AS NY, MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN n END) AS NN, MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN mean_expr END) AS AVG_Y, MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN mean_expr END) AS AVG_N, CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN mean_expr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN mean_expr END)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SQRT(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN var_expr END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN n END) + CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN var_expr END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / MAX(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN n END)) AS TSCORE FROM group_stats

WITH sub_forums AS (SELECT "Id" FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMS" WHERE "ParentForumId" = (SELECT "Id" FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMS" WHERE "Title" = 'General' AND "ParentForumId" IS NULL)), earliest_topics AS (SELECT ft."Id" AS topic_id, ft."CreationDate", ft."Title" AS topic_title, ft."TotalViews", pf."Title" AS parent_forum_title FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMTOPICS" AS ft JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMS" AS f ON f."Id" = ft."ForumId" JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMS" AS pf ON pf."Id" = f."ParentForumId" WHERE ft."ForumId" IN (SELECT "Id" FROM sub_forums) ORDER BY ft."CreationDate" ASC LIMIT 5), msg_stats AS (SELECT fm."ForumTopicId", COUNT(fm."Id") AS reply_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fm."PostUserId") AS distinct_user_replies FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGES" AS fm WHERE fm."ForumTopicId" IN (SELECT topic_id FROM earliest_topics) GROUP BY fm."ForumTopicId"), vote_stats AS (SELECT fm."ForumTopicId", COUNT(fmv."Id") AS total_upvotes FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGEVOTES" AS fmv JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGES" AS fm ON fm."Id" = fmv."ForumMessageId" WHERE fm."ForumTopicId" IN (SELECT topic_id FROM earliest_topics) GROUP BY fm."ForumTopicId") SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(et."CreationDate" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF6') || ' UTC' AS DATE, et.topic_title AS FORUMTOPICTITLE, et.parent_forum_title AS PARENTFORUMTITLE, COALESCE(ms.reply_count, 0) AS FORUMTOPICREPLIESCOUNT, COALESCE(ms.distinct_user_replies, 0) AS DISTINCTUSERREPLIESCOUNT, COALESCE(vs.total_upvotes, 0) AS TOPICUPVOTES, COALESCE(et."TotalViews", 0) AS TOTALVIEWS FROM earliest_topics AS et LEFT JOIN msg_stats AS ms ON ms."ForumTopicId" = et.topic_id LEFT JOIN vote_stats AS vs ON vs."ForumTopicId" = et.topic_id ORDER BY et."CreationDate" ASC

WITH clinical_paad AS (/* Base population: all PAAD patients from clinical/follow-up data */ SELECT DISTINCT "bcr_patient_barcode" AS patient FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_CLINICAL_PANCAN_PATIENT_WITH_FOLLOWUP" WHERE "acronym" = 'PAAD'), kras_patients AS (/* PAAD patients with KRAS mutations that passed quality filters */ SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" AS patient FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Study" = 'PAAD' AND "Hugo_Symbol" = 'KRAS' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), tp53_patients AS (/* PAAD patients with TP53 mutations that passed quality filters */ SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode" AS patient FROM "PANCANCER_ATLAS_2"."PANCANCER_ATLAS"."FILTERED_MC3_MAF_V5_ONE_PER_TUMOR_SAMPLE" WHERE "Study" = 'PAAD' AND "Hugo_Symbol" = 'TP53' AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'), both_mutations AS (/* Patients with mutations in BOTH KRAS and TP53 */ SELECT c.patient FROM clinical_paad AS c INNER JOIN kras_patients AS k ON c.patient = k.patient INNER JOIN tp53_patients AS t ON c.patient = t.patient), neither_mutation AS (/* Patients without mutations in either KRAS or TP53 */ SELECT c.patient FROM clinical_paad AS c WHERE c.patient <> ALL (SELECT patient FROM kras_patients) AND c.patient <> ALL (SELECT patient FROM tp53_patients)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_mutations) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM neither_mutation) AS OUTPUT

WITH level2_data AS (/* Get WUSTL ImagingLevel2 records with their assay types */ SELECT DISTINCT m."Imaging_Assay_Type", p."HTAN_CENTER", p."HTAN_DATA_FILE_ID", p."ENTITYID", 'Level2' AS data_level FROM "HTAN_1"."HTAN_VERSIONED"."ID_PROVENANCE_R5" AS p INNER JOIN "HTAN_1"."HTAN_VERSIONED"."IMAGING_LEVEL2_METADATA_R5" AS m ON p."ENTITYID" = m."entityId" WHERE p."HTAN_CENTER" = 'HTAN WUSTL' AND NOT p."COMPONENT" IS NULL AND NOT p."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Auxiliary%' AND NOT p."COMPONENT" LIKE '%OtherAssay%' AND NOT p."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Level1%' AND NOT p."COMPONENT" LIKE '%ElectronMicroscopy%' AND p."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Imaging%'), level3_data AS (/* Find Level3 records derived from Level2 through provenance */ SELECT DISTINCT l2."Imaging_Assay_Type", l2."HTAN_CENTER", 'Level3' AS data_level FROM level2_data AS l2 INNER JOIN "HTAN_1"."HTAN_VERSIONED"."ID_PROVENANCE_R5" AS child ON child."HTAN_PARENT_DATA_FILE_ID" = l2."HTAN_DATA_FILE_ID" WHERE NOT child."COMPONENT" IS NULL AND NOT child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Auxiliary%' AND NOT child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%OtherAssay%' AND child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Level3%'), level4_data AS (/* Find Level4 records derived from Level3 or Level2 through provenance */ SELECT DISTINCT l2."Imaging_Assay_Type", l2."HTAN_CENTER", 'Level4' AS data_level FROM level2_data AS l2 INNER JOIN "HTAN_1"."HTAN_VERSIONED"."ID_PROVENANCE_R5" AS child ON child."HTAN_PARENT_DATA_FILE_ID" = l2."HTAN_DATA_FILE_ID" WHERE NOT child."COMPONENT" IS NULL AND NOT child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Auxiliary%' AND NOT child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%OtherAssay%' AND child."COMPONENT" LIKE '%Level4%'), all_levels AS (SELECT "Imaging_Assay_Type", "HTAN_CENTER", data_level FROM level2_data UNION SELECT "Imaging_Assay_Type", "HTAN_CENTER", data_level FROM level3_data UNION SELECT "Imaging_Assay_Type", "HTAN_CENTER", data_level FROM level4_data) SELECT "Imaging_Assay_Type", "HTAN_CENTER" AS "HTAN_Center", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT data_level, ', ' ORDER BY data_level) AS "AVAILABLE_DATA_LEVELS" FROM all_levels GROUP BY "Imaging_Assay_Type", "HTAN_CENTER" ORDER BY "Imaging_Assay_Type"

WITH loss_chr13 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "RefNo", "CaseNo", "InvNo", "Clone", "ChrOrd", "Start", "End" FROM "MITELMAN"."PROD"."CYTOCONVERTED" WHERE "Type" = 'Loss' AND "ChrOrd" = 13 AND "Start" <= 48481890 AND "End" >= 48303751), loss_chr17 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "RefNo", "CaseNo", "InvNo", "Clone", "ChrOrd", "Start", "End" FROM "MITELMAN"."PROD"."CYTOCONVERTED" WHERE "Type" = 'Loss' AND "ChrOrd" = 17 AND "Start" <= 7687490 AND "End" >= 7668421), gain_chr11 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "RefNo", "CaseNo", "InvNo", "Clone", "ChrOrd", "Start", "End" FROM "MITELMAN"."PROD"."CYTOCONVERTED" WHERE "Type" = 'Gain' AND "ChrOrd" = 11 AND "Start" <= 108369102 AND "End" >= 108223067) SELECT DISTINCT l13."RefNo", l13."CaseNo", l13."InvNo", l13."Clone", k."CloneShort" AS "KaryotypeShortDescription", l13."ChrOrd" AS "Chr13_ChrOrd", l13."Start" AS "Chr13_Start", l13."End" AS "Chr13_End", l17."ChrOrd" AS "Chr17_ChrOrd", l17."Start" AS "Chr17_Start", l17."End" AS "Chr17_End", g11."ChrOrd" AS "Chr11_ChrOrd", g11."Start" AS "Chr11_Start", g11."End" AS "Chr11_End" FROM loss_chr13 AS l13 INNER JOIN loss_chr17 AS l17 ON l13."RefNo" = l17."RefNo" AND l13."CaseNo" = l17."CaseNo" AND l13."InvNo" = l17."InvNo" AND l13."Clone" = l17."Clone" INNER JOIN gain_chr11 AS g11 ON l13."RefNo" = g11."RefNo" AND l13."CaseNo" = g11."CaseNo" AND l13."InvNo" = g11."InvNo" AND l13."Clone" = g11."Clone" INNER JOIN "MITELMAN"."PROD"."KARYCLONE" AS k ON l13."RefNo" = k."RefNo" AND l13."CaseNo" = k."CaseNo" AND l13."InvNo" = k."InvNo" AND l13."Clone" = k."CloneNo" ORDER BY l13."RefNo", l13."CaseNo", l13."InvNo", l13."Clone", l13."Start", l13."End", l17."Start", l17."End", g11."Start", g11."End"

WITH total_cases AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "case_barcode") AS n_cases FROM "TCGA_MITELMAN"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."COPY_NUMBER_SEGMENT_ALLELIC_HG38_GDC_R23" WHERE "project_short_name" = 'TCGA-BRCA'), overlaps /* Step 1: Compute overlap between each CNV segment and each cytoband, per case */ AS (SELECT cn."case_barcode", c."cytoband_name", c."hg38_start", c."hg38_stop", cn."copy_number", CAST((ABS(c."hg38_stop" - c."hg38_start") + ABS(cn."end_pos" - cn."start_pos") - ABS(c."hg38_stop" - cn."end_pos") - ABS(c."hg38_start" - cn."start_pos")) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 2.0 AS overlap_bp FROM "TCGA_MITELMAN"."PROD"."CYTOBANDS_HG38" AS c JOIN "TCGA_MITELMAN"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."COPY_NUMBER_SEGMENT_ALLELIC_HG38_GDC_R23" AS cn ON c."chromosome" = cn."chromosome" AND cn."start_pos" < c."hg38_stop" AND cn."end_pos" > c."hg38_start" WHERE cn."project_short_name" = 'TCGA-BRCA'), weighted_avg /* Step 2: Compute overlap-weighted average copy number per case, cytoband */ AS (SELECT "case_barcode", "cytoband_name", "hg38_start", "hg38_stop", CAST(SUM(overlap_bp * "copy_number") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(overlap_bp) AS weighted_avg_cn FROM overlaps WHERE overlap_bp > 0 GROUP BY "case_barcode", "cytoband_name", "hg38_start", "hg38_stop"), classified /* Step 3: Round to nearest integer and classify CNV type */ AS (SELECT "case_barcode", "cytoband_name", "hg38_start", "hg38_stop", ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) AS rounded_cn, CASE WHEN ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) = 0 THEN 'homodel' WHEN ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) = 1 THEN 'heterodel' WHEN ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) = 2 THEN 'normal' WHEN ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) = 3 THEN 'gain' WHEN ROUND(weighted_avg_cn, 0) >= 4 THEN 'amp' END AS cnv_type FROM weighted_avg) /* Step 4: Calculate frequency of each CNV type per cytoband */ SELECT cl."cytoband_name", cl."hg38_start", cl."hg38_stop", ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cnv_type = 'homodel' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.n_cases, 2) AS freq_homodel, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cnv_type = 'heterodel' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.n_cases, 2) AS freq_heterodel, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cnv_type = 'normal' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.n_cases, 2) AS freq_normal, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cnv_type = 'gain' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.n_cases, 2) AS freq_gain, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cnv_type = 'amp' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.n_cases, 2) AS freq_amp FROM classified AS cl CROSS JOIN total_cases AS tc GROUP BY cl."cytoband_name", cl."hg38_start", cl."hg38_stop", tc.n_cases ORDER BY cl."cytoband_name"

WITH user_upvotes AS (SELECT fmv."ToUserId" AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_upvotes FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGEVOTES" AS fmv WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fmv."VoteDate") = 2019 GROUP BY fmv."ToUserId"), avg_upvotes AS (SELECT AVG(total_upvotes) AS avg_val FROM user_upvotes) SELECT COALESCE(usr."UserName", usr."DisplayName") AS Username FROM user_upvotes AS u CROSS JOIN avg_upvotes AS a JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."USERS" AS usr ON u.user_id = usr."Id" ORDER BY ABS(u.total_upvotes - a.avg_val) ASC, COALESCE(usr."UserName", usr."DisplayName") ASC LIMIT 1

WITH top_drug_ny AS (SELECT "drug_name" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."PART_D_PRESCRIBER_2014" WHERE "nppes_provider_state" = 'NY' GROUP BY "drug_name" ORDER BY SUM("total_claim_count") DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "nppes_provider_state" AS STATE, SUM("total_claim_count") AS TOTAL_CLAIM_COUNT, SUM("total_drug_cost") AS TOTAL_DRUG_COST FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."PART_D_PRESCRIBER_2014" AS p JOIN top_drug_ny AS t ON p."drug_name" = t."drug_name" GROUP BY "nppes_provider_state" ORDER BY TOTAL_CLAIM_COUNT DESC LIMIT 5

WITH sample_cytoband_max AS (/* For each sample and cytoband on chr1 in TCGA-KIRC, get the max copy number */ SELECT c."cytoband_name", s."sample_barcode", MAX(s."copy_number") AS max_cn FROM "TCGA_MITELMAN"."PROD"."CYTOBANDS_HG38" AS c JOIN "TCGA_MITELMAN"."TCGA_VERSIONED"."COPY_NUMBER_SEGMENT_ALLELIC_HG38_GDC_R23" AS s ON s."chromosome" = c."chromosome" AND s."start_pos" < c."hg38_stop" AND s."end_pos" > c."hg38_start" WHERE c."chromosome" = 'chr1' AND s."project_short_name" = 'TCGA-KIRC' GROUP BY c."cytoband_name", s."sample_barcode"), classified AS (/* Classify each sample-cytoband by CNV category based on max copy number */ SELECT "cytoband_name", CASE WHEN max_cn >= 4 THEN 'amplification' WHEN max_cn = 3 THEN 'gain' WHEN max_cn = 1 THEN 'heterozygous_deletion' END AS cnv_category FROM sample_cytoband_max), freq_per_cytoband AS (/* Count frequency of each CNV category per cytoband */ SELECT "cytoband_name", cnv_category, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM classified WHERE NOT cnv_category IS NULL GROUP BY "cytoband_name", cnv_category), ranked AS (/* Rank cytobands by frequency within each CNV category */ SELECT "cytoband_name", cnv_category, frequency, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cnv_category ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS rnk FROM freq_per_cytoband) /* Return cytobands where ALL 3 categories rank within top 11 */ SELECT "cytoband_name" FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 11 GROUP BY "cytoband_name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cnv_category) = 3 ORDER BY "cytoband_name"

WITH all_inpatient AS (SELECT 2011 AS year, "provider_id", "provider_name", "average_medicare_payments", "total_discharges" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2011" UNION ALL SELECT 2012, "provider_id", "provider_name", "average_medicare_payments", "total_discharges" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2012" UNION ALL SELECT 2013, "provider_id", "provider_name", "average_medicare_payments", "total_discharges" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2013" UNION ALL SELECT 2014, "provider_id", "provider_name", "average_medicare_payments", "total_discharges" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" UNION ALL SELECT 2015, "provider_id", "provider_name", "average_medicare_payments", "total_discharges" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2015"), all_outpatient AS (SELECT 2011 AS year, "provider_id", "average_total_payments", "outpatient_services" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2011" UNION ALL SELECT 2012, "provider_id", "average_total_payments", "outpatient_services" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2012" UNION ALL SELECT 2013, "provider_id", "average_total_payments", "outpatient_services" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2013" UNION ALL SELECT 2014, "provider_id", "average_total_payments", "outpatient_services" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" UNION ALL SELECT 2015, "provider_id", "average_total_payments", "outpatient_services" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2015"), top_provider /* Find the provider with highest total inpatient Medicare cost */ AS (SELECT "provider_id" FROM all_inpatient GROUP BY "provider_id" ORDER BY SUM("average_medicare_payments" * "total_discharges") DESC LIMIT 1), inpatient_yearly /* Yearly average inpatient cost for the top provider */ AS (SELECT i.year AS YEAR, i."provider_id" AS PROVIDER_ID, i."provider_name" AS PROVIDER_NAME, AVG(i."average_medicare_payments" * i."total_discharges") AS AVG_INPATIENT_COST FROM all_inpatient AS i JOIN top_provider AS t ON i."provider_id" = t."provider_id" GROUP BY i.year, i."provider_id", i."provider_name"), outpatient_yearly /* Yearly average outpatient cost for the top provider */ AS (SELECT o.year AS YEAR, o."provider_id" AS PROVIDER_ID, AVG(o."average_total_payments" * o."outpatient_services") AS AVG_OUTPATIENT_COST FROM all_outpatient AS o JOIN top_provider AS t ON o."provider_id" = t."provider_id" GROUP BY o.year, o."provider_id") SELECT ip.YEAR, ip.PROVIDER_ID, ip.PROVIDER_NAME, ip.AVG_INPATIENT_COST, op.AVG_OUTPATIENT_COST FROM inpatient_yearly AS ip JOIN outpatient_yearly AS op ON ip.PROVIDER_ID = op.PROVIDER_ID AND ip.YEAR = op.YEAR ORDER BY ip.YEAR

WITH python_imports AS (SELECT COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRIM(LEADING ' 	' FROM CAST(f.value AS TEXT)), '^import\s+(\w+)', 1, 1, 'e', 0), REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRIM(LEADING ' 	' FROM CAST(f.value AS TEXT)), '^from\s+(\w+)', 1, 1, 'e', 0)) AS module_name FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_CONTENTS", LATERAL UNNEST(input => SPLIT("content", '
')) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE LOWER("sample_path") LIKE '%.py' AND (TRIM(LEADING ' 	' FROM CAST(f.value AS TEXT)) LIKE 'import %' OR TRIM(LEADING ' 	' FROM CAST(f.value AS TEXT)) LIKE 'from %')), r_imports AS (SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(f.value AS TEXT), 'library\((\w+)', 1, 1, 'e', 0) AS module_name FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_CONTENTS", LATERAL UNNEST(input => SPLIT("content", '
')) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE LOWER("sample_path") LIKE '%.r' AND CAST(f.value AS TEXT) LIKE '%library(%'), all_imports AS (SELECT module_name FROM python_imports WHERE NOT module_name IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT module_name FROM r_imports WHERE NOT module_name IS NULL) SELECT module_name, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM all_imports GROUP BY module_name ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 5

WITH station_valid_days AS (SELECT "stn", SUM(CASE WHEN NOT "temp" IS NULL AND "temp" <> 9999.9 AND NOT "max" IS NULL AND "max" <> 9999.9 AND NOT "min" IS NULL AND "min" <> 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_day_count FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2022" WHERE "stn" <> '999999' GROUP BY "stn"), qualifying_stations AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_qualifying FROM station_valid_days WHERE valid_day_count >= 0.9 * 365), total_stations AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_total FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" WHERE "usaf" <> '999999') SELECT CAST(q.num_qualifying * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.num_total AS percentage_of_stations_with_90_percent_coverage FROM qualifying_stations AS q, total_stations AS t

WITH date_spine AS (SELECT CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) - 1) AS "DATE" FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(1826))), daily_counts AS (SELECT CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) AS dt, SUM(CASE WHEN "trace_address" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS external_daily, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT "trace_address" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contract_daily FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" WHERE "trace_type" = 'create' AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY dt) SELECT d."DATE", COALESCE(dc.external_daily, 0) AS "EXTERNAL_DAILY", COALESCE(dc.contract_daily, 0) AS "CONTRACT_DAILY", SUM(COALESCE(dc.external_daily, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d."DATE" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "EXTERNAL_CUMULATIVE", SUM(COALESCE(dc.contract_daily, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d."DATE" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "CONTRACT_CUMULATIVE" FROM date_spine AS d LEFT JOIN daily_counts AS dc ON d."DATE" = dc.dt ORDER BY d."DATE"

SELECT AVG(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."dropoff_datetime" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) / POWER(10, 6)) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) / POWER(10, 6)) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT)) AS AVG_DURATION FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TLC_YELLOW_TRIPS_2016" AS t JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS pz ON t."pickup_location_id" = pz."zone_id" JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_ZONE_GEOM" AS dz ON t."dropoff_location_id" = dz."zone_id" WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) / POWER(10, 6)) >= '2016-02-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."pickup_datetime" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) / POWER(10, 6)) < '2016-02-08' AND t."dropoff_datetime" > t."pickup_datetime" AND t."passenger_count" > 3 AND t."trip_distance" >= 10 AND pz."borough" = 'Brooklyn' AND dz."borough" = 'Brooklyn'

WITH trip_data AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("start_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000), 'YYYYMM') AS YEAR_MONTH, "start_date", "duration_sec" FROM "SAN_FRANCISCO"."SAN_FRANCISCO"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS"), month_bounds AS (SELECT YEAR_MONTH, MIN("start_date") AS first_start, MAX("start_date") AS last_start, MAX("duration_sec") AS highest_dur, MIN("duration_sec") AS lowest_dur FROM trip_data GROUP BY YEAR_MONTH), first_trips AS (SELECT t.YEAR_MONTH, MAX(t."duration_sec") AS first_dur FROM trip_data AS t JOIN month_bounds AS m ON t.YEAR_MONTH = m.YEAR_MONTH AND t."start_date" = m.first_start GROUP BY t.YEAR_MONTH), last_trips AS (SELECT t.YEAR_MONTH, MIN(t."duration_sec") AS last_dur FROM trip_data AS t JOIN month_bounds AS m ON t.YEAR_MONTH = m.YEAR_MONTH AND t."start_date" = m.last_start GROUP BY t.YEAR_MONTH) SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(f.first_dur AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL), 6) AS FIRST_TRIP_DURATION_MINUTES, ROUND(CAST(CAST(l.last_dur AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL), 6) AS LAST_TRIP_DURATION_MINUTES, ROUND(CAST(CAST(m.highest_dur AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL), 6) AS HIGHEST_TRIP_DURATION_MINUTES, ROUND(CAST(CAST(m.lowest_dur AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL), 6) AS LOWEST_TRIP_DURATION_MINUTES, m.YEAR_MONTH FROM month_bounds AS m JOIN first_trips AS f ON m.YEAR_MONTH = f.YEAR_MONTH JOIN last_trips AS l ON m.YEAR_MONTH = l.YEAR_MONTH ORDER BY m.YEAR_MONTH

/* Step 1: Find the category with the highest total purchase quantity */ WITH top_category AS (SELECT p."category" AS TOP_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS total_purchase_quantity FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" GROUP BY p."category" ORDER BY total_purchase_quantity DESC LIMIT 1), events_with_next /* Step 2: Add next event timestamp using LEAD window function */ AS (SELECT "session_id", "event_type", "uri", "created_at", "sequence_number", LEAD("created_at") OVER (PARTITION BY "session_id" ORDER BY "sequence_number") AS next_event_time FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."EVENTS"), product_page_times /* Step 3: Calculate time on page for product views in the top category */ AS (SELECT CAST((e.next_event_time - e."created_at") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60000000.0 AS time_on_page_minutes FROM events_with_next AS e JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON CAST(SPLIT_PART(e."uri", '/', 3) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) = p."id" JOIN top_category AS tc ON p."category" = tc.TOP_CATEGORY WHERE e."event_type" = 'product' AND NOT e.next_event_time IS NULL) /* Step 4: Return the top category and its average page visit time */ SELECT tc.TOP_CATEGORY, ROUND(CAST(AVG(ppt.time_on_page_minutes) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS AVG_MINUTES_SPENT FROM product_page_times AS ppt CROSS JOIN top_category AS tc GROUP BY tc.TOP_CATEGORY

WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT p."category", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o."order_id") AS unique_orders FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" AS o JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON o."order_id" = oi."order_id" JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE o."status" = 'Complete' GROUP BY p."category", month), order_growth_rates AS (SELECT "category", month, unique_orders, LAG(unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY "category" ORDER BY month) AS prev_orders, CASE WHEN LAG(unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY "category" ORDER BY month) > 0 THEN CAST((unique_orders - LAG(unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY "category" ORDER BY month)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / LAG(unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY "category" ORDER BY month) ELSE NULL END AS pct_growth FROM monthly_orders), avg_order_growth AS (SELECT "category", AVG(pct_growth) AS avg_order_growth_rate FROM order_growth_rates WHERE NOT pct_growth IS NULL GROUP BY "category"), top_category AS (SELECT "category" FROM avg_order_growth ORDER BY avg_order_growth_rate DESC LIMIT 1), monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS month, SUM(oi."sale_price") AS total_revenue FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" AS o JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON o."order_id" = oi."order_id" JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE o."status" = 'Complete' AND p."category" = (SELECT "category" FROM top_category) GROUP BY month), revenue_growth AS (SELECT month, total_revenue, LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue, CASE WHEN LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) > 0 THEN CAST((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) ELSE NULL END AS pct_growth FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT (SELECT "category" FROM top_category) AS category, (SELECT avg_order_growth_rate FROM avg_order_growth WHERE "category" = (SELECT "category" FROM top_category)) AS avg_order_growth_rate, AVG(pct_growth) AS avg_monthly_revenue_growth_rate FROM revenue_growth WHERE NOT pct_growth IS NULL

WITH python_repos AS (SELECT DISTINCT "repo_name" FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_FILES" WHERE "ref" = 'refs/heads/master' AND "path" LIKE '%.py'), licensed_repos AS (SELECT DISTINCT "repo_name" FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."GITHUB_REPOS"."LICENSES" WHERE "license" IN ('artistic-2.0', 'isc', 'mit', 'apache-2.0')), watches AS (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("repo", 'name') AS TEXT) AS repo_name, COUNT(*) AS watch_count FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."MONTH"."_202204" WHERE "type" = 'WatchEvent' GROUP BY 1), issues AS (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("repo", 'name') AS TEXT) AS repo_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."MONTH"."_202204" WHERE "type" = 'IssuesEvent' GROUP BY 1), forks AS (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("repo", 'name') AS TEXT) AS repo_name, COUNT(*) AS fork_count FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."MONTH"."_202204" WHERE "type" = 'ForkEvent' GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.repo_name AS REPO_NAME, COALESCE(f.fork_count, 0) + COALESCE(i.issue_count, 0) + COALESCE(w.watch_count, 0) AS TOTAL_ACTIVITY FROM watches AS w LEFT JOIN issues AS i ON w.repo_name = i.repo_name LEFT JOIN forks AS f ON w.repo_name = f.repo_name INNER JOIN python_repos AS p ON w.repo_name = p."repo_name" INNER JOIN licensed_repos AS l ON w.repo_name = l."repo_name" ORDER BY TOTAL_ACTIVITY DESC LIMIT 1

WITH python_import_lines AS (SELECT TRIM(line.VALUE) AS line_content FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS AS sc, LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(sc."content", '
') AS line WHERE sc."binary" = FALSE AND (sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.py' OR sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.ipynb') AND (TRIM(line.VALUE) LIKE 'import %' OR TRIM(line.VALUE) LIKE 'from %import%')), parsed_python_imports AS (SELECT CASE WHEN line_content LIKE 'import %' AND NOT line_content LIKE 'from %' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(line_content, 'import\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)) WHEN line_content LIKE 'from %import%' THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(line_content, 'from ', 2), ' import', 1)) ELSE NULL END AS module_name FROM python_import_lines), r_import_lines AS (SELECT TRIM(line.VALUE) AS line_content FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS AS sc, LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(sc."content", '
') AS line WHERE sc."binary" = FALSE AND (sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.r' OR sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.R' OR sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.Rmd' OR sc."sample_path" LIKE '%.rmd') AND (TRIM(line.VALUE) LIKE '%library(%' OR TRIM(line.VALUE) LIKE '%require(%')), parsed_r_imports AS (SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(line_content, '(library|require)\s*\(\s*[\"'']*([a-zA-Z0-9._]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 2) AS module_name FROM r_import_lines), all_imports AS (SELECT module_name FROM parsed_python_imports WHERE NOT module_name IS NULL AND module_name <> '' UNION ALL SELECT module_name FROM parsed_r_imports WHERE NOT module_name IS NULL AND module_name <> ''), import_counts AS (SELECT module_name AS LIBRARY_OR_MODULE, COUNT(*) AS TIMES_IMPORTED_OR_LOADED FROM all_imports GROUP BY module_name), ranked AS (SELECT LIBRARY_OR_MODULE, TIMES_IMPORTED_OR_LOADED, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TIMES_IMPORTED_OR_LOADED DESC) AS rn FROM import_counts) SELECT LIBRARY_OR_MODULE, TIMES_IMPORTED_OR_LOADED FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2

WITH trace_values AS (/* Get value flows from successful traces with call_type IS NULL or 'call' */ /* before Sept 1, 2021 */ SELECT "to_address" AS address, CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS value_in, 0 AS value_out FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" WHERE "status" = 1 AND ("call_type" IS NULL OR "call_type" = 'call') AND "block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000 AND NOT "to_address" IS NULL AND "value" > 0 UNION ALL SELECT "from_address" AS address, 0 AS value_in, CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS value_out FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" WHERE "status" = 1 AND ("call_type" IS NULL OR "call_type" = 'call') AND "block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000 AND NOT "from_address" IS NULL AND "value" > 0), gas_fees AS (/* Gas fees are charged to the transaction sender (from_address) */ SELECT "from_address" AS address, CAST("gas_price" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) * CAST("receipt_gas_used" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS gas_fee FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS" WHERE "block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000 AND "receipt_status" = 1), balance_calc AS (SELECT address, SUM(value_in) - SUM(value_out) AS net_value FROM trace_values GROUP BY address), gas_calc AS (SELECT address, SUM(gas_fee) AS total_gas FROM gas_fees GROUP BY address), final_balance AS (SELECT COALESCE(b.address, g.address) AS ADDRESS, COALESCE(b.net_value, 0) - COALESCE(g.total_gas, 0) AS BALANCE FROM balance_calc AS b FULL OUTER JOIN gas_calc AS g ON b.address = g.address) SELECT ADDRESS, CAST(BALANCE AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS BALANCE FROM final_balance ORDER BY BALANCE DESC LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_product_sales AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)), 'YYYY-MM') AS "MONTH", p."name" AS "PRODUCT_NAME", p."brand" AS "BRAND", p."category" AS "CATEGORY", COUNT(*) AS "TOTAL_SALES", ROUND(SUM(oi."sale_price"), 2) AS "TOTAL_REVENUE", o."status" AS "ORDER_STATUS" FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" AS o ON oi."order_id" = o."order_id" JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE o."status" = 'Complete' AND NOT p."brand" IS NULL AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)), 'YYYY-MM'), p."name", p."brand", p."category", o."status"), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MONTH" ORDER BY "TOTAL_SALES" DESC, "TOTAL_REVENUE" DESC) AS rn FROM monthly_product_sales) SELECT "MONTH", "PRODUCT_NAME", "BRAND", "CATEGORY", "TOTAL_SALES", "TOTAL_REVENUE", "ORDER_STATUS" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "MONTH"

WITH max_wins_per_season AS (SELECT "season", MAX("wins") AS max_wins FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TEAMS_SEASONS" WHERE "season" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000 GROUP BY "season"), teams_with_max_wins AS (SELECT t."market" AS TEAM_NAME, t."season" FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TEAMS_SEASONS" AS t JOIN max_wins_per_season AS m ON t."season" = m."season" AND t."wins" = m.max_wins WHERE NOT t."market" IS NULL) SELECT TEAM_NAME, COUNT(*) AS TOP_PERFORMER_COUNT FROM teams_with_max_wins GROUP BY TEAM_NAME ORDER BY TOP_PERFORMER_COUNT DESC, TEAM_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

WITH per_liter_prices AS (SELECT "category_name", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") AS sale_year, CAST("state_bottle_retail" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (CAST("bottle_volume_ml" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000.0) AS per_liter_retail_price FROM "IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES"."IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES"."SALES" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") IN (2019, 2020, 2021) AND NOT "category_name" IS NULL AND "bottle_volume_ml" > 0), top10_2021 AS (SELECT "category_name", AVG(per_liter_retail_price) AS avg_price_2021 FROM per_liter_prices WHERE sale_year = 2021 GROUP BY "category_name" ORDER BY avg_price_2021 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t."category_name" AS category, AVG(CASE WHEN p.sale_year = 2019 THEN p.per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_price_liter_2019, AVG(CASE WHEN p.sale_year = 2020 THEN p.per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_price_liter_2020, AVG(CASE WHEN p.sale_year = 2021 THEN p.per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_price_liter_2021 FROM top10_2021 AS t LEFT JOIN per_liter_prices AS p ON t."category_name" = p."category_name" GROUP BY t."category_name" ORDER BY avg_price_liter_2021 DESC

WITH all_pitches AS (/* Regular season */ SELECT g."gameId", g."pitcherId", g."pitcherFirstName", g."pitcherLastName", g."pitchSpeed", CASE WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."homeFielder1", g."homeFielder2", g."homeFielder3", g."homeFielder4", g."homeFielder5", g."homeFielder6", g."homeFielder7", g."homeFielder8", g."homeFielder9", g."homeFielder10", g."homeFielder11", g."homeFielder12") THEN s."homeTeamId" WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."awayFielder1", g."awayFielder2", g."awayFielder3", g."awayFielder4", g."awayFielder5", g."awayFielder6", g."awayFielder7", g."awayFielder8", g."awayFielder9", g."awayFielder10", g."awayFielder11", g."awayFielder12") THEN s."awayTeamId" END AS team_id, CASE WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."homeFielder1", g."homeFielder2", g."homeFielder3", g."homeFielder4", g."homeFielder5", g."homeFielder6", g."homeFielder7", g."homeFielder8", g."homeFielder9", g."homeFielder10", g."homeFielder11", g."homeFielder12") THEN s."homeTeamName" WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."awayFielder1", g."awayFielder2", g."awayFielder3", g."awayFielder4", g."awayFielder5", g."awayFielder6", g."awayFielder7", g."awayFielder8", g."awayFielder9", g."awayFielder10", g."awayFielder11", g."awayFielder12") THEN s."awayTeamName" END AS team_name FROM "MLB"."BASEBALL"."GAMES_WIDE" AS g INNER JOIN "MLB"."BASEBALL"."SCHEDULES" AS s ON g."gameId" = s."gameId" WHERE g."pitchSpeed" > 0 UNION ALL /* Post season */ SELECT g."gameId", g."pitcherId", g."pitcherFirstName", g."pitcherLastName", g."pitchSpeed", CASE WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."homeFielder1", g."homeFielder2", g."homeFielder3", g."homeFielder4", g."homeFielder5", g."homeFielder6", g."homeFielder7", g."homeFielder8", g."homeFielder9", g."homeFielder10", g."homeFielder11", g."homeFielder12") THEN s."homeTeamId" WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."awayFielder1", g."awayFielder2", g."awayFielder3", g."awayFielder4", g."awayFielder5", g."awayFielder6", g."awayFielder7", g."awayFielder8", g."awayFielder9", g."awayFielder10", g."awayFielder11", g."awayFielder12") THEN s."awayTeamId" END AS team_id, CASE WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."homeFielder1", g."homeFielder2", g."homeFielder3", g."homeFielder4", g."homeFielder5", g."homeFielder6", g."homeFielder7", g."homeFielder8", g."homeFielder9", g."homeFielder10", g."homeFielder11", g."homeFielder12") THEN s."homeTeamName" WHEN g."pitcherId" IN (g."awayFielder1", g."awayFielder2", g."awayFielder3", g."awayFielder4", g."awayFielder5", g."awayFielder6", g."awayFielder7", g."awayFielder8", g."awayFielder9", g."awayFielder10", g."awayFielder11", g."awayFielder12") THEN s."awayTeamName" END AS team_name FROM "MLB"."BASEBALL"."GAMES_POST_WIDE" AS g INNER JOIN "MLB"."BASEBALL"."SCHEDULES" AS s ON g."gameId" = s."gameId" WHERE g."pitchSpeed" > 0), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM all_pitches WHERE NOT team_id IS NULL AND NOT team_name IN ('American League', 'National League')), ranked AS (SELECT team_id AS "teamId", team_name AS "teamName", "pitcherId", "pitcherFirstName", "pitcherLastName", "pitchSpeed" AS "maxPitchSpeed", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY "pitchSpeed" DESC, "pitcherId" ASC) AS rn FROM filtered) SELECT "teamId", "teamName", "pitcherId", "pitcherFirstName", "pitcherLastName", "maxPitchSpeed" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "teamName"

WITH trips_2018 AS (SELECT "start_station_id", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS start_ts FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE"."CITIBIKE_TRIPS" WHERE NOT "starttime" IS NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2018), top_station AS (SELECT "start_station_id" FROM trips_2018 GROUP BY "start_station_id" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1), station_trips AS (SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK(t.start_ts) AS DAY_OF_WEEK, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.start_ts) AS HOUR_OF_DAY, COUNT(*) AS TRIP_COUNT FROM trips_2018 AS t JOIN top_station AS ts ON t."start_station_id" = ts."start_station_id" GROUP BY DAY_OF_WEEK, HOUR_OF_DAY) SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK, HOUR_OF_DAY, TRIP_COUNT FROM station_trips ORDER BY TRIP_COUNT DESC LIMIT 1

WITH total_stations AS (SELECT "borough_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "station_lat" || '|' || "station_lon") AS TOTAL_STATIONS FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_SUBWAY"."STATIONS" GROUP BY "borough_name"), ada_stations AS (SELECT s."borough_name", COUNT(DISTINCT s."station_lat" || '|' || s."station_lon") AS ADA_STATION_COUNT FROM "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_SUBWAY"."STATIONS" AS s JOIN "NEW_YORK_PLUS"."NEW_YORK_SUBWAY"."STATION_ENTRANCES" AS e ON s."station_name" = e."station_name" WHERE e."entry" = TRUE AND e."ada_compliant" = TRUE GROUP BY s."borough_name") SELECT t."borough_name", COALESCE(a.ADA_STATION_COUNT, 0) AS ADA_STATION_COUNT, t.TOTAL_STATIONS, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(a.ADA_STATION_COUNT, 0) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.TOTAL_STATIONS, 2) AS PERCENTAGE FROM total_stations AS t LEFT JOIN ada_stations AS a ON t."borough_name" = a."borough_name" ORDER BY PERCENTAGE DESC

WITH earliest_pub AS (SELECT "application_number", "publication_number", "publication_date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "application_number" ORDER BY "publication_date" ASC) AS rn FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS") SELECT ep."application_number" AS "APPLN_NR", ep."publication_number" AS "PUBLN_NR", cs."claim_no", cs."word_ct" FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_CLAIMS"."PATENT_CLAIMS_STATS" AS cs JOIN "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_CLAIMS"."MATCH" AS m ON cs."pat_no" = m."pat_no" JOIN earliest_pub AS ep ON m."publication_number" = ep."publication_number" WHERE cs."ind_flg" = 1 AND ep.rn = 1 ORDER BY CAST(cs."word_ct" AS INT) DESC LIMIT 100

WITH nearby_stations AS (SELECT "usaf", "wban" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" WHERE NOT "lat" IS NULL AND NOT "lon" IS NULL AND HAVERSINE(41.197, -73.764, "lat", "lon") <= 32.187), all_observations AS (SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2011" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2012" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2013" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2014" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2015" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2016" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2017" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2018" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2019" UNION ALL SELECT "stn", "wban", "temp" FROM "NEW_YORK_NOAA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2020") SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Data_Points" FROM all_observations AS o INNER JOIN nearby_stations AS s ON o."stn" = s."usaf" AND o."wban" = s."wban" WHERE o."temp" <> 9999.9 AND NOT o."temp" IS NULL GROUP BY o."stn", o."wban" ORDER BY "Data_Points" DESC

/* Among patents granted between 2010 and 2023 in CN, */ /* how many of them belong to families that have a total of over one distinct applications? */ WITH multi_app_families AS (/* Find families with more than 1 distinct application (global scope) */ SELECT "family_id" FROM "PATENTS"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" GROUP BY "family_id" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "application_number") > 1) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "OUTPUT" FROM "PATENTS"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p INNER JOIN multi_app_families AS f ON p."family_id" = f."family_id" WHERE p."country_code" = 'CN' AND FLOOR(CAST(p."grant_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 10000) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023

WITH ipc_expanded AS (SELECT p."publication_number", SUBSTRING(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'code') AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS IPC4 FROM "PATENTS"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p, LATERAL UNNEST(input => p."ipc") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE p."country_code" = 'US' AND p."kind_code" = 'B2' AND p."grant_date" BETWEEN 20220601 AND 20220930), ipc_counts AS (SELECT "publication_number", IPC4, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ipc_expanded GROUP BY "publication_number", IPC4), ranked AS (SELECT "publication_number", IPC4, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "publication_number" ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM ipc_counts) SELECT "publication_number" AS publication_number, IPC4 FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND cnt >= 10 ORDER BY "publication_number"

/* Step 1: Identify US B2 utility patents granted 2010-2014 */ WITH target_patents AS (SELECT p."publication_number", p."filing_date", p."grant_date" FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p WHERE p."country_code" = 'US' AND p."kind_code" = 'B2' AND FLOOR(CAST(p."grant_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 10000) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014), forward_citation_counts /* Step 2: Count forward citations within a month of filing date */ /* Forward citations = other patents in PUBLICATIONS whose citation array references the target patent */ /* "Within a month" = citing patent's filing_date within 30 days of target patent's filing_date */ AS (SELECT t."publication_number" AS focal_pub, t."filing_date" AS focal_filing_date, t."grant_date" AS focal_grant_date, COUNT(*) AS citation_count FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PUBLICATIONS" AS citing, LATERAL UNNEST(input => citing."citation") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) JOIN target_patents AS t ON CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'publication_number') AS TEXT) = t."publication_number" WHERE citing."filing_date" > 0 AND ABS((CAST(CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(citing."filing_date" AS VARCHAR), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) AS DATE) - CAST(CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."filing_date" AS VARCHAR), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) AS DATE))) <= 30 GROUP BY t."publication_number", t."filing_date", t."grant_date"), top_patent /* Step 3: Find the patent with the most forward citations (tiebreak by grant_date ASC) */ AS (SELECT focal_pub, focal_filing_date, citation_count FROM forward_citation_counts ORDER BY citation_count DESC, focal_grant_date ASC LIMIT 1), target_emb /* Step 4: Get the top patent's embedding */ AS (SELECT a."embedding_v1" FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."ABS_AND_EMB" AS a JOIN top_patent AS tp ON a."publication_number" = tp.focal_pub), candidates /* Step 5: Find all candidate patents from the same filing year (regardless of type) */ AS (SELECT a."publication_number", a."embedding_v1" FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."ABS_AND_EMB" AS a JOIN "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p ON a."publication_number" = p."publication_number" JOIN top_patent AS tp ON 1 = 1 WHERE FLOOR(CAST(p."filing_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 10000) = FLOOR(CAST(tp.focal_filing_date AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 10000) AND a."publication_number" <> tp.focal_pub AND ARRAY_LENGTH(a."embedding_v1", 1) = 64), dot_products /* Step 6: Compute dot product similarity */ AS (SELECT c."publication_number", SUM(CAST(te.value AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(ce.value AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS similarity FROM candidates AS c, target_emb AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."embedding_v1") AS te(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => c."embedding_v1") AS ce(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE te.index = ce.index GROUP BY c."publication_number"), most_similar /* Step 7: Find the most similar patent */ AS (SELECT "publication_number" AS similar_patent, similarity FROM dot_products ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT 1) /* Final result */ SELECT tp.focal_pub, tp.citation_count, ms.similar_patent FROM top_patent AS tp CROSS JOIN most_similar AS ms

WITH backward_citations AS (/* Get all backward citations for US B2 patents with grant date 2015-2018 */ SELECT p1."publication_number" AS citing_patent, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'publication_number') AS TEXT) AS cited_patent FROM "PATENTS"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p1, LATERAL UNNEST(input => p1."citation") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE p1."country_code" = 'US' AND p1."kind_code" = 'B2' AND p1."grant_date" >= 20150101 AND p1."grant_date" <= 20181231 AND NOT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'publication_number') AS TEXT) IS NULL AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'publication_number') AS TEXT) <> ''), cited_ipc_counts AS (/* For each cited patent, count frequency of each 4-digit IPC code */ SELECT bc.citing_patent, bc.cited_patent, SUBSTRING(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(ipc.value, 'code') AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS ipc_4digit, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM backward_citations AS bc JOIN "PATENTS"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p2 ON bc.cited_patent = p2."publication_number", LATERAL UNNEST(input => p2."ipc") AS ipc(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) GROUP BY bc.citing_patent, bc.cited_patent, SUBSTRING(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(ipc.value, 'code') AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)), cited_main_class AS (/* Assign each cited patent its main (most frequent) 4-digit IPC class */ SELECT citing_patent, cited_patent, ipc_4digit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY citing_patent, cited_patent ORDER BY freq DESC, ipc_4digit ASC) AS rn FROM cited_ipc_counts), cited_with_class AS (SELECT citing_patent, cited_patent, ipc_4digit AS main_class FROM cited_main_class WHERE rn = 1), class_counts AS (/* Count number of cited patents per class per citing patent */ SELECT citing_patent, main_class, COUNT(*) AS ncited_k FROM cited_with_class GROUP BY citing_patent, main_class), total_counts AS (/* Total cited patents per citing patent */ SELECT citing_patent, SUM(ncited_k) AS ncited_i FROM class_counts GROUP BY citing_patent), originality AS (SELECT cc.citing_patent, 1.0 - SUM(POWER(CAST(cc.ncited_k AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(tc.ncited_i AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 2)) AS originality_score FROM class_counts AS cc JOIN total_counts AS tc ON cc.citing_patent = tc.citing_patent GROUP BY cc.citing_patent, tc.ncited_i) SELECT citing_patent AS PUBLICATION_NUMBER, originality_score AS ORIGINALITY FROM originality ORDER BY originality_score DESC, citing_patent ASC LIMIT 1

WITH js_repos AS (SELECT DISTINCT l."repo_name" FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."GITHUB_REPOS"."LANGUAGES" AS l, LATERAL UNNEST(input => l."language") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'name') AS TEXT) = 'JavaScript') SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_PULL_REQUESTS FROM "GITHUB_REPOS_DATE"."DAY"."_20230118" AS e JOIN js_repos AS j ON CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(e."repo", 'name') AS TEXT) = j."repo_name" WHERE e."type" = 'PullRequestEvent' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(CAST(e."payload" AS JSON), 'action') AS TEXT) = 'opened'

WITH yearly_revenue AS (SELECT "item_number", "item_description", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") AS sale_year, SUM("sale_dollars") AS total_revenue FROM "IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES"."IOWA_LIQUOR_SALES"."SALES" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") IN (2022, 2023) GROUP BY "item_number", "item_description", sale_year), item_revenue AS (SELECT "item_number", ANY_VALUE("item_description") AS ITEM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS REVENUE_2022, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS REVENUE_2023 FROM yearly_revenue GROUP BY "item_number") SELECT "item_number", ITEM_DESCRIPTION, REVENUE_2022, REVENUE_2023, CAST((REVENUE_2023 - REVENUE_2022) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / REVENUE_2022 * 100 AS YOY_GROWTH_PCT FROM item_revenue WHERE REVENUE_2022 > 0 AND REVENUE_2023 > 0 ORDER BY YOY_GROWTH_PCT DESC LIMIT 5

WITH joined AS (SELECT c."state_code", c."state_code_name", c."inventory_year", c."proportion_basis", c."condition_proportion_unadjusted" AS P, p."expansion_factor" AS E, p."adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot" AS A_s, p."adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot" AS A_m FROM "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."CONDITION" AS c JOIN "USFS_FIA"."USFS_FIA"."POPULATION" AS p ON c."plot_sequence_number" = p."plot_sequence_number" AND c."state_code" = p."state_code" AND c."inventory_year" = p."inventory_year" AND c."county_code" = p."county_code" WHERE p."evaluation_type" = 'EXPCURR' AND c."condition_status_code" = 1 AND c."inventory_year" IN (2015, 2016, 2017)), subplot_avg AS (SELECT "inventory_year", "state_code", "state_code_name", AVG(E * P * A_s) AS AVG_SIZE FROM joined WHERE "proportion_basis" = 'SUBP' GROUP BY "inventory_year", "state_code", "state_code_name"), macroplot_avg AS (SELECT "inventory_year", "state_code", "state_code_name", AVG(E * P * A_m) AS AVG_SIZE FROM joined WHERE "proportion_basis" = 'MACR' GROUP BY "inventory_year", "state_code", "state_code_name"), subplot_max AS (SELECT 'SUBPLOT' AS PLOT_TYPE, s."inventory_year" AS INVENTORY_YEAR, s."state_code", s."state_code_name", s.AVG_SIZE FROM subplot_avg AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT "inventory_year", MAX(AVG_SIZE) AS max_size FROM subplot_avg GROUP BY "inventory_year") AS mx ON s."inventory_year" = mx."inventory_year" AND s.AVG_SIZE = mx.max_size), macroplot_max AS (SELECT 'MACROPLOT' AS PLOT_TYPE, m."inventory_year" AS INVENTORY_YEAR, m."state_code", m."state_code_name", m.AVG_SIZE FROM macroplot_avg AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT "inventory_year", MAX(AVG_SIZE) AS max_size FROM macroplot_avg GROUP BY "inventory_year") AS mx ON m."inventory_year" = mx."inventory_year" AND m.AVG_SIZE = mx.max_size) SELECT * FROM macroplot_max UNION ALL SELECT * FROM subplot_max ORDER BY PLOT_TYPE, INVENTORY_YEAR

WITH file_extensions AS (SELECT sf."id", sf."path", CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN sf."path") > 0 THEN LOWER(REVERSE(SPLIT_PART(REVERSE(sf."path"), '.', 1))) ELSE NULL END AS ext, CASE WHEN sf."path" LIKE '%/Dockerfile' OR sf."path" = 'Dockerfile' THEN 'Dockerfile' ELSE NULL END AS dockerfile_match FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_FILES" AS sf JOIN "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_CONTENTS" AS sc ON sf."id" = sc."id" WHERE NOT sc."content" IS NULL), language_mapping AS (SELECT CASE WHEN dockerfile_match = 'Dockerfile' THEN 'Dockerfile' WHEN ext IN ('asm', 'nasm') THEN 'Assembly' WHEN ext IN ('c', 'h') THEN 'C' WHEN ext = 'cs' THEN 'C#' WHEN ext IN ('c++', 'cpp', 'h++', 'hpp') THEN 'C++' WHEN ext = 'css' THEN 'CSS' WHEN ext = 'clj' THEN 'Clojure' WHEN ext = 'lisp' THEN 'Common Lisp' WHEN ext = 'd' THEN 'D' WHEN ext = 'dart' THEN 'Dart' WHEN ext = 'dockerfile' THEN 'Dockerfile' WHEN ext IN ('ex', 'exs') THEN 'Elixir' WHEN ext = 'erl' THEN 'Erlang' WHEN ext = 'go' THEN 'Go' WHEN ext = 'groovy' THEN 'Groovy' WHEN ext IN ('html', 'htm') THEN 'HTML' WHEN ext = 'hs' THEN 'Haskell' WHEN ext = 'hx' THEN 'Haxe' WHEN ext = 'json' THEN 'JSON' WHEN ext = 'java' THEN 'Java' WHEN ext IN ('js', 'cjs') THEN 'JavaScript' WHEN ext = 'jl' THEN 'Julia' WHEN ext IN ('kt', 'ktm', 'kts') THEN 'Kotlin' WHEN ext = 'lua' THEN 'Lua' WHEN ext IN ('matlab', 'm') THEN 'MATLAB' WHEN ext IN ('md', 'markdown', 'mdown') THEN 'Markdown' WHEN ext = 'php' THEN 'PHP' WHEN ext IN ('ps1', 'psd1', 'psm1') THEN 'PowerShell' WHEN ext = 'py' THEN 'Python' WHEN ext = 'r' THEN 'R' WHEN ext = 'rb' THEN 'Ruby' WHEN ext = 'rs' THEN 'Rust' WHEN ext = 'scss' THEN 'SCSS' WHEN ext = 'sql' THEN 'SQL' WHEN ext = 'sass' THEN 'Sass' WHEN ext = 'scala' THEN 'Scala' WHEN ext IN ('sh', 'bash') THEN 'Shell' WHEN ext = 'swift' THEN 'Swift' WHEN ext = 'ts' THEN 'TypeScript' WHEN ext = 'vue' THEN 'Vue' WHEN ext = 'xml' THEN 'XML' WHEN ext IN ('yml', 'yaml') THEN 'YAML' ELSE NULL END AS language FROM file_extensions) SELECT language FROM language_mapping WHERE NOT language IS NULL GROUP BY language ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, language ASC LIMIT 10
