SELECT 'https://cronoscan.com/address/' || t."from_address" AS OUTPUT FROM "GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN"."GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN_CRONOS_MAINNET_US"."TRANSACTIONS" AS t JOIN "GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN"."GOOG_BLOCKCHAIN_CRONOS_MAINNET_US"."BLOCKS" AS b ON t."block_hash" = b."block_hash" WHERE b."size" > 4096 AND t."block_timestamp" >= '2023-01-01' AND NOT t."to_address" IS NULL GROUP BY t."from_address" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH top5 AS (SELECT "minor_category", SUM("value") AS total_2008 FROM "LONDON"."LONDON_CRIME"."CRIME_BY_LSOA" WHERE "year" = 2008 GROUP BY "minor_category" ORDER BY total_2008 DESC LIMIT 5), top5_ranked AS (SELECT "minor_category", total_2008, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_2008 DESC) AS rn FROM top5), yearly_total AS (SELECT "year", SUM("value") AS total FROM "LONDON"."LONDON_CRIME"."CRIME_BY_LSOA" GROUP BY "year"), category_yearly AS (SELECT c."year", c."minor_category", SUM(c."value") AS cat_total FROM "LONDON"."LONDON_CRIME"."CRIME_BY_LSOA" AS c INNER JOIN top5 AS t ON c."minor_category" = t."minor_category" GROUP BY c."year", c."minor_category") SELECT cy."year", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.rn = 1 THEN CAST(cy.cat_total * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / yt.total END), 2) AS "Category 1", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.rn = 2 THEN CAST(cy.cat_total * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / yt.total END), 2) AS "Category 2", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.rn = 3 THEN CAST(cy.cat_total * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / yt.total END), 2) AS "Category 3", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.rn = 4 THEN CAST(cy.cat_total * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / yt.total END), 2) AS "Category 4", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.rn = 5 THEN CAST(cy.cat_total * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / yt.total END), 2) AS "Category 5" FROM category_yearly AS cy JOIN yearly_total AS yt ON cy."year" = yt."year" JOIN top5_ranked AS tr ON cy."minor_category" = tr."minor_category" GROUP BY cy."year" ORDER BY cy."year"

WITH cat_images AS (SELECT DISTINCT l."image_id" FROM "OPEN_IMAGES"."OPEN_IMAGES"."LABELS" AS l WHERE l."label_name" = '/m/01yrx' AND l."confidence" = 1), cat_urls AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i."original_url") AS url_count FROM "OPEN_IMAGES"."OPEN_IMAGES"."IMAGES" AS i INNER JOIN cat_images AS c ON i."image_id" = c."image_id"), all_cat_images AS (SELECT DISTINCT "image_id" FROM "OPEN_IMAGES"."OPEN_IMAGES"."LABELS" WHERE "label_name" = '/m/01yrx'), other_urls AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i."original_url") AS url_count FROM "OPEN_IMAGES"."OPEN_IMAGES"."IMAGES" AS i WHERE i."image_id" <> ALL (SELECT "image_id" FROM all_cat_images)) SELECT 'cat' AS CATEGORY, url_count AS URL_COUNT FROM cat_urls UNION ALL SELECT 'other' AS CATEGORY, url_count AS URL_COUNT FROM other_urls

WITH corn AS (SELECT "state_name", SUM("value") AS CORN_PRODUCTION FROM "USDA_NASS_AGRICULTURE"."USDA_NASS_AGRICULTURE"."CROPS" WHERE "commodity_desc" = 'CORN' AND "group_desc" = 'FIELD CROPS' AND "statisticcat_desc" = 'PRODUCTION' AND "agg_level_desc" = 'STATE' AND "unit_desc" = 'BU' AND "year" = 2022 AND NOT "value" IS NULL GROUP BY "state_name"), mushrooms AS (SELECT "state_name", SUM("value") AS MUSHROOM_PRODUCTION FROM "USDA_NASS_AGRICULTURE"."USDA_NASS_AGRICULTURE"."CROPS" WHERE "commodity_desc" = 'MUSHROOMS' AND "group_desc" = 'HORTICULTURE' AND "statisticcat_desc" = 'PRODUCTION' AND "agg_level_desc" = 'STATE' AND "year" = 2022 AND NOT "value" IS NULL GROUP BY "state_name") SELECT COALESCE(c."state_name", m."state_name") AS state_name, COALESCE(c.CORN_PRODUCTION, 0) AS CORN_PRODUCTION, COALESCE(m.MUSHROOM_PRODUCTION, 0) AS MUSHROOM_PRODUCTION FROM corn AS c FULL OUTER JOIN mushrooms AS m ON c."state_name" = m."state_name" ORDER BY state_name

SELECT "year", SUM("value") AS YEAR_TOTAL FROM "LONDON"."LONDON_CRIME"."CRIME_BY_LSOA" WHERE "borough" = 'Westminster' AND "major_category" = 'Theft and Handling' AND "minor_category" = 'Other Theft' GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

WITH inpatient_avg AS (SELECT "provider_id", "provider_name", AVG("average_total_payments") AS avg_inpatient_cost FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."INPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" GROUP BY "provider_id", "provider_name"), outpatient_avg AS (SELECT "provider_id", "provider_name", AVG("average_total_payments") AS avg_outpatient_cost FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_MEDICARE"."OUTPATIENT_CHARGES_2014" GROUP BY "provider_id", "provider_name") SELECT i."provider_name" AS "Provider_Name" FROM inpatient_avg AS i INNER JOIN outpatient_avg AS o ON i."provider_id" = o."provider_id" ORDER BY (i.avg_inpatient_cost + o.avg_outpatient_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH top_families AS (SELECT "family_id" FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PUBLICATIONS" WHERE "family_id" <> -1 GROUP BY "family_id" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT p."family_id", a."abstract" FROM "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p INNER JOIN "PATENTS_GOOGLE"."PATENTS_GOOGLE"."ABS_AND_EMB" AS a ON p."publication_number" = a."publication_number" INNER JOIN top_families AS tf ON p."family_id" = tf."family_id" WHERE NOT a."abstract" IS NULL AND TRIM(a."abstract") <> ''

WITH latest_versions AS (/* For packages with multiple versions, use only the most recent version based on upload time */ SELECT "name", "version", "project_urls", "upload_time", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "name" ORDER BY "upload_time" DESC) AS rn FROM "PYPI"."PYPI"."DISTRIBUTION_METADATA"), github_urls AS (/* Extract and clean GitHub URLs from project_urls array */ SELECT DISTINCT lv."name", REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(SUBSTRING(CAST(f.value AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(', ' IN CAST(f.value AS TEXT)) + 2)), '/(issues|pull|blob|tree)(/.*)?$', '', 'g') AS github_url FROM latest_versions AS lv, LATERAL UNNEST(input => lv."project_urls") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE lv.rn = 1 AND CAST(f.value AS TEXT) ILIKE '%github.com%'), downloads AS (/* Count downloads per project */ SELECT "project", COUNT(*) AS download_count FROM "PYPI"."PYPI"."FILE_DOWNLOADS" GROUP BY "project") SELECT g.github_url AS GITHUB_URL FROM github_urls AS g JOIN downloads AS d ON g."name" = d."project" WHERE NOT g.github_url IS NULL AND g.github_url <> '' ORDER BY d.download_count DESC LIMIT 3

/* Step 1: Get Q1095 geometry */ WITH q1095 AS (SELECT CAST(p."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY) AS geom FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" AS p, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => p."all_tags") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE p."feature_type" = 'multipolygons' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'wikidata' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value') AS TEXT) = 'Q1095' LIMIT 1), features_in_q1095 /* Step 2: All features within Q1095 area */ AS (SELECT feat."osm_id", feat."feature_type", feat."geometry" FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" AS feat, q1095 AS q WHERE ST_DWITHIN(CAST(feat."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY), q.geom, 0)), features_with_wikidata /* Step 3: Which features in Q1095 have a wikidata tag? */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT fq."osm_id" FROM features_in_q1095 AS fq JOIN "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" AS p ON fq."osm_id" = p."osm_id" AND fq."feature_type" = p."feature_type", LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => p."all_tags") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'wikidata'), candidate_relations /* Step 4: Candidate relations - only multipolygons (can encompass/contain features) */ /* Must have name, no wikidata tag */ AS (SELECT fq."osm_id", fq."geometry" AS rel_geometry, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'name' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value') AS TEXT) END) AS relation_name FROM features_in_q1095 AS fq JOIN "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" AS p ON fq."osm_id" = p."osm_id" AND fq."feature_type" = p."feature_type", LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => p."all_tags") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE fq."feature_type" = 'multipolygons' GROUP BY fq."osm_id", fq."geometry" HAVING NOT relation_name IS NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'wikidata' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value') AS TEXT) END) IS NULL), relation_scores /* Step 5: For each candidate, count features in Q1095 that are also within the relation */ AS (SELECT cr."osm_id", cr.relation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fq."osm_id") AS feature_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fw."osm_id") AS wikidata_feature_count FROM candidate_relations AS cr JOIN features_in_q1095 AS fq ON ST_DWITHIN(CAST(fq."geometry" AS GEOGRAPHY), CAST(cr.rel_geometry AS GEOGRAPHY), 0) AND fq."osm_id" <> cr."osm_id" LEFT JOIN features_with_wikidata AS fw ON fq."osm_id" = fw."osm_id" GROUP BY cr."osm_id", cr.relation_name) SELECT relation_name AS name FROM relation_scores WHERE wikidata_feature_count >= 1 ORDER BY feature_count DESC LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_data AS (SELECT p."category" AS CATEGORY, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS DATE) AS MONTH_START, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS YEAR, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS MONTH, SUM(oi."sale_price") AS REVENUE, COUNT(DISTINCT oi."order_id") AS ORDERS_COUNT, SUM(p."cost") AS TOTAL_COST FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE oi."status" = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) < 2022 GROUP BY p."category", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."delivered_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000))), with_growth AS (SELECT CATEGORY, MONTH_START, YEAR, MONTH, REVENUE, ORDERS_COUNT, ROUND(CAST((REVENUE - LAG(REVENUE) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY MONTH_START)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / LAG(REVENUE) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY MONTH_START) * 100, 2) AS REVENUE_MOM_PCT, ROUND(CAST((ORDERS_COUNT - LAG(ORDERS_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY MONTH_START)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / LAG(ORDERS_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY MONTH_START) * 100, 2) AS ORDERS_MOM_PCT, TOTAL_COST, REVENUE - TOTAL_COST AS PROFIT, CAST((REVENUE - TOTAL_COST) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / TOTAL_COST AS PROFIT_TO_COST_RATIO FROM monthly_data) SELECT CATEGORY, MONTH_START, YEAR, MONTH, REVENUE, ORDERS_COUNT, REVENUE_MOM_PCT, ORDERS_MOM_PCT, TOTAL_COST, PROFIT, PROFIT_TO_COST_RATIO FROM with_growth ORDER BY CATEGORY, MONTH_START

WITH orders_converted AS (SELECT "user_id", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS order_ts, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS order_month FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) <= '2022-12-31 23:59:59'), first_purchase AS (SELECT "user_id", MIN(order_month) AS first_month FROM orders_converted GROUP BY "user_id"), user_order_months AS (SELECT DISTINCT o."user_id", o.order_month FROM orders_converted AS o), cohort_data AS (SELECT fp.first_month AS cohort_month, fp."user_id", CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(uom.order_month AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(fp.first_month AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(uom.order_month AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(fp.first_month AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS months_since_first FROM first_purchase AS fp JOIN user_order_months AS uom ON fp."user_id" = uom."user_id"), cohort_sizes AS (SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS cohort_size FROM cohort_data GROUP BY cohort_month), cohort_activity AS (SELECT cohort_month, months_since_first, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS active_users FROM cohort_data WHERE months_since_first BETWEEN 0 AND 3 GROUP BY cohort_month, months_since_first) SELECT TO_CHAR(cs.cohort_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS COHORT_MONTH, cs.cohort_size AS COHORT_SIZE, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(m0.active_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cs.cohort_size, 6) AS PCT_MONTH_1, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(m1.active_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cs.cohort_size, 6) AS PCT_MONTH_2, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(m2.active_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cs.cohort_size, 6) AS PCT_MONTH_3, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(m3.active_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cs.cohort_size, 6) AS PCT_MONTH_4 FROM cohort_sizes AS cs LEFT JOIN cohort_activity AS m0 ON cs.cohort_month = m0.cohort_month AND m0.months_since_first = 0 LEFT JOIN cohort_activity AS m1 ON cs.cohort_month = m1.cohort_month AND m1.months_since_first = 1 LEFT JOIN cohort_activity AS m2 ON cs.cohort_month = m2.cohort_month AND m2.months_since_first = 2 LEFT JOIN cohort_activity AS m3 ON cs.cohort_month = m3.cohort_month AND m3.months_since_first = 3 ORDER BY cs.cohort_month

WITH monthly_product_profit AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(oi."created_at" / 1000000.0)), 'YYYY-MM') AS "month_year", oi."product_id" AS "product_id", p."name" AS "product_name", SUM(oi."sale_price") AS "sales", SUM(p."cost") AS "cost", SUM(oi."sale_price" - p."cost") AS "profit" FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000.0) < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY "month_year", oi."product_id", p."name"), ranked AS (SELECT "month_year", "product_id", "product_name", "sales", "cost", "profit", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "month_year" ORDER BY "profit" DESC, "product_id" ASC) AS "rn" FROM monthly_product_profit) SELECT "month_year", "product_id", "product_name", "sales", "cost", "profit" FROM ranked WHERE "rn" = 1 ORDER BY "month_year"

WITH monthly_data AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, p."category" AS product_category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi."order_id") AS total_order, SUM(oi."sale_price") AS total_revenue, SUM(oi."sale_price" - p."cost") AS total_profit FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2019-06-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY month, p."category"), with_growth AS (SELECT month, product_category, total_order, CAST((total_order - LAG(total_order) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(total_order) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month), 0) * 100 AS order_growth, total_revenue, CAST((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month), 0) * 100 AS revenue_growth, total_profit, CAST((total_profit - LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY month), 0) * 100 AS profit_growth FROM monthly_data) SELECT month, product_category, total_order, order_growth, total_revenue, revenue_growth, total_profit, profit_growth FROM with_growth WHERE month >= '2019-07' ORDER BY month ASC, product_category ASC

WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS month_num, oi."product_id", p."name", (p."retail_price" - p."cost") AS profit FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2020), ranked AS (SELECT month_num, "name", profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY profit ASC, "name" ASC) AS rn FROM monthly_sales) SELECT "name" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY month_num

WITH all_sessions AS (SELECT "fullVisitorId", "date", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("totals", 'transactions') AS INT) AS transactions, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("device", 'deviceCategory') AS TEXT) AS deviceCategory FROM "GA360"."GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_SAMPLE"."GA_SESSIONS_20160801" UNION ALL SELECT "fullVisitorId", "date", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("totals", 'transactions') AS INT) AS transactions, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("device", 'deviceCategory') AS TEXT) AS deviceCategory FROM "GA360"."GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_SAMPLE"."GA_SESSIONS_20160802" UNION ALL SELECT "fullVisitorId", "date", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("totals", 'transactions') AS INT) AS transactions, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("device", 'deviceCategory') AS TEXT) AS deviceCategory FROM "GA360"."GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_SAMPLE"."GA_SESSIONS_20160803" UNION ALL SELECT "fullVisitorId", "date", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("totals", 'transactions') AS INT) AS transactions, WITH monthly_product_profit AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS DATE) AS "MONTH", p."name" AS "PRODUCT_NAME", SUM(oi."sale_price") - SUM(p."cost") AS "PROFIT" FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."id" WHERE NOT oi."status" IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2019-01-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(oi."created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2022-09-01' GROUP BY "MONTH", p."name"), ranked AS (SELECT "MONTH", "PRODUCT_NAME", "PROFIT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MONTH" ORDER BY "PROFIT" DESC) AS "RANK" FROM monthly_product_profit) SELECT "MONTH", "PRODUCT_NAME", "PROFIT", "RANK" FROM ranked WHERE "RANK" <= 3 ORDER BY "MONTH", "RANK"

SELECT "state_name", 'Census Tract' AS "ANALYSIS_LEVEL", COUNT(*) AS "REGION_COUNT", SUM("count_qualified") AS "BUILDINGS_AVAILABLE", ROUND(CAST(AVG("percent_covered") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AVG_GOOGLE_MAPS_COVERAGE_PCT", ROUND(CAST(AVG("percent_qualified") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AVG_SUITABLE_COVERAGE_PCT", SUM("number_of_panels_total") AS "POTENTIAL_PANEL_COUNT", SUM("kw_total") AS "TOTAL_KW_CAPACITY", SUM("yearly_sunlight_kwh_total") AS "ENERGY_GENERATION_POTENTIAL_KWH", SUM("carbon_offset_metric_tons") AS "CARBON_DIOXIDE_OFFSET_TONS", SUM("existing_installs_count") AS "CURRENT_BUILDINGS_WITH_SOLAR", ROUND(SUM(CAST(CAST("count_qualified" * "percent_covered" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100.0 * "percent_qualified" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100.0) - SUM("existing_installs_count"), 0) AS "GAP_IN_POTENTIAL_INSTALLS" FROM "SUNROOF_SOLAR"."SUNROOF_SOLAR"."SOLAR_POTENTIAL_BY_CENSUSTRACT" GROUP BY "state_name" UNION ALL SELECT "state_name", 'Postal Code' AS "ANALYSIS_LEVEL", COUNT(*) AS "REGION_COUNT", SUM("count_qualified") AS "BUILDINGS_AVAILABLE", ROUND(CAST(AVG("percent_covered") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AVG_GOOGLE_MAPS_COVERAGE_PCT", ROUND(CAST(AVG("percent_qualified") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AVG_SUITABLE_COVERAGE_PCT", SUM("number_of_panels_total") AS "POTENTIAL_PANEL_COUNT", SUM("kw_total") AS "TOTAL_KW_CAPACITY", SUM("yearly_sunlight_kwh_total") AS "ENERGY_GENERATION_POTENTIAL_KWH", SUM("carbon_offset_metric_tons") AS "CARBON_DIOXIDE_OFFSET_TONS", SUM("existing_installs_count") AS "CURRENT_BUILDINGS_WITH_SOLAR", ROUND(SUM(CAST(CAST("count_qualified" * "percent_covered" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100.0 * "percent_qualified" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100.0) - SUM("existing_installs_count"), 0) AS "GAP_IN_POTENTIAL_INSTALLS" FROM "SUNROOF_SOLAR"."SUNROOF_SOLAR"."SOLAR_POTENTIAL_BY_POSTAL_CODE" GROUP BY "state_name" ORDER BY "state_name", "ANALYSIS_LEVEL"

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."start_time" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s."status" = 'active' THEN t."start_station_id" END) AS number_status_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s."status" = 'closed' THEN t."start_station_id" END) AS number_status_closed FROM "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" AS t JOIN "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s ON t."start_station_id" = s."station_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."start_time" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) IN (2013, 2014) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT u."display_name" AS output FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS a JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u ON a."owner_user_id" = u."id" WHERE u."reputation" > 10 GROUP BY u."display_name" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(daily_count) AS OUTPUT FROM (SELECT CAST("start_time" AS DATE) AS ride_day, COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" WHERE "bike_type" = 'electric' AND "subscriber_type" = 'Student Membership' AND "duration_minutes" > 10 AND "start_station_name" <> 'Mobile Station' AND "end_station_name" <> 'Mobile Station' AND "start_station_name" <> 'Repair Shop' AND "end_station_name" <> 'Repair Shop' GROUP BY ride_day)

SELECT s1."council_district" AS output FROM "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" AS t JOIN "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s1 ON CAST(t."start_station_id" AS INT) = s1."station_id" JOIN "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s2 ON CAST(t."end_station_id" AS INT) = s2."station_id" WHERE s1."status" = 'active' AND s2."status" = 'active' AND s1."council_district" = s2."council_district" AND t."start_station_id" <> t."end_station_id" GROUP BY s1."council_district" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH active_station_trips AS (SELECT t."start_station_id" AS START_STATION_ID, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS, AVG(t."duration_minutes") AS AVG_DURATION_MINUTES FROM "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" AS t INNER JOIN "AUSTIN"."AUSTIN_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATIONS" AS s ON t."start_station_id" = s."station_id" WHERE s."status" = 'active' GROUP BY t."start_station_id"), total AS (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_TRIPS) AS overall_trips FROM active_station_trips), ranked AS (SELECT a.START_STATION_ID, a.TOTAL_TRIPS, a.AVG_DURATION_MINUTES, (CAST(a.TOTAL_TRIPS * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.overall_trips) AS PERCENTAGE_OF_TOTAL_TRIPS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.TOTAL_TRIPS DESC) AS rnk FROM active_station_trips AS a CROSS JOIN total AS t) SELECT START_STATION_ID, TOTAL_TRIPS, AVG_DURATION_MINUTES, PERCENTAGE_OF_TOTAL_TRIPS FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 15 ORDER BY rnk

SELECT "category", COUNT(*) AS NUMBER_TOTAL_BY_CATEGORY, ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER("body") LIKE '%education%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 6) AS PERCENT_EDUCATION FROM "BBC"."BBC_NEWS"."FULLTEXT" GROUP BY "category" ORDER BY "category"
SELECT "zip_code" AS OUTPUT FROM "FDA"."FDIC_BANKS"."LOCATIONS" WHERE "state_name" = 'Florida' GROUP BY "zip_code" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH wy_names AS (SELECT "name", "number" AS wy_count FROM "USA_NAMES"."USA_NAMES"."USA_1910_CURRENT" WHERE "state" = 'WY' AND "gender" = 'F' AND "year" = 2021), all_states_names AS (SELECT "name", SUM("number") AS total_count FROM "USA_NAMES"."USA_NAMES"."USA_1910_CURRENT" WHERE "gender" = 'F' AND "year" = 2021 GROUP BY "name") SELECT w."name" AS output FROM wy_names AS w JOIN all_states_names AS a ON w."name" = a."name" ORDER BY CAST(w.wy_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / a.total_count DESC LIMIT 1

WITH utah_zips AS (SELECT "zip_code" FROM "FDA"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" WHERE "state_code" = 'UT'), bank_counts AS (SELECT uz."zip_code", COUNT(loc."zip_code") AS bank_location_count FROM utah_zips AS uz LEFT JOIN "FDA"."FDIC_BANKS"."LOCATIONS" AS loc ON uz."zip_code" = loc."zip_code" GROUP BY uz."zip_code"), fewest_bank_zip AS (SELECT "zip_code" FROM bank_counts ORDER BY bank_location_count ASC, "zip_code" ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST(acs."employed_pop" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / acs."pop_16_over" AS EMPLOYMENT_RATE FROM fewest_bank_zip AS fbz JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."ZIP_CODES_2017_5YR" AS acs ON fbz."zip_code" = acs."geo_id"

WITH filtered_banks AS (SELECT "state_name", SUM("total_assets") AS sum_assets FROM "FDA"."FDIC_BANKS"."INSTITUTIONS" WHERE "institution_name" LIKE 'Bank%' AND "established_date" >= '1900-01-01' AND "established_date" <= '2000-12-31' GROUP BY "state_name" ORDER BY sum_assets DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT COUNT("institution_name") AS "COUNT(""INSTITUTION_NAME"")" FROM "FDA"."FDIC_BANKS"."INSTITUTIONS" WHERE "state_name" = (SELECT "state_name" FROM filtered_banks)

WITH us_daily AS (SELECT g."date", AVG(CASE WHEN g."max" <> 9999.9 THEN g."max" END) AS avg_max_temp, AVG(CASE WHEN g."min" <> 9999.9 THEN g."min" END) AS avg_min_temp, AVG(CASE WHEN g."temp" <> 9999.9 THEN g."temp" END) AS avg_temp FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2023" AS g JOIN "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" AS s ON g."stn" = s."usaf" AND g."wban" = s."wban" WHERE s."country" = 'US' AND g."date" >= '2023-10-01' AND g."date" <= '2023-10-31' AND g."max" <> 9999.9 AND g."min" <> 9999.9 AND g."temp" <> 9999.9 GROUP BY g."date"), uk_daily AS (SELECT g."date", AVG(CASE WHEN g."max" <> 9999.9 THEN g."max" END) AS avg_max_temp, AVG(CASE WHEN g."min" <> 9999.9 THEN g."min" END) AS avg_min_temp, AVG(CASE WHEN g."temp" <> 9999.9 THEN g."temp" END) AS avg_temp FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2023" AS g JOIN "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" AS s ON g."stn" = s."usaf" AND g."wban" = s."wban" WHERE s."country" = 'UK' AND g."date" >= '2023-10-01' AND g."date" <= '2023-10-31' AND g."max" <> 9999.9 AND g."min" <> 9999.9 AND g."temp" <> 9999.9 GROUP BY g."date") SELECT u."date", u.avg_max_temp - k.avg_max_temp AS DIFF_MAX_TEMP, u.avg_min_temp - k.avg_min_temp AS DIFF_MIN_TEMP, u.avg_temp - k.avg_temp AS DIFF_AVG_TEMP FROM us_daily AS u JOIN uk_daily AS k ON u."date" = k."date" ORDER BY u."date"

WITH coinjoin_txns AS (SELECT DISTINCT t."hash", t."block_timestamp_month", t."input_count", t."output_count", t."input_value", t."output_value" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."TRANSACTIONS" AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."outputs") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE t."block_timestamp_month" >= '2023-07-01' AND t."is_coinbase" = FALSE AND t."output_count" > 2 AND t."output_value" <= t."input_value" AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value') AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY t."hash", t."block_timestamp_month", t."input_count", t."output_count", t."input_value", t."output_value", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value') AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), monthly_coinjoin AS (SELECT "block_timestamp_month", COUNT(DISTINCT "hash") AS coinjoin_tx_count, SUM("input_count") AS coinjoin_input_count, SUM("output_count") AS coinjoin_output_count, SUM("input_value") AS coinjoin_input_value FROM coinjoin_txns GROUP BY "block_timestamp_month"), monthly_totals AS (SELECT "block_timestamp_month", COUNT(*) AS total_tx_count, SUM("input_count") AS total_input_count, SUM("output_count") AS total_output_count, SUM("input_value") AS total_input_value FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."TRANSACTIONS" WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= '2023-07-01' GROUP BY "block_timestamp_month") SELECT CAST(c.coinjoin_tx_count * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.total_tx_count AS "tx_percent", CAST((CAST(c.coinjoin_input_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.total_input_count + CAST(c.coinjoin_output_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.total_output_count) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 2 * 100 AS "utxos_percent", CAST(c.coinjoin_input_value * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.total_input_value AS "value_percent" FROM monthly_coinjoin AS c JOIN monthly_totals AS t ON c."block_timestamp_month" = t."block_timestamp_month" ORDER BY c."block_timestamp_month" DESC
SELECT MAX(CAST("answer_count" AS INT)) AS output FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" WHERE "tags" LIKE '%python-2%' AND NOT "tags" LIKE '%python-3%'

SELECT a."id" AS A_ID, u_a."reputation" AS A_USER_REPUTATION, a."score" AS A_SCORE, a."comment_count" AS ANSWER_COMMENT_COUNT, q."tags" AS Q_TAGS, q."score" AS Q_SCORE, q."answer_count" AS ANSWER_COUNT, u_q."reputation" AS Q_USER_REPUTATION, q."view_count" AS Q_VIEW_COUNT, q."comment_count" AS Q_COMMENT_COUNT FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS a ON q."accepted_answer_id" = a."id" JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u_a ON a."owner_user_id" = u_a."id" JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u_q ON q."owner_user_id" = u_q."id" WHERE q."creation_date" >= 1451606400000000 AND q."creation_date" < 1454284800000000 AND a."creation_date" >= 1451606400000000 AND a."creation_date" < 1454284800000000 AND q."tags" LIKE '%javascript%' AND (q."tags" LIKE '%xss%' OR q."tags" LIKE '%cross-site%' OR q."tags" LIKE '%exploit%' OR q."tags" LIKE '%cybersecurity%') ORDER BY A_ID DESC

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS INT) * 100 + CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS INT) AS MONTH_INDEX, ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "tags" = 'python' OR "tags" LIKE 'python|%' OR "tags" LIKE '%|python|%' OR "tags" LIKE '%|python' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 6) AS PROPORTION FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2022 GROUP BY MONTH_INDEX ORDER BY MONTH_INDEX

/* sf_bq303: Retrieve user_id and tags for all contributions (questions, answers, comments) */ /* from July 1, 2019 through December 31, 2019 for users with IDs between 16712208 and 18712208 */ /* Date boundaries (microseconds since epoch): */ /* July 1, 2019 00:00:00 UTC = 1561939200 * 1000000 = 1561939200000000 */ /* Jan 1, 2020 00:00:00 UTC = 1577836800 * 1000000 = 1577836800000000 */ /* 1. Comments on questions: user_id from comment, tags from question */ SELECT c."user_id" AS U_ID, pq."tags" AS TAGS FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."COMMENTS" AS c INNER JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS pq ON c."post_id" = pq."id" WHERE c."user_id" BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208 AND c."creation_date" >= 1561939200000000 AND c."creation_date" < 1577836800000000 UNION ALL /* 2. Comments on answers: user_id from comment, tags from parent question of the answer */ SELECT c."user_id" AS U_ID, pq."tags" AS TAGS FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."COMMENTS" AS c INNER JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS pa ON c."post_id" = pa."id" INNER JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS pq ON pa."parent_id" = pq."id" WHERE c."user_id" BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208 AND c."creation_date" >= 1561939200000000 AND c."creation_date" < 1577836800000000 UNION ALL /* 3. Answers posted: owner_user_id from answer, tags from parent question */ SELECT pa."owner_user_id" AS U_ID, pq."tags" AS TAGS FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS pa INNER JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS pq ON pa."parent_id" = pq."id" WHERE pa."owner_user_id" BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208 AND pa."creation_date" >= 1561939200000000 AND pa."creation_date" < 1577836800000000 UNION ALL /* 4. Questions authored: owner_user_id and tags directly from question */ SELECT pq."owner_user_id" AS U_ID, pq."tags" AS TAGS FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS pq WHERE pq."owner_user_id" BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208 AND pq."creation_date" >= 1561939200000000 AND pq."creation_date" < 1577836800000000

WITH tagged_questions AS (SELECT q."id", q."title" AS TITLE, q."view_count" AS VIEW_COUNT, CAST(t.value AS TEXT) AS TAG FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q, LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(q."tags", '|') AS t WHERE CAST(t.value AS TEXT) IN ('android-layout', 'android-activity', 'android-intent', 'android-edittext', 'android-fragments', 'android-recyclerview', 'listview', 'android-actionbar', 'google-maps', 'android-asynctask') AND (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%how%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%fail%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%problem%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%error%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%wrong%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%fix%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%bug%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%issue%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%solve%') AND NOT (LOWER(q."title") LIKE '%trouble%' OR LOWER(q."body") LIKE '%trouble%')), qualified_tags AS (SELECT TAG FROM tagged_questions GROUP BY TAG HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), ranked AS (SELECT tq.TAG, tq.TITLE, tq.VIEW_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tq.TAG ORDER BY tq.VIEW_COUNT DESC) AS rn FROM tagged_questions AS tq INNER JOIN qualified_tags AS qt ON tq.TAG = qt.TAG) SELECT TAG, TITLE, VIEW_COUNT FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 50 ORDER BY TAG, VIEW_COUNT DESC

WITH answer_total_scores AS (/* Pre-compute total answer scores per question */ SELECT "parent_id" AS question_id, SUM("score") AS total_score FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" GROUP BY "parent_id"), answer_ranks AS (/* Pre-compute rank of each answer within its question */ SELECT "id" AS answer_id, "parent_id" AS question_id, "owner_user_id", "score", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "parent_id" ORDER BY "score" DESC) AS score_rank FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" WHERE NOT "owner_user_id" IS NULL), criterion1 /* Criterion 1: User owns the question */ AS (SELECT "owner_user_id" AS user_id, "id" AS question_id FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" WHERE NOT "owner_user_id" IS NULL), criterion2 /* Criterion 2: User's answer is the accepted answer */ AS (SELECT a."owner_user_id" AS user_id, q."id" AS question_id FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS a ON q."accepted_answer_id" = a."id" WHERE NOT a."owner_user_id" IS NULL), criterion3 /* Criterion 3: User's answer score > 5 */ AS (SELECT ar."owner_user_id" AS user_id, ar.question_id FROM answer_ranks AS ar WHERE ar."score" > 5), criterion4 /* Criterion 4: User's answer score > 20% of total AND score > 0 */ AS (SELECT ar."owner_user_id" AS user_id, ar.question_id FROM answer_ranks AS ar JOIN answer_total_scores AS ats ON ar.question_id = ats.question_id WHERE ar."score" > 0 AND ats.total_score > 0 AND ar."score" > 0.2 * ats.total_score), criterion5 /* Criterion 5: User's answer is among top 3 highest-scoring for that question */ AS (SELECT ar."owner_user_id" AS user_id, ar.question_id FROM answer_ranks AS ar WHERE ar.score_rank <= 3), all_associations /* Union all criteria (dedup user-question pairs) */ AS (SELECT user_id, question_id FROM criterion1 UNION SELECT user_id, question_id FROM criterion2 UNION SELECT user_id, question_id FROM criterion3 UNION SELECT user_id, question_id FROM criterion4 UNION SELECT user_id, question_id FROM criterion5), user_views /* Sum view counts per user */ AS (SELECT a.user_id, SUM(q."view_count") AS TOTAL_VIEW_COUNT FROM all_associations AS a JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q ON a.question_id = q."id" GROUP BY a.user_id) SELECT uv.user_id AS USER_ID, u."display_name", uv.TOTAL_VIEW_COUNT FROM user_views AS uv JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u ON uv.user_id = u."id" ORDER BY uv.TOTAL_VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 10

WITH first_gold AS (SELECT b."user_id", b."name" AS badge_name, b."date" AS badge_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."user_id" ORDER BY b."date" ASC, b."id" ASC) AS rn FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."BADGES" AS b WHERE b."class" = 1) SELECT fg.badge_name AS BADGE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS USER_COUNT, AVG(CAST(CAST((fg.badge_date - u."creation_date") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 86400.0) AS AVG_DAYS_TO_EARN FROM first_gold AS fg JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u ON fg."user_id" = u."id" WHERE fg.rn = 1 GROUP BY fg.badge_name ORDER BY USER_COUNT DESC LIMIT 10

WITH questions_2021 AS (SELECT "id" AS question_id, TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS question_ts, DAY_OF_WEEK(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) + 1 AS day_of_week FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2021), first_answers AS (SELECT "parent_id" AS question_id, MIN(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("creation_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS first_answer_ts FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" GROUP BY "parent_id"), combined AS (SELECT q.day_of_week, q.question_id, CASE WHEN fa.first_answer_ts <= q.question_ts + INTERVAL '1 HOUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS answered_in_1h FROM questions_2021 AS q LEFT JOIN first_answers AS fa ON q.question_id = fa.question_id) SELECT day_of_week AS "Day_of_Week", COUNT(*) AS "Num_Questions", SUM(answered_in_1h) AS "Num_Answered_in_1H", ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(answered_in_1h) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 6) AS "Percent_Answered_in_1H" FROM combined GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

WITH qualified_questions AS (/* Questions with an accepted answer */ SELECT q."id", LENGTH(q."body") AS body_len, q."owner_user_id" FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q WHERE NOT q."accepted_answer_id" IS NULL UNION /* Questions without accepted answer but with at least one answer with score/view ratio > 0.01 */ SELECT DISTINCT q."id", LENGTH(q."body") AS body_len, q."owner_user_id" FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" AS q JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_ANSWERS" AS a ON a."parent_id" = q."id" WHERE q."accepted_answer_id" IS NULL AND q."view_count" > 0 AND CAST(a."score" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / q."view_count" > 0.01), top10 AS (SELECT * FROM qualified_questions ORDER BY body_len DESC LIMIT 10), badge_counts AS (SELECT "user_id", COUNT(*) AS badge_number FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."BADGES" GROUP BY "user_id") SELECT t."id", u."reputation", u."up_votes" - u."down_votes" AS net_votes, COALESCE(b.badge_number, 0) AS badge_number FROM top10 AS t LEFT JOIN "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."USERS" AS u ON t."owner_user_id" = u."id" LEFT JOIN badge_counts AS b ON t."owner_user_id" = b."user_id" ORDER BY t.body_len DESC
SELECT "title" AS OUTPUT FROM "STACKOVERFLOW"."STACKOVERFLOW"."POSTS_QUESTIONS" WHERE LOWER("title") LIKE 'how%' AND "tags" LIKE '%android-%' ORDER BY "view_count" DESC LIMIT 1

WITH labeled_sequences AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER("SeriesDescription") LIKE '%t2_tse_tra%' THEN 't2w_prostateX' WHEN "SeriesDescription" LIKE '%ADC%' THEN 'adc_prostateX' END AS SEQUENCE_LABEL, CAST("RepetitionTime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS RepetitionTime, CAST("EchoTime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS EchoTime, CAST("SliceThickness" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SliceThickness FROM "IDC"."IDC_V17"."DICOM_ALL" WHERE "collection_id" = 'prostatex' AND "Modality" = 'MR' AND (LOWER("SeriesDescription") LIKE '%t2_tse_tra%' OR "SeriesDescription" LIKE '%ADC%')), per_label AS (SELECT SEQUENCE_LABEL, AVG(RepetitionTime) AS AVG_REPETITION_TIME, AVG(EchoTime) AS AVG_ECHO_TIME, AVG(SliceThickness) AS AVG_SLICE_THICKNESS, AVG(RepetitionTime) + AVG(EchoTime) + AVG(SliceThickness) AS COMBINED_AVERAGE_SUM FROM labeled_sequences GROUP BY SEQUENCE_LABEL), combined AS (SELECT 'combined_overall' AS SEQUENCE_LABEL, AVG(RepetitionTime) AS AVG_REPETITION_TIME, AVG(EchoTime) AS AVG_ECHO_TIME, AVG(SliceThickness) AS AVG_SLICE_THICKNESS, AVG(RepetitionTime) + AVG(EchoTime) + AVG(SliceThickness) AS COMBINED_AVERAGE_SUM FROM labeled_sequences) SELECT * FROM per_label UNION ALL SELECT * FROM combined ORDER BY SEQUENCE_LABEL

WITH eosin_images AS (SELECT DISTINCT d."SOPInstanceUID" FROM "IDC"."IDC_V17"."DICOM_ALL" AS d, LATERAL UNNEST(input => d."SpecimenDescriptionSequence") AS sds(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(sds.value, 'SpecimenPreparationSequence')) AS sps(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(sps.value, 'SpecimenPreparationStepContentItemSequence')) AS item(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE d."Modality" = 'SM' AND d."collection_id" = 'tcga_brca' AND LOWER(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(item.value, 'ConceptCodeSequence', '0', 'CodeMeaning') AS TEXT)) LIKE '%eosin%') SELECT SUM(d."NumberOfFrames") AS total_frames FROM "IDC"."IDC_V17"."DICOM_ALL" AS d INNER JOIN eosin_images AS e ON d."SOPInstanceUID" = e."SOPInstanceUID" WHERE d."Modality" = 'SM' AND d."collection_id" = 'tcga_brca'

WITH gene_study_min AS (SELECT "gene_id", "study_id", MIN("pval_exponent") AS min_exp FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_GENETICS_2"."OPEN_TARGETS_GENETICS"."DISEASE_VARIANT_GENE" GROUP BY "gene_id", "study_id"), top10 AS (SELECT "gene_id", "study_id", min_exp FROM gene_study_min ORDER BY min_exp ASC, "gene_id" ASC LIMIT 10), get_variant AS (SELECT d."gene_id", d."study_id", d."lead_chrom" AS CHROM, d."lead_pos" AS POS, d."lead_ref" AS REF, d."lead_alt" AS ALT, d."pval", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d."gene_id", d."study_id" ORDER BY d."pval_exponent" ASC, d."pval_mantissa" ASC, d."lead_chrom" ASC, d."lead_pos" ASC, d."lead_ref" ASC, d."lead_alt" ASC) AS rn FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_GENETICS_2"."OPEN_TARGETS_GENETICS"."DISEASE_VARIANT_GENE" AS d INNER JOIN top10 AS t ON d."gene_id" = t."gene_id" AND d."study_id" = t."study_id") SELECT "gene_id", "study_id", CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, "pval" FROM get_variant WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "gene_id" ASC

WITH pop_increase AS (SELECT p."country_code" FROM "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_GLOBAL_POPULATION"."POPULATION_BY_COUNTRY" AS p JOIN "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_HEALTH_POPULATION"."COUNTRY_SUMMARY" AS cs ON p."country_code" = cs."country_code" AND NOT cs."region" IS NULL AND cs."region" <> '' WHERE NOT p."year_2017" IS NULL AND p."year_2017" > 0 AND NOT p."year_2018" IS NULL AND CAST((p."year_2018" - p."year_2017") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / p."year_2017" > 0.01), health_increase AS (SELECT h2018."country_code" FROM "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_HEALTH_POPULATION"."HEALTH_NUTRITION_POPULATION" AS h2018 JOIN "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_HEALTH_POPULATION"."HEALTH_NUTRITION_POPULATION" AS h2017 ON h2018."country_code" = h2017."country_code" AND h2017."indicator_code" = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND h2017."year" = 2017 AND NOT h2017."value" IS NULL AND h2017."value" > 0 WHERE h2018."indicator_code" = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND h2018."year" = 2018 AND NOT h2018."value" IS NULL AND CAST((h2018."value" - h2017."value") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / h2017."value" > 0.01) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "NUM_COUNTRIES" FROM pop_increase AS p JOIN health_increase AS h ON p."country_code" = h."country_code"
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "indicator_name") AS number_of_indicators_with_zero FROM "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_INTL_DEBT"."INTERNATIONAL_DEBT" WHERE "country_name" = 'Russian Federation' AND "value" = 0

SELECT c."region" FROM "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_WDI"."INDICATORS_DATA" AS i JOIN "WORLD_BANK"."WORLD_BANK_WDI"."COUNTRY_SUMMARY" AS c ON i."country_code" = c."country_code" WHERE i."indicator_code" = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD' AND NOT c."region" IS NULL AND c."region" <> '' GROUP BY c."region" ORDER BY PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i."value") DESC LIMIT 1

WITH zip_with_block_groups AS (SELECT DISTINCT z."zip_code" FROM "FDA"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" AS z JOIN "FDA"."GEO_CENSUS_BLOCKGROUPS"."BLOCKGROUPS_08" AS b ON ST_INTERSECTS(CAST(z."zip_code_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY), CAST(b."blockgroup_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY)) WHERE z."state_code" = 'CO'), bank_counts AS (SELECT "zip_code", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS bank_count FROM "FDA"."FDIC_BANKS"."LOCATIONS" WHERE "state_name" = 'Colorado' GROUP BY "zip_code") SELECT bc."zip_code" AS ZIP_CODE, bc.bank_count AS BANK_CONCENTRATION_PER_BLOCK_GROUP FROM bank_counts AS bc JOIN zip_with_block_groups AS zb ON bc."zip_code" = zb."zip_code" ORDER BY BANK_CONCENTRATION_PER_BLOCK_GROUP DESC LIMIT 1

WITH first_messages AS (SELECT fm."Id" AS message_id, fm."PostUserId", COUNT(DISTINCT fmv."FromUserId") AS message_score FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMTOPICS" AS ft JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGES" AS fm ON ft."FirstForumMessageId" = fm."Id" LEFT JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGEVOTES" AS fmv ON fm."Id" = fmv."ForumMessageId" GROUP BY fm."Id", fm."PostUserId"), avg_score AS (SELECT AVG(message_score) AS avg_msg_score FROM first_messages) SELECT u."UserName", ABS(fm.message_score - a.avg_msg_score) AS ABS_DIFF FROM first_messages AS fm JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."USERS" AS u ON fm."PostUserId" = u."Id" CROSS JOIN avg_score AS a ORDER BY fm.message_score DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT "browser", AVG(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(MAX_ts AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(MIN_ts AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT)) AS AVG_USER_DURATION FROM (SELECT "user_id", "session_id", "browser", MIN("created_at") AS MIN_ts, MAX("created_at") AS MAX_ts FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."EVENTS" GROUP BY "user_id", "session_id", "browser") AS sub GROUP BY "browser" HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY AVG_USER_DURATION ASC LIMIT 3

WITH all_txns AS (/* Combine inputs and outputs with flattened addresses */ SELECT CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT) AS address, TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(i."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) AS ts, i."value" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."INPUTS" AS i, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => i."addresses") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(i."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) >= '2017-10-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(i."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) < '2017-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT) AS address, TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) AS ts, o."value" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."OUTPUTS" AS o, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => o."addresses") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) >= '2017-10-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(o."block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)) < '2017-11-01'), per_address AS (/* For each address: find their last transaction timestamp and total value */ SELECT address, MAX(ts) AS last_txn_ts, SUM("value") AS total_value FROM all_txns GROUP BY address) /* Find the address with the latest final transaction, breaking ties by highest total value */ SELECT address AS OUTPUT FROM per_address ORDER BY last_txn_ts DESC, total_value DESC LIMIT 1

WITH base AS (SELECT a."geo_id", a."total_pop" AS pop_2011, b."total_pop" AS pop_2018, a."median_income" AS income_2011, b."median_income" AS income_2018 FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2011_5YR" AS a INNER JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_1"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2018_5YR" AS b ON a."geo_id" = b."geo_id" WHERE a."geo_id" LIKE '36047%' AND a."total_pop" > 1000 AND b."total_pop" > 1000), top_pop AS (SELECT "geo_id" FROM base ORDER BY CAST((pop_2018 - pop_2011) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / pop_2011 DESC LIMIT 20), top_income AS (SELECT "geo_id" FROM base WHERE NOT income_2011 IS NULL AND NOT income_2018 IS NULL ORDER BY (income_2018 - income_2011) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tp."geo_id" FROM top_pop AS tp INNER JOIN top_income AS ti ON tp."geo_id" = ti."geo_id"

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("end_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS end_month, CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "subscriber_type" = 'Customer' THEN "duration_sec" ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000.0 AS customer_minutes_k, CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "subscriber_type" = 'Subscriber' THEN "duration_sec" ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000.0 AS subscriber_minutes_k FROM "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("end_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2017 AND "subscriber_type" IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber') GROUP BY 1), cumulative AS (SELECT end_month, SUM(customer_minutes_k) OVER (ORDER BY end_month) AS cum_customer, SUM(subscriber_minutes_k) OVER (ORDER BY end_month) AS cum_subscriber FROM monthly) SELECT end_month AS END_MONTH FROM cumulative ORDER BY ABS(cum_customer - cum_subscriber) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH all_transfers AS (SELECT "to_address" AS addr, CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS val, "block_number", "log_index" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" WHERE "token_address" IN ('0x0d8775f648430679a709e98d2b0cb6250d2887ef0', '0x1e15c05cbad367f044cbfbafda3d9a1510db5513') UNION ALL SELECT "from_address" AS addr, CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS val, "block_number", "log_index" FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" WHERE "token_address" IN ('0x0d8775f648430679a709e98d2b0cb6250d2887ef0', '0x1e15c05cbad367f044cbfbafda3d9a1510db5513')), ranked AS (SELECT addr, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY addr ORDER BY "block_number" DESC, "log_index" DESC) AS rn FROM all_transfers WHERE addr <> '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000') SELECT addr AS ADDRESS FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY val DESC LIMIT 6

WITH hourly_totals AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS yr, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS hr, SUM(CAST("value" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS hourly_total FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" WHERE "token_address" = '0x68e54af74b22acaccffa04ccaad13be16ed14eac' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) >= '2019-01-01' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("block_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) < '2021-01-01' AND ("from_address" = '0x8babf0ba311aab914c00e8fda7e8558a8b66de5d' OR "to_address" = '0xfbd6c6b112214d949dcdfb1217153bc0a742862f') GROUP BY yr, hr), hourly_changes AS (SELECT yr, hr, hourly_total, hourly_total - LAG(hourly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY hr) AS hourly_change FROM hourly_totals), yearly_avg AS (SELECT yr, AVG(hourly_change) AS avg_hourly_change FROM hourly_changes WHERE NOT hourly_change IS NULL GROUP BY yr) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_hourly_change END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_hourly_change END) AS DIFFERENCE_2020_MINUS_2019 FROM yearly_avg

WITH amenity_history AS (SELECT h."id", h."username", h."version", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h."id" ORDER BY h."version" ASC) AS rn FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."HISTORY_NODES" AS h, LATERAL UNNEST(input => h."all_tags") AS t(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(t.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'amenity' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(t.value, 'value') AS TEXT) IN ('hospital', 'clinic', 'doctors') AND h."latitude" BETWEEN 31.1798246 AND 54.3798246 AND h."longitude" BETWEEN 18.0 AND 33.6519921 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_NODES" AS p WHERE p."id" = h."id")) SELECT "username", COUNT(*) AS NODE_COUNT FROM amenity_history WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY "username" ORDER BY NODE_COUNT DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m."id" AS DRUG_ID, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(tn.VALUE, 'element') AS TEXT) AS DRUG_TRADE_NAME, m."drugType" AS DRUG_TYPE, m."hasBeenWithdrawn" AS DRUG_WITHDRAWN FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."MOLECULE" AS m, LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(m."tradeNames", 'list')) AS tn(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE m."isApproved" = TRUE AND m."blackBoxWarning" = TRUE AND m."drugType" <> 'Unknown' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(tn.VALUE, 'element') AS TEXT) IN ('Keytruda', 'Vioxx', 'Premarin', 'Humira') ORDER BY DRUG_ID

SELECT n."County_of_Residence", n."Ave_Number_of_Prenatal_Wks" AS "Vist_Ave" FROM "SDOH"."SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY"."COUNTY_NATALITY" AS n INNER JOIN "SDOH"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."COUNTY_2017_5YR" AS a ON n."County_of_Residence_FIPS" = a."geo_id" WHERE n."County_of_Residence" LIKE '%, WI' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM n."Year") = 2018 AND CAST(a."commute_45_59_mins" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(a."employed_pop", 0) > 0.05 ORDER BY n."County_of_Residence"

WITH icd_codes AS (/* Find all ICD-10-CM codes and subcategories for the 4 conditions */ SELECT "concept_id", "concept_code", "concept_name", CASE WHEN "concept_code" LIKE 'L70%' THEN 'Acne' WHEN "concept_code" LIKE 'L20%' THEN 'Atopic Dermatitis' WHEN "concept_code" LIKE 'L40%' THEN 'Psoriasis' WHEN "concept_code" LIKE 'L80%' THEN 'Vitiligo' END AS condition_group FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT" WHERE "vocabulary_id" = 'ICD10CM' AND ("concept_code" LIKE 'L70%' OR "concept_code" LIKE 'L20%' OR "concept_code" LIKE 'L40%' OR "concept_code" LIKE 'L80%')), mapped_standard AS (/* Map each ICD-10-CM code to standard SNOMED concepts via concept relationships */ SELECT DISTINCT ic.condition_group, cr."concept_id_2" AS standard_concept_id FROM icd_codes AS ic JOIN "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP" AS cr ON ic."concept_id" = cr."concept_id_1" AND cr."relationship_id" = 'Maps to' JOIN "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT" AS c2 ON cr."concept_id_2" = c2."concept_id" AND c2."standard_concept" = 'S'), all_related_concepts AS (/* Include the mapped standard concepts themselves */ SELECT condition_group, standard_concept_id AS concept_id FROM mapped_standard UNION /* Include all descendant concepts of those standard concepts */ SELECT ms.condition_group, ca."descendant_concept_id" AS concept_id FROM mapped_standard AS ms JOIN "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT_ANCESTOR" AS ca ON ms.standard_concept_id = ca."ancestor_concept_id"), total_participants AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "person_id") AS total FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."PERSON") SELECT arc.condition_group AS CONDITION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT co."person_id") AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT, tp.total AS TOTAL_PARTICIPANTS, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT co."person_id") * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tp.total, 2) AS PERCENTAGE FROM all_related_concepts AS arc JOIN "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONDITION_OCCURRENCE" AS co ON co."condition_concept_id" = arc.concept_id CROSS JOIN total_participants AS tp GROUP BY arc.condition_group, tp.total ORDER BY arc.condition_group

WITH quinapril_concept AS (SELECT "concept_id" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT" WHERE "concept_code" = '35208' AND "vocabulary_id" = 'RxNorm'), related_drugs AS (SELECT DISTINCT ca."descendant_concept_id" AS "drug_concept_id" FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."CONCEPT_ANCESTOR" AS ca JOIN quinapril_concept AS qc ON ca."ancestor_concept_id" = qc."concept_id"), quinapril_users AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de."person_id") AS user_count FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."DRUG_EXPOSURE" AS de JOIN related_drugs AS rd ON de."drug_concept_id" = rd."drug_concept_id"), total_persons AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM "CMS_DATA"."CMS_SYNTHETIC_PATIENT_DATA_OMOP"."PERSON") SELECT ROUND(CAST((tp.total_count - qu.user_count) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tp.total_count, 6) AS "OUTPUT" FROM total_persons AS tp CROSS JOIN quinapril_users AS qu

WITH qualifying_stations AS (/* Stations whose period of record began on or before Jan 1, 2000 */ /* and continued through at least June 30, 2019 */ SELECT "usaf", "wban" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."STATIONS" WHERE "begin" <= '20000101' AND "end" >= '20190630'), valid_days_per_station AS (/* Count valid temperature-record days in 2019 per qualifying station */ /* A valid day requires all three: temp, max, min to be non-missing (not 9999.9) */ SELECT g."stn", g."wban", COUNT(*) AS valid_day_count FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2019" AS g JOIN qualifying_stations AS qs ON g."stn" = qs."usaf" AND g."wban" = qs."wban" WHERE g."temp" <> 9999.9 AND g."max" <> 9999.9 AND g."min" <> 9999.9 GROUP BY g."stn", g."wban") /* Count stations that achieved 90% or more of the maximum possible days (365) */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS STATION_COUNT FROM valid_days_per_station WHERE CAST(valid_day_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 365.0 >= 0.9

WITH all_icoads AS (SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2005" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2006" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2007" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2008" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2009" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2010" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2011" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2012" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2013" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2014" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", "wind_speed" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2015" WHERE NOT "wind_speed" IS NULL) SELECT "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude", AVG("wind_speed") AS AVG_WIND_SPEED FROM all_icoads GROUP BY "year", "month", "day", "latitude", "longitude" ORDER BY AVG_WIND_SPEED DESC LIMIT 5

AVG_COUNT, DIFF, IS_CLOSEST_TO_AVG FROM ranked ORDER BY NPI_COUNT DESC

WITH orders_with_dates AS (SELECT "user_id", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("created_at" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS order_ts FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS"), first_purchase AS (SELECT "user_id", MIN(order_ts) AS first_order_ts FROM orders_with_dates GROUP BY "user_id" HAVING DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', MIN(order_ts)) = '2020-01-01'), cohort_size AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users FROM first_purchase), returning_users AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_ts) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fp.first_order_ts) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_ts) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fp.first_order_ts) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS month_since_first_order, COUNT(DISTINCT o."user_id") AS new_user FROM orders_with_dates AS o JOIN first_purchase AS fp ON o."user_id" = fp."user_id" WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_ts) > DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fp.first_order_ts) AND o.order_ts < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY month_since_first_order) SELECT CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) AS COHORT, r.month_since_first_order AS MONTH_SINCE_FIRST_ORDER, r.new_user AS NEW_USER, cs.total_users AS COHORT_USER, ROUND(r.new_user / CAST(cs.total_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 6) AS COHORT_USERS_PERCENTAGE FROM returning_users AS r CROSS JOIN cohort_size AS cs ORDER BY r.month_since_first_order

WITH monthly_counts AS (SELECT "company", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("trip_start_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS trip_month, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM "CHICAGO"."CHICAGO_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_TRIPS" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("trip_start_timestamp" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2018 GROUP BY "company", trip_month), month_over_month AS (SELECT curr."company", curr.trip_count - prev.trip_count AS trip_increase FROM monthly_counts AS curr JOIN monthly_counts AS prev ON curr."company" = prev."company" AND curr.trip_month = prev.trip_month + 1), company_max_increase AS (SELECT "company", MAX(trip_increase) AS max_increase FROM month_over_month GROUP BY "company") SELECT "company" AS "COMPANY" FROM company_max_increase ORDER BY max_increase DESC LIMIT 3

WITH duration_minutes AS (SELECT DISTINCT FLOOR(CAST("trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) AS trip_min FROM "CHICAGO"."CHICAGO_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_TRIPS" WHERE FLOOR(CAST("trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) BETWEEN 1 AND 50), ntiled AS (SELECT trip_min, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_min) AS quantile_group FROM duration_minutes), groups AS (SELECT quantile_group, MIN(trip_min) AS min_min, MAX(trip_min) AS max_min FROM ntiled GROUP BY quantile_group) SELECT LPAD(CAST(CAST(g.min_min AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || 'm to ' || LPAD(CAST(CAST(g.max_min AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || 'm' AS TIME_RANGE, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS, ROUND(CAST(AVG(t."fare") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS AVERAGE_FARE FROM "CHICAGO"."CHICAGO_TAXI_TRIPS"."TAXI_TRIPS" AS t JOIN groups AS g ON FLOOR(CAST(t."trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) BETWEEN g.min_min AND g.max_min WHERE FLOOR(CAST(t."trip_seconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60.0) BETWEEN 1 AND 50 GROUP BY g.quantile_group, g.min_min, g.max_min ORDER BY TIME_RANGE

WITH order_agg AS (SELECT T1."CustomerID", COUNT(DISTINCT T1."OrderID") AS order_count, SUM(ol."Quantity" * ol."UnitPrice" * (1 + CAST(ol."TaxRate" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100)) AS order_total_value FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_ORDERS" AS T1 JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_ORDERLINES" AS ol ON T1."OrderID" = ol."OrderID" GROUP BY T1."CustomerID"), invoice_agg AS (SELECT i."CustomerID", COUNT(DISTINCT i."InvoiceID") AS invoice_count, SUM(il."ExtendedPrice") AS invoice_total_value FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICES" AS i JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICELINES" AS il ON i."InvoiceID" = il."InvoiceID" GROUP BY i."CustomerID") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."CustomerID") AS "COUNT(DISTINCT T1.""CUSTOMERID"")" FROM order_agg AS T1 JOIN invoice_agg AS T2 ON T1."CustomerID" = T2."CustomerID" WHERE T1.order_count = T2.invoice_count AND T1.order_total_value = T2.invoice_total_value

WITH invoice_totals AS (SELECT i."InvoiceID", CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(i."InvoiceDate" FROM 6 FOR 2) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN SUBSTRING(i."InvoiceDate" FROM 6 FOR 2) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN SUBSTRING(i."InvoiceDate" FROM 6 FOR 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') THEN 'Q3' WHEN SUBSTRING(i."InvoiceDate" FROM 6 FOR 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') THEN 'Q4' END AS quarter, SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity") AS invoice_total FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICES" AS i JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICELINES" AS il ON i."InvoiceID" = il."InvoiceID" WHERE LEFT(i."InvoiceDate", 4) = '2013' GROUP BY i."InvoiceID", quarter), quarterly_avg AS (SELECT quarter, AVG(invoice_total) AS avg_invoice_value FROM invoice_totals GROUP BY quarter) SELECT MAX(avg_invoice_value) - MIN(avg_invoice_value) AS DIFFERENCE FROM quarterly_avg

WITH lost_orders AS (SELECT o."OrderID", o."CustomerID" FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_ORDERS" AS o WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICES" AS i WHERE i."OrderID" = o."OrderID")), order_values AS (SELECT lo."OrderID", lo."CustomerID", SUM(ol."Quantity" * ol."UnitPrice") AS order_value FROM lost_orders AS lo JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_ORDERLINES" AS ol ON lo."OrderID" = ol."OrderID" GROUP BY lo."OrderID", lo."CustomerID"), category_max AS (SELECT cc."CustomerCategoryName", MAX(ov.order_value) AS MAXLOSTORDERVALUE FROM order_values AS ov JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_CUSTOMERS" AS c ON ov."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID" JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_CUSTOMERCATEGORIES" AS cc ON c."CustomerCategoryID" = cc."CustomerCategoryID" GROUP BY cc."CustomerCategoryName"), with_avg AS (SELECT "CustomerCategoryName", MAXLOSTORDERVALUE, AVG(MAXLOSTORDERVALUE) OVER () AS AVGMAXLOSTORDERVALUE, ABS(MAXLOSTORDERVALUE - AVG(MAXLOSTORDERVALUE) OVER ()) AS DIFFERENCEFROMAVERAGE FROM category_max) SELECT "CustomerCategoryName", MAXLOSTORDERVALUE, AVGMAXLOSTORDERVALUE, DIFFERENCEFROMAVERAGE FROM with_avg ORDER BY DIFFERENCEFROMAVERAGE ASC LIMIT 1

WITH customer_total AS (SELECT i."CustomerID", SUM(il."ExtendedPrice") AS total_spending FROM "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICES" AS i JOIN "WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS"."SALES_INVOICELINES" AS il ON i."InvoiceID" = il."InvoiceID" WHERE i."InvoiceDate" >= '2014-01-01' AND i."InvoiceDate" < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY i."CustomerID"), avg_monthly AS (SELECT "CustomerID", CAST(total_spending AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 12 AS avg_monthly_spend FROM customer_total) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_monthly_spend) AS MEDIAN_AVG_MONTHLY_SPEND FROM avg_monthly

SELECT CASE WHEN "path" LIKE '%.py' THEN 'Python' WHEN "path" LIKE '%.c' THEN 'C' WHEN "path" LIKE '%.ipynb' THEN 'Jupyter Notebook' WHEN "path" LIKE '%.java' THEN 'Java' WHEN "path" LIKE '%.js' THEN 'JavaScript' END AS FILE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS FILE_COUNT FROM "GITHUB_REPOS"."GITHUB_REPOS"."SAMPLE_FILES" WHERE ("path" LIKE '%.py' OR "path" LIKE '%.c' OR "path" LIKE '%.ipynb' OR "path" LIKE '%.java' OR "path" LIKE '%.js') AND REGEXP_COUNT("path", '/') > 10 GROUP BY FILE_TYPE ORDER BY FILE_COUNT DESC LIMIT 1

WITH psoriasis_scores AS (SELECT a."targetId", a."score" FROM "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLDIRECT" AS a JOIN "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."DISEASES" AS d ON a."diseaseId" = d."id" WHERE LOWER(d."name") = 'psoriasis'), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG("score") AS mean_score FROM psoriasis_scores) SELECT t."approvedSymbol" AS "OUTPUT" FROM psoriasis_scores AS ps CROSS JOIN mean_calc AS mc JOIN "OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1"."PLATFORM"."TARGETS" AS t ON ps."targetId" = t."id" ORDER BY ABS(ps."score" - mc.mean_score) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH received AS (SELECT "ToUserId" AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") AS upvotes_received FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGEVOTES" GROUP BY "ToUserId" ORDER BY upvotes_received DESC LIMIT 3), given AS (SELECT "FromUserId" AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") AS upvotes_given FROM "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."FORUMMESSAGEVOTES" GROUP BY "FromUserId") SELECT u."UserName" AS "MostUpvotedUserName", r.upvotes_received AS "UpvotesReceived", COALESCE(g.upvotes_given, 0) AS "UpvotesGiven" FROM received AS r JOIN "META_KAGGLE"."META_KAGGLE"."USERS" AS u ON r.user_id = u."Id" LEFT JOIN given AS g ON r.user_id = g.user_id ORDER BY r.upvotes_received DESC

WITH pm10 AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") AS PM10 FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."PM10_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month), pm25_frm AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") AS PM25_FRM FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."PM25_FRM_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month), pm25_nonfrm AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") AS PM25_NONFRM FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."PM25_NONFRM_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month), voc AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") AS CO FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."VOC_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month), so2 AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") * 10 AS SO2 FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."SO2_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month), lead_data AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date_local") AS month, AVG("arithmetic_mean") * 100 AS LEAD FROM "EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."EPA_HISTORICAL_AIR_QUALITY"."LEAD_DAILY_SUMMARY" WHERE "state_name" = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date_local") = 2020 GROUP BY month) SELECT p.month AS MONTH, p.PM10, f.PM25_FRM, n.PM25_NONFRM, v.CO, s.SO2, l.LEAD FROM pm10 AS p JOIN pm25_frm AS f ON p.month = f.month JOIN pm25_nonfrm AS n ON p.month = n.month JOIN voc AS v ON p.month = v.month JOIN so2 AS s ON p.month = s.month JOIN lead_data AS l ON p.month = l.month ORDER BY p.month

WITH living_a_patients AS (SELECT "id" AS patient_id FROM "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."PATIENT" WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH("name"[1], 'family') AS TEXT) LIKE 'A%' AND "deceased" IS NULL), single_condition_patients AS (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) AS patient_id, MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."code", 'coding', '0', 'display') AS TEXT)) AS condition_display, MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."code", 'coding', '0', 'code') AS TEXT)) AS condition_code FROM "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."CONDITION" AS c WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) IN (SELECT patient_id FROM living_a_patients) GROUP BY CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c."code", 'coding', '0', 'code') AS TEXT)) = 1), patient_active_med_counts AS (SELECT sc.patient_id, sc.condition_display, sc.condition_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(mr."medication", 'codeableConcept', 'coding', '0', 'code') AS TEXT)) AS num_active_meds FROM single_condition_patients AS sc JOIN "FHIR_SYNTHEA"."FHIR_SYNTHEA"."MEDICATION_REQUEST" AS mr ON CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(mr."subject", 'patientId') AS TEXT) = sc.patient_id AND mr."status" = 'active' GROUP BY sc.patient_id, sc.condition_display, sc.condition_code), condition_max_meds AS (SELECT condition_display AS "CONDITIONS", condition_code AS "CODES", MAX(num_active_meds) AS max_meds FROM patient_active_med_counts GROUP BY condition_display, condition_code) SELECT "CONDITIONS", "CODES" FROM condition_max_meds ORDER BY max_meds DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT "year" || '-' || "mo" || '-' || "da" AS DATES FROM "NOAA_GSOD"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2009" WHERE "stn" = '723758' AND "mo" = '10' AND "temp" <> 9999.9 ORDER BY "temp" DESC LIMIT 3

WITH user_activity_months AS (/* Get distinct activity months per user, up until Sep 10, 2024 */ SELECT "by" AS user_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP("time")) AS activity_month FROM "HACKER_NEWS"."HACKER_NEWS"."FULL" WHERE NOT "by" IS NULL AND "time" > 0 AND "time" < 2000000000 AND TO_TIMESTAMP("time") <= '2024-09-10' GROUP BY "by", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP("time"))), user_span AS (/* For each user, compute first/last activity month, active month count, and total span */ SELECT user_id, MIN(activity_month) AS first_month, MAX(activity_month) AS last_month, COUNT(DISTINCT activity_month) AS active_months, CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(MAX(activity_month) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MIN(activity_month) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(MAX(activity_month) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MIN(activity_month) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) + 1 AS span_months FROM user_activity_months GROUP BY user_id), qualified_users AS (/* Users who have at least one inactive month within their activity span */ /* i.e., span_months > active_months */ /* AND who became inactive (last_month before September 2024) */ SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, span_months, CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(last_month AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(first_month AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(last_month AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(first_month AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) /* Month number = count of months since first activity month */ /* The month they became inactive is the month AFTER their last activity */ /* 1-indexed: first_month = month 1, so last_month = DATEDIFF + 1 */ /* The inactive month after = DATEDIFF + 2 */ + 2 AS month_number FROM user_span WHERE span_months > active_months /* at least one inactive month in span */ AND last_month < '2024-09-01' /* became inactive (not active in the cutoff month) */) SELECT user_id AS USER_ID, month_number AS MONTH_NUMBER FROM qualified_users ORDER BY month_number DESC LIMIT 1

WITH all_data AS (SELECT "year", "month", "air_temperature", "wetbulb_temperature", "dewpoint_temperature", "sea_surface_temp" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2010" WHERE NOT "air_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "wetbulb_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "dewpoint_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "sea_surface_temp" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "air_temperature", "wetbulb_temperature", "dewpoint_temperature", "sea_surface_temp" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2011" WHERE NOT "air_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "wetbulb_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "dewpoint_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "sea_surface_temp" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "air_temperature", "wetbulb_temperature", "dewpoint_temperature", "sea_surface_temp" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2012" WHERE NOT "air_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "wetbulb_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "dewpoint_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "sea_surface_temp" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "air_temperature", "wetbulb_temperature", "dewpoint_temperature", "sea_surface_temp" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2013" WHERE NOT "air_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "wetbulb_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "dewpoint_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "sea_surface_temp" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "year", "month", "air_temperature", "wetbulb_temperature", "dewpoint_temperature", "sea_surface_temp" FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_ICOADS"."ICOADS_CORE_2014" WHERE NOT "air_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "wetbulb_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "dewpoint_temperature" IS NULL AND NOT "sea_surface_temp" IS NULL), monthly_avgs AS (SELECT "year", "month", AVG("air_temperature") AS avg_air, AVG("wetbulb_temperature") AS avg_wet, AVG("dewpoint_temperature") AS avg_dew, AVG("sea_surface_temp") AS avg_sst FROM all_data GROUP BY "year", "month") SELECT "year", "month", ABS(avg_air - avg_wet) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_wet - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_wet - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dew - avg_sst) AS SUM_OF_DIFFERENCES FROM monthly_avgs ORDER BY SUM_OF_DIFFERENCES ASC LIMIT 3

WITH state_totals AS (SELECT LEFT("CoC_Number", 2) AS "State_Abbr", SUM(CASE WHEN "Count_Year" = 2015 THEN COALESCE("Unsheltered_Homeless", 0) ELSE 0 END) AS unsheltered_2015, SUM(CASE WHEN "Count_Year" = 2018 THEN COALESCE("Unsheltered_Homeless", 0) ELSE 0 END) AS unsheltered_2018 FROM "SDOH"."SDOH_HUD_PIT_HOMELESSNESS"."HUD_PIT_BY_COC" WHERE "Count_Year" IN (2015, 2018) GROUP BY LEFT("CoC_Number", 2) HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "Count_Year" = 2015 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN "Count_Year" = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), pct_changes AS (SELECT "State_Abbr", CAST((unsheltered_2018 - unsheltered_2015) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / unsheltered_2015 AS pct_change FROM state_totals WHERE unsheltered_2015 > 0), national_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_changes) SELECT p."State_Abbr" FROM pct_changes AS p CROSS JOIN national_avg AS n ORDER BY ABS(p.pct_change - n.avg_pct_change) ASC LIMIT 5

WITH sessions AS (SELECT "fullVisitorId", "visitId", "channelGrouping", "geoNetwork_country", SUM(DISTINCT "totals_transactions") AS transactions FROM "ECOMMERCE"."ECOMMERCE"."REV_TRANSACTIONS" GROUP BY "fullVisitorId", "visitId", "channelGrouping", "geoNetwork_country"), qualifying AS (SELECT "channelGrouping" FROM sessions GROUP BY "channelGrouping" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "geoNetwork_country") > 1), country_stats AS (SELECT s."channelGrouping", s."geoNetwork_country", SUM(s.transactions) AS total_transactions FROM sessions AS s JOIN qualifying AS q ON s."channelGrouping" = q."channelGrouping" GROUP BY s."channelGrouping", s."geoNetwork_country"), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "channelGrouping" ORDER BY total_transactions DESC) AS rn FROM country_stats) SELECT "channelGrouping", "geoNetwork_country" AS COUNTRY, total_transactions AS TOTAL_TRANSACTIONS FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "channelGrouping"
