WITH y2014 AS (SELECT "race_asian", "race_black", "race_hispanic_latinx", "race_native_american", "race_white", "gender_us_women", "gender_us_men", "gender_global_women", "gender_global_men" FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."GOOGLE_DEI"."DAR_NON_INTERSECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION" WHERE "workforce" = 'overall' AND "report_year" = 2014), y2024 AS (SELECT "race_asian", "race_black", "race_hispanic_latinx", "race_native_american", "race_white", "gender_us_women", "gender_us_men", "gender_global_women", "gender_global_men" FROM "GOOGLE_DEI"."GOOGLE_DEI"."DAR_NON_INTERSECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION" WHERE "workforce" = 'overall' AND "report_year" = 2024) SELECT CAST((y2024."race_asian" - y2014."race_asian") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."race_asian" AS RACE_ASIAN_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."race_black" - y2014."race_black") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."race_black" AS RACE_BLACK_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."race_hispanic_latinx" - y2014."race_hispanic_latinx") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."race_hispanic_latinx" AS RACE_HISPANIC_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."race_native_american" - y2014."race_native_american") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."race_native_american" AS RACE_NATIVE_AMERICAN_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."race_white" - y2014."race_white") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."race_white" AS RACE_WHITE_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."gender_us_women" - y2014."gender_us_women") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."gender_us_women" AS GENDER_US_WOMEN_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."gender_us_men" - y2014."gender_us_men") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."gender_us_men" AS GENDER_US_MEN_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."gender_global_women" - y2014."gender_global_women") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."gender_global_women" AS GENDER_GLOBAL_WOMEN_GROWTH, CAST((y2024."gender_global_men" - y2014."gender_global_men") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / y2014."gender_global_men" AS GENDER_GLOBAL_MEN_GROWTH FROM y2014 CROSS JOIN y2024

SELECT s."county_name" AS county_name, s."state" AS state, c."median_age" AS median_age, c."total_pop" AS total_pop, (CAST(s."confirmed_cases" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c."total_pop") * 100000 AS CASES_PER_100K, (CAST(s."deaths" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c."total_pop") * 100000 AS DEATHS_PER_100K, (CAST(s."deaths" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(s."confirmed_cases", 0)) * 100 AS CASE_FATALITY_RATE_PERCENT FROM "COVID19_USA"."COVID19_USAFACTS"."SUMMARY" AS s JOIN "COVID19_USA"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."COUNTY_2020_5YR" AS c ON LPAD(c."geo_id", 5, '0') = s."county_fips_code" WHERE s."date" = '2020-08-27' AND c."total_pop" > 50000 AND s."confirmed_cases" > 0 AND s."deaths" > 0 ORDER BY CASE_FATALITY_RATE_PERCENT DESC LIMIT 3

WITH tract_data AS (SELECT LEFT(t17."geo_id", 2) AS state_fips, GREATEST(t17."unemployed_pop" + t17."not_in_labor_force" - t17."group_quarters", 0) AS adj_nonlabor, t17."total_pop", (t18."median_income" - t15."median_income") AS income_diff FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2017_5YR" AS t17 JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2015_5YR" AS t15 ON t17."geo_id" = t15."geo_id" JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2018_5YR" AS t18 ON t17."geo_id" = t18."geo_id"), state_agg AS (SELECT s."state" AS state, SUM(td.income_diff) AS TOTAL_INCOME_CHANGE, SUM(td.adj_nonlabor) AS TOTAL_ADJUSTED_NON_LABOR, AVG(CAST(td.adj_nonlabor AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(td."total_pop", 0)) AS AVG_PROPORTION FROM tract_data AS td JOIN "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."STATES" AS s ON td.state_fips = s."state_fips_code" WHERE NOT td.income_diff IS NULL GROUP BY s."state") SELECT state, TOTAL_INCOME_CHANGE, TOTAL_ADJUSTED_NON_LABOR, AVG_PROPORTION FROM state_agg ORDER BY TOTAL_ADJUSTED_NON_LABOR ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p."journal", 'title') AS TEXT), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p."proceedings_title", 'preferred') AS TEXT), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p."book_title", 'preferred') AS TEXT), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(p."book_series_title", 'preferred') AS TEXT)) AS VENUE FROM "DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19"."DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p, LATERAL UNNEST(input => p."research_orgs") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) INNER JOIN "DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19"."DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19"."GRID" AS g ON CAST(f.value AS TEXT) = g."id" WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(g."address", 'city') AS TEXT) = 'Qianjiang' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(p."date_inserted" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) >= 2021

SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'name') AS TEXT) AS CALL_SET_NAME, COUNT(*) AS HOM_RR_COUNT FROM "HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS"."HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS"."_1000_GENOMES_PHASE_3_VARIANTS_20150220" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(v."alternate_bases", 1) = 1 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) = 0 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) = 0 GROUP BY CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'name') AS TEXT) ORDER BY HOM_RR_COUNT DESC, CALL_SET_NAME ASC LIMIT 10

WITH sorafenib_targets AS (SELECT DISTINCT i."target_uniprotID" AS "uniprot_id" FROM "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."TARGETOME_VERSIONED"."INTERACTIONS_V1" AS i JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."TARGETOME_VERSIONED"."EXPERIMENTS_V1" AS e ON i."expID" = e."expID" WHERE LOWER(i."drugName") LIKE '%sorafenib%' AND i."targetSpecies" = 'Homo sapiens' AND e."exp_assayValueMedian" <= 100 AND (e."exp_assayValueLow" <= 100 OR e."exp_assayValueLow" IS NULL) AND (e."exp_assayValueHigh" <= 100 OR e."exp_assayValueHigh" IS NULL)), universe /* Universe: all distinct non-null uniprot_ids in lowest-level TAS pathways */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT pe."uniprot_id" FROM "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PE_TO_PATHWAY_V77" AS pp JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PATHWAY_V77" AS pw ON pp."pathway_stable_id" = pw."stable_id" JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PHYSICAL_ENTITY_V77" AS pe ON pp."pe_stable_id" = pe."stable_id" WHERE pp."evidence_code" = 'TAS' AND pw."lowest_level" = 'True' AND NOT pe."uniprot_id" IS NULL), pathway_genes /* For each lowest-level TAS pathway, get distinct non-null uniprot_ids */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT pp."pathway_stable_id", pe."uniprot_id" FROM "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PE_TO_PATHWAY_V77" AS pp JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PATHWAY_V77" AS pw ON pp."pathway_stable_id" = pw."stable_id" JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PHYSICAL_ENTITY_V77" AS pe ON pp."pe_stable_id" = pe."stable_id" WHERE pp."evidence_code" = 'TAS' AND pw."lowest_level" = 'True' AND NOT pe."uniprot_id" IS NULL), pathway_counts /* Count per pathway: n (total genes in pathway), k (target genes in pathway) */ AS (SELECT pg."pathway_stable_id", COUNT(DISTINCT pg."uniprot_id") AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT st."uniprot_id" IS NULL THEN pg."uniprot_id" END) AS k FROM pathway_genes AS pg LEFT JOIN sorafenib_targets AS st ON pg."uniprot_id" = st."uniprot_id" GROUP BY pg."pathway_stable_id"), params /* Global parameters */ AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM universe) AS N_val, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM universe AS u INNER JOIN sorafenib_targets AS st ON u."uniprot_id" = st."uniprot_id") AS K_val) SELECT pc."pathway_stable_id" AS PATHWAY_ID, pw."name" AS PATHWAY_NAME, pc.k AS TARGETS_IN_PATHWAY, p.K_val - pc.k AS TARGETS_OUTSIDE_PATHWAY, pc.n - pc.k AS NONTARGETS_IN_PATHWAY, p.N_val - p.K_val - pc.n + pc.k AS NONTARGETS_OUTSIDE_PATHWAY, ROUND(CAST(CAST(CAST(p.N_val AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * POWER(CAST(pc.k AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(p.N_val - p.K_val - pc.n + pc.k AS DOUBLE PRECISION) - CAST(p.K_val - pc.k AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(pc.n - pc.k AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(CAST(p.K_val AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(p.N_val - p.K_val AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(pc.n AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(p.N_val - pc.n AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS CHI_SQUARED FROM pathway_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN params AS p JOIN "TARGETOME_REACTOME"."REACTOME_VERSIONED"."PATHWAY_V77" AS pw ON pc."pathway_stable_id" = pw."stable_id" WHERE pc.k > 0 ORDER BY CHI_SQUARED DESC LIMIT 3

WITH all_storms AS (SELECT "state", 1980 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1980" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1981 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1981" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1982 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1982" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1983 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1983" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1984 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1984" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1985 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1985" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1986 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1986" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1987 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1987" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1988 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1988" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1989 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1989" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1990 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1990" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1991 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1991" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1992 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1992" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1993 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1993" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1994 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1994" UNION ALL SELECT "state", 1995 AS year FROM "NOAA_DATA"."NOAA_HISTORIC_SEVERE_STORMS"."STORMS_1995"), yearly_counts AS (SELECT "state", year, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM all_storms GROUP BY "state", year), ranked_per_year AS (SELECT "state", year, event_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rn FROM yearly_counts), top_1000_per_year AS (SELECT "state", year, event_count FROM ranked_per_year WHERE rn <= 1000), total_across_years AS (SELECT "state" AS state, SUM(event_count) AS TOTAL_EVENTS FROM top_1000_per_year GROUP BY "state") SELECT state, TOTAL_EVENTS FROM total_across_years ORDER BY TOTAL_EVENTS DESC LIMIT 5

WITH rejected_apps AS (SELECT "app_id", MIN("mail_dt") AS first_office_action_date FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_OFFICE_ACTIONS"."OFFICE_ACTIONS" WHERE "rejection_101" = 1 AND "allowed_claims" = 0 GROUP BY "app_id"), app_link AS (SELECT ma."app_id", ma."application_number" FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_OFFICE_ACTIONS"."MATCH_APP" AS ma WHERE NOT ma."application_number" IS NULL), grant_pubs AS (SELECT p."application_number", p."publication_number" AS grant_publication_number, p."grant_date" FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p WHERE p."country_code" = 'US' AND p."grant_date" BETWEEN 20100101 AND 20231231 AND p."kind_code" IN ('B1', 'B2')), granted_claims /* Granted claims word count: independent claims from PATENT_CLAIMS_STATS */ /* Formula: SUM(word_ct) - COUNT(*) to exclude claim number prefix word */ AS (SELECT CAST(cs."appl_id" AS VARCHAR) AS app_id, CAST(cs."pat_no" AS VARCHAR) AS pat_no, SUM(CAST(cs."word_ct" AS INT)) - COUNT(*) AS granted_claims_length_words FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_CLAIMS"."PATENT_CLAIMS_STATS" AS cs WHERE cs."ind_flg" = 1 GROUP BY cs."appl_id", cs."pat_no"), filed_claims /* Filed claims: pre-grant publication claims from PGPUB_CLAIMS_FULLTEXT */ /* Also get pub_no for first_publication_number */ AS (SELECT CAST(pcf."appl_id" AS VARCHAR) AS app_id, pcf."pub_no", SUM(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(TRIM(pcf."claim_txt"), ' '), 1)) - COUNT(*) AS filed_claims_length_words FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."USPTO_OCE_CLAIMS"."PGPUB_CLAIMS_FULLTEXT" AS pcf WHERE pcf."ind_flg" = '1' GROUP BY pcf."appl_id", pcf."pub_no"), first_pub_a1 /* Get the A1 (pre-grant) publication date from PUBLICATIONS if it exists */ AS (SELECT p."application_number", p."publication_number" AS first_publication_number, p."publication_date" AS first_publication_date FROM "PATENTS_USPTO"."PATENTS"."PUBLICATIONS" AS p WHERE p."country_code" = 'US' AND p."kind_code" IN ('A1', 'A2')) SELECT gp.grant_publication_number, gp."grant_date" AS grant_date, gc.granted_claims_length_words, COALESCE(CASE WHEN NOT fc."pub_no" IS NULL THEN 'US-' || fc."pub_no" || '-A1' END, gp.grant_publication_number) AS first_publication_number, fpa.first_publication_date AS first_publication_date, fc.filed_claims_length_words, ra.first_office_action_date FROM rejected_apps AS ra JOIN app_link AS al ON ra."app_id" = al."app_id" JOIN grant_pubs AS gp ON al."application_number" = gp."application_number" JOIN granted_claims AS gc ON ra."app_id" = gc.app_id LEFT JOIN filed_claims AS fc ON ra."app_id" = fc.app_id LEFT JOIN first_pub_a1 AS fpa ON al."application_number" = fpa."application_number" ORDER BY gc.granted_claims_length_words DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT cs."creative_page_url" AS OUTPUT FROM "GOOGLE_ADS"."GOOGLE_ADS_TRANSPARENCY_CENTER"."CREATIVE_STATS" AS cs, LATERAL UNNEST(input => cs."region_stats") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE cs."ad_format_type" = 'IMAGE' AND cs."topic" = 'Health' AND cs."advertiser_verification_status" = 'VERIFIED' AND cs."advertiser_location" = 'CY' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(cs."audience_selection_approach_info", 'contextual_signals') AS TEXT) <> 'CRITERIA_UNUSED' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(cs."audience_selection_approach_info", 'customer_lists') AS TEXT) <> 'CRITERIA_UNUSED' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(cs."audience_selection_approach_info", 'demographic_info') AS TEXT) <> 'CRITERIA_UNUSED' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(cs."audience_selection_approach_info", 'geo_location') AS TEXT) <> 'CRITERIA_UNUSED' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(cs."audience_selection_approach_info", 'topics_of_interest') AS TEXT) <> 'CRITERIA_UNUSED' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'region_code') AS TEXT) = 'HR' AND JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'times_shown_availability_date') IS NULL AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'first_shown') AS DATE) > '2023-01-01' AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'last_shown') AS DATE) < '2024-01-01' ORDER BY CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'times_shown_upper_bound') AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH molecule_products AS (SELECT md."chembl_id" AS MOLECULE_CHEMBL_ID, p."trade_name", p."approval_date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY md."chembl_id" ORDER BY p."approval_date" DESC, p."trade_name" ASC) AS rn FROM "EBI_CHEMBL"."EBI_CHEMBL"."RESEARCH_COMPANIES_23" AS rc JOIN "EBI_CHEMBL"."EBI_CHEMBL"."MOLECULE_SYNONYMS_23" AS ms ON rc."res_stem_id" = ms."res_stem_id" JOIN "EBI_CHEMBL"."EBI_CHEMBL"."MOLECULE_DICTIONARY_23" AS md ON ms."molregno" = md."molregno" JOIN "EBI_CHEMBL"."EBI_CHEMBL"."FORMULATIONS_23" AS f ON md."molregno" = f."molregno" JOIN "EBI_CHEMBL"."EBI_CHEMBL"."PRODUCTS_23" AS p ON f."product_id" = p."product_id" WHERE rc."company" = 'SanofiAventis') SELECT MOLECULE_CHEMBL_ID, "trade_name", "approval_date" AS LATEST_APPROVAL_DATE FROM molecule_products WHERE rn = 1

WITH zip_geom AS (SELECT CAST("zip_code_geom" AS GEOGRAPHY) AS geom FROM "NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1"."GEO_US_BOUNDARIES"."ZIP_CODES" WHERE "zip_code" = '10019'), trips_in_zip AS (SELECT t."usertype", TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS trip_ts, LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS trip_mo, LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS trip_da FROM "NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1"."NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE"."CITIBIKE_TRIPS" AS t CROSS JOIN zip_geom AS z WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."starttime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000)) = 2018 AND NOT t."usertype" IS NULL AND ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(t."start_station_longitude", t."start_station_latitude"), z.geom) AND ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(t."end_station_longitude", t."end_station_latitude"), z.geom)), trip_weather AS (SELECT tr."usertype", w."prcp", w."wdsp", w."temp" FROM trips_in_zip AS tr JOIN "NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1"."NOAA_GSOD"."GSOD2018" AS w ON w."stn" = '725053' AND w."wban" = '94728' AND w."mo" = tr.trip_mo AND w."da" = tr.trip_da), user_avgs AS (SELECT "usertype", AVG("prcp") AS AVG_PRECIPITATION, AVG("wdsp") AS AVG_WIND_SPEED, AVG("temp") AS AVG_TEMPERATURE FROM trip_weather GROUP BY "usertype") SELECT "usertype", AVG_PRECIPITATION, AVG_WIND_SPEED, AVG_TEMPERATURE FROM user_avgs ORDER BY AVG_TEMPERATURE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "shot_type", AVG(CASE WHEN "event_coord_x" < 564 THEN "event_coord_x" ELSE 1128 - "event_coord_x" END) AS AVG_X, AVG(CASE WHEN "event_coord_x" < 564 THEN 600 - "event_coord_y" ELSE "event_coord_y" END) AS AVG_Y, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT "game_id") AS AVG_ATTEMPTS, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "shot_made" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT "game_id") AS AVG_SUCCESSES FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_PBP_SR" WHERE NOT "shot_type" IS NULL AND NOT "event_coord_x" IS NULL AND NOT "event_coord_y" IS NULL AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST("scheduled_date" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000000) AS DATE) < '2018-03-15' AND (("team_basket" = 'left' AND "event_coord_x" < 564) OR ("team_basket" = 'right' AND "event_coord_x" >= 564)) GROUP BY "shot_type" ORDER BY "shot_type"

WITH top_markets AS (/* Find top 5 team markets by distinct players scoring >=15 points in period 2 */ SELECT "team_market" FROM (SELECT "game_id", "team_market", "player_full_name", SUM("points_scored") AS total_points FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_PBP_SR" WHERE "period" = 2 AND "season" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018 GROUP BY "game_id", "team_market", "player_full_name" HAVING SUM("points_scored") >= 15) GROUP BY "team_market" ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "player_full_name") DESC LIMIT 5), win_rows /* Unpivot historical tournament games: winner side */ AS (SELECT h."season", h."round", h."days_from_epoch", h."game_date", h."day", 'win' AS "label", h."win_seed" AS "seed", h."win_market" AS "market", h."win_name" AS "name", h."win_alias" AS "alias", h."win_school_ncaa" AS "school_ncaa", h."lose_seed" AS "opponent_seed", h."lose_market" AS "opponent_market", h."lose_name" AS "opponent_name", h."lose_alias" AS "opponent_alias", h."lose_school_ncaa" AS "opponent_school_ncaa" FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TOURNAMENT_GAMES" AS h WHERE h."season" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018), lose_rows /* Unpivot historical tournament games: loser side */ AS (SELECT h."season", h."round", h."days_from_epoch", h."game_date", h."day", 'loss' AS "label", h."lose_seed" AS "seed", h."lose_market" AS "market", h."lose_name" AS "name", h."lose_alias" AS "alias", h."lose_school_ncaa" AS "school_ncaa", h."win_seed" AS "opponent_seed", h."win_market" AS "opponent_market", h."win_name" AS "opponent_name", h."win_alias" AS "opponent_alias", h."win_school_ncaa" AS "opponent_school_ncaa" FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_HISTORICAL_TOURNAMENT_GAMES" AS h WHERE h."season" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018), all_games /* Combine both sides */ AS (SELECT * FROM win_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lose_rows) SELECT g."season", g."round", g."days_from_epoch", g."game_date", g."day", g."label", g."seed", g."market", g."name", g."alias", g."school_ncaa", g."opponent_seed", g."opponent_market", g."opponent_name", g."opponent_alias", g."opponent_school_ncaa" FROM all_games AS g INNER JOIN top_markets AS tm ON g."market" = tm."team_market" ORDER BY g."market", g."season", g."round" DESC

SELECT "report_number", SPLIT("reactions", ', ') AS "REACTIONS", SPLIT("outcomes", ', ') AS "OUTCOMES", REPLACE("products_brand_name", ', ', ' -- ') AS "PRODUCTS_BRAND_NAME", REPLACE("products_industry_code", ', ', ' -- ') AS "PRODUCTS_INDUSTRY_CODE", "products_role" AS "PRODUCTS_ROLE", REPLACE("products_industry_name", ', ', ' -- ') AS "PRODUCTS_INDUSTRY_NAME", "date_created", "date_started", "consumer_gender", "consumer_age", "consumer_age_unit", ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(REPLACE("products_industry_code", ', ', ' -- '), ' -- '), 1) AS "INDUSTRY_CODE_LENGTH", ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(REPLACE("products_brand_name", ', ', ' -- '), ' -- '), 1) AS "BRAND_NAME_LENGTH" FROM "FDA"."FDA_FOOD"."FOOD_EVENTS" WHERE "date_started" >= '2015-01-01' AND "date_started" < '2015-02-01' AND "date_created" >= '2015-01-01' AND "date_created" < '2015-02-01'

SELECT a."consecutive_number" AS "consecutive_number", a."county" AS "county", a."type_of_intersection" AS "type_of_intersection", a."light_condition" AS "light_condition", a."atmospheric_conditions_1" AS "atmospheric_conditions_1", a."hour_of_crash" AS "hour_of_crash", a."functional_system" AS "functional_system", a."related_factors_crash_level_1" AS "RELATED_FACTORS", CASE WHEN NOT a."hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital" IN (88, 99) THEN CAST(a."hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital" - a."hour_of_crash" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE NULL END AS "DELAY_TO_HOSPITAL", CASE WHEN NOT a."hour_of_arrival_at_scene" IN (88, 99) THEN CAST(a."hour_of_arrival_at_scene" - a."hour_of_crash" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE NULL END AS "DELAY_TO_SCENE", p."age" AS "age", p."person_type" AS "person_type", p."seating_position" AS "seating_position", CASE WHEN p."restraint_system_helmet_use" = 0 THEN 0.00 WHEN p."restraint_system_helmet_use" = 1 THEN 0.33 WHEN p."restraint_system_helmet_use" = 2 THEN 0.67 WHEN p."restraint_system_helmet_use" = 3 THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.50 END AS "RESTRAINT", CASE WHEN p."injury_severity" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "SURVIVED", CASE WHEN v."rollover" = 'No Rollover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "ROLLOVER", CASE WHEN p."air_bag_deployed" BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "AIRBAG", CASE WHEN p."police_reported_alcohol_involvement" LIKE 'Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "ALCOHOL", CASE WHEN p."police_reported_drug_involvement" LIKE 'Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "DRUGS", p."related_factors_person_level1" AS "related_factors_person_level1", v."travel_speed" AS "travel_speed", CASE WHEN v."speeding_related" LIKE 'Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "SPEEDING_RELATED", v."extent_of_damage" AS "extent_of_damage", v."body_type" AS "body_type", v."vehicle_removal" AS "vehicle_removal", LEAST(v."manner_of_collision", 11) AS "MANNER_OF_COLLISION", CASE WHEN v."roadway_surface_condition" > 11 THEN 8 ELSE v."roadway_surface_condition" END AS "ROADWAY_SURFACE_CONDITION", CASE WHEN v."first_harmful_event" >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE v."first_harmful_event" END AS "FIRST_HARMFUL_EVENT", CASE WHEN v."most_harmful_event" >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE v."most_harmful_event" END AS "MOST_HARMFUL_EVENT" FROM "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."PERSON_2015" AS p JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."ACCIDENT_2015" AS a ON p."consecutive_number" = a."consecutive_number" JOIN "NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES"."VEHICLE_2015" AS v ON p."consecutive_number" = v."consecutive_number" AND p."vehicle_number" = v."vehicle_number"

SELECT t."OrderID" AS TRADEID, TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(t."TransactTime" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(10, 6)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') || ' UTC' AS TRADETIMESTAMP, CASE WHEN LEFT(t."TargetCompID", 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum' WHEN LEFT(t."TargetCompID", 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky' WHEN LEFT(t."TargetCompID", 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction' END AS ALGORITHM, t."Symbol" AS SYMBOL, t."LastPx" AS OPENPRICE, t."StrikePrice" AS CLOSEPRICE, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'Side') AS TEXT) AS TRADEDIRECTION, CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'Side') AS TEXT) = 'SHORT' THEN -1 WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'Side') AS TEXT) = 'LONG' THEN 1 END AS TRADEMULTIPLIER FROM "CYMBAL_INVESTMENTS"."CYMBAL_INVESTMENTS"."TRADE_CAPTURE_REPORT" AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."Sides") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) ORDER BY t."StrikePrice" DESC, t."TransactTime" DESC LIMIT 6

WITH brca1_region AS (/* Step 1: Find the smallest start and largest end position for BRCA1 variants */ SELECT MIN(t."start_position") AS gene_start, MAX(t."end_position") AS gene_end FROM "GNOMAD"."GNOMAD"."V2_1_1_GENOMES__CHR17" AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."alternate_bases") AS ab(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(ab.value, 'vep')) AS v(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(v.value, 'SYMBOL') AS TEXT) = 'BRCA1') /* Step 2: For variants in that region, get Protein_position where Consequence includes missense_variant */ SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(v.value, 'Protein_position') AS TEXT) AS PROTEIN_POSITION FROM "GNOMAD"."GNOMAD"."V2_1_1_GENOMES__CHR17" AS t, LATERAL UNNEST(input => t."alternate_bases") AS ab(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), LATERAL UNNEST(input => JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(ab.value, 'vep')) AS v(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS), brca1_region AS r WHERE t."start_position" >= r.gene_start AND t."end_position" <= r.gene_end AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(v.value, 'Consequence') AS TEXT) LIKE '%missense_variant%' AND NOT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(v.value, 'Protein_position') AS TEXT) IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(v.value, 'Protein_position') AS TEXT) AS INT) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH genotype_calls AS (SELECT CAST(c.value['call_set_name'] AS TEXT) AS call_set_name, CAST(c.value['genotype'][1] AS INT) AS allele0, CAST(c.value['genotype'][2] AS INT) AS allele1 FROM "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."VARIANTS" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE v."reference_name" = 'X' AND v."VT" = 'SNP' AND NOT (v."start" BETWEEN 59999 AND 2699519) AND NOT (v."start" BETWEEN 154931042 AND 155260559) AND ARRAY_LENGTH(c.value['genotype'], 1) >= 2), classified AS (SELECT call_set_name, CASE WHEN allele0 = 0 AND allele1 = 0 THEN 'hom_ref' WHEN allele0 = allele1 AND allele0 > 0 THEN 'hom_alt' WHEN allele0 <> allele1 AND (allele0 > 0 OR allele1 > 0) THEN 'het' ELSE 'other' END AS genotype_class FROM genotype_calls), aggregated AS (SELECT call_set_name AS CALL_SET_NAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CALLABLE_SITES, SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class = 'hom_ref' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOMOZYGOUS_REFERENCE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class = 'hom_alt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOMOZYGOUS_ALTERNATE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class = 'het' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HETEROZYGOUS_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class IN ('hom_alt', 'het') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_SNVS, ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class = 'het' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class IN ('hom_alt', 'het') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS PERCENTAGE_HETEROZYGOUS_AMONG_SNVS, ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class = 'hom_alt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN genotype_class IN ('hom_alt', 'het') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS PERCENTAGE_HOMOZYGOUS_ALTERNATE_AMONG_SNVS FROM classified GROUP BY call_set_name) SELECT * FROM aggregated ORDER BY PERCENTAGE_HETEROZYGOUS_AMONG_SNVS DESC, CALL_SET_NAME ASC

WITH allele_counts AS (SELECT v."start" AS start_pos, v."end" AS end_pos, SUM(CASE WHEN s."Super_Population" = 'EAS' THEN 2 - (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) + CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT)) ELSE 0 END) AS case_ref, SUM(CASE WHEN s."Super_Population" = 'EAS' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) + CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) ELSE 0 END) AS case_alt, SUM(CASE WHEN s."Super_Population" <> 'EAS' THEN 2 - (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) + CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT)) ELSE 0 END) AS ctrl_ref, SUM(CASE WHEN s."Super_Population" <> 'EAS' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) + CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) ELSE 0 END) AS ctrl_alt FROM "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."VARIANTS" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) JOIN "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."SAMPLE_INFO" AS s ON CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'call_set_name') AS TEXT) = s."Sample" WHERE v."reference_name" = '12' GROUP BY v."start", v."end"), chi_calc AS (SELECT start_pos AS "start", end_pos AS "end", case_ref AS a, case_alt AS b, ctrl_ref AS c, ctrl_alt AS d, (case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS N, (case_ref + case_alt) AS R1 /* Row totals */, (ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS R2, (case_ref + ctrl_ref) AS C1 /* Column totals */, (case_alt + ctrl_alt) AS C2, CAST(((case_ref + case_alt) * (case_ref + ctrl_ref)) /* Expected counts */ * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS E_a, CAST(((case_ref + case_alt) * (case_alt + ctrl_alt)) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS E_b, CAST(((ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) * (case_ref + ctrl_ref)) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS E_c, CAST(((ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) * (case_alt + ctrl_alt)) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS E_d, CAST((case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) /* Chi-squared with Yates correction */ * POWER(ABS(case_ref * ctrl_alt - case_alt * ctrl_ref) - CAST((case_ref + case_alt + ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 2.0, 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((case_ref + case_alt) * 1.0 * (ctrl_ref + ctrl_alt) * (case_ref + ctrl_ref) * (case_alt + ctrl_alt), 0) AS "CHI2" FROM allele_counts) SELECT "start", "end", "CHI2" FROM chi_calc WHERE E_a >= 5 AND E_b >= 5 AND E_c >= 5 AND E_d >= 5 AND "CHI2" >= 29.71679 ORDER BY "CHI2" DESC

WITH genotype_counts AS (SELECT v."reference_name", v."start", v."end", v."reference_bases", v."alternate_bases" AS DISTINCT_ALTERNATE_BASES, v."VT" AS VARIANT_TYPE, v."AF" AS KG_OVERALL_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, v."AFR_AF", v."EUR_AF", v."AMR_AF", v."ASN_AF", COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_GENOTYPES, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) = 0 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OBS_HOM_REF, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) = 0 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) = 1) OR (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) = 1 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OBS_HET, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) = 1 AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OBS_HOM_ALT FROM "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."VARIANTS" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE v."reference_name" = '17' AND v."start" >= 41196311 AND v."start" <= 41277499 GROUP BY v."reference_name", v."start", v."end", v."reference_bases", v."alternate_bases", v."VT", v."AF", v."AFR_AF", v."EUR_AF", v."AMR_AF", v."ASN_AF"), hwe_calc AS (SELECT "reference_name", "start", "end", "reference_bases", DISTINCT_ALTERNATE_BASES, VARIANT_TYPE, TOTAL_GENOTYPES, OBS_HOM_REF, OBS_HET, OBS_HOM_ALT, CAST((2.0 * OBS_HOM_REF + OBS_HET) /* Compute allele frequencies from observed genotype counts */ AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (2.0 * TOTAL_GENOTYPES) AS COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ, CAST((2.0 * OBS_HOM_ALT + OBS_HET) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (2.0 * TOTAL_GENOTYPES) AS COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, KG_OVERALL_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, AFR_AF, EUR_AF, AMR_AF, ASN_AF FROM genotype_counts) SELECT "reference_name", "start", "end", "reference_bases", DISTINCT_ALTERNATE_BASES, VARIANT_TYPE, CAST(POWER(OBS_HOM_REF - (POWER(COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES), 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (POWER(COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES) + CAST(POWER(OBS_HET - (2.0 * COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ * COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ * TOTAL_GENOTYPES), 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (2.0 * COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ * COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ * TOTAL_GENOTYPES) + CAST(POWER(OBS_HOM_ALT - (POWER(COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES), 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (POWER(COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES) AS HWE_CHI_SQUARED, TOTAL_GENOTYPES, OBS_HOM_REF, OBS_HET, OBS_HOM_ALT, POWER(COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES AS EXP_HOM_REF, 2.0 * COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ * COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ * TOTAL_GENOTYPES AS EXP_HET, POWER(COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, 2) * TOTAL_GENOTYPES AS EXP_HOM_ALT, COMPUTED_REF_ALLELE_FREQ, COMPUTED_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, KG_OVERALL_ALT_ALLELE_FREQ, AFR_AF, EUR_AF, AMR_AF, ASN_AF FROM hwe_calc ORDER BY "start"

WITH pop_sizes AS (/* Total population size per super population from PEDIGREE */ SELECT s."Super_Population", s."Super_Population_Description", COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_POPULATION_SIZE FROM "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."PEDIGREE" AS p JOIN "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."SAMPLE_INFO" AS s ON p."Individual_ID" = s."Sample" GROUP BY s."Super_Population", s."Super_Population_Description"), variant_sample_superpop AS (/* Flatten call array, join with SAMPLE_INFO, filter autosomal + common + alt allele */ SELECT v."reference_name", v."start", v."end", s."Super_Population", CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'call_set_name') AS TEXT) AS sample_name FROM "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."VARIANTS" AS v, LATERAL UNNEST(input => v."call") AS c(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) JOIN "_1000_GENOMES"."_1000_GENOMES"."SAMPLE_INFO" AS s ON CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'call_set_name') AS TEXT) = s."Sample" WHERE NOT v."reference_name" IN ('X', 'Y', 'MT') AND v."AF" >= 0.05 AND (CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '0') AS INT) > 0 OR CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(c.value, 'genotype', '1') AS INT) > 0)), samples_per_variant_superpop AS (/* Count how many samples per super pop have each variant */ SELECT "Super_Population", "reference_name", "start", "end", COUNT(*) AS num_samples FROM variant_sample_superpop GROUP BY "Super_Population", "reference_name", "start", "end"), variant_sharing AS (/* Count how many variants are shared by each number of samples per super pop */ SELECT "Super_Population", num_samples AS SAMPLES_WITH_VARIANT, COUNT(*) AS VARIANT_COUNT FROM samples_per_variant_superpop GROUP BY "Super_Population", num_samples) SELECT vs."Super_Population", ps."Super_Population_Description", ps.TOTAL_POPULATION_SIZE, 'Yes' AS IS_COMMON_VARIANT, vs.SAMPLES_WITH_VARIANT, vs.VARIANT_COUNT FROM variant_sharing AS vs JOIN pop_sizes AS ps ON vs."Super_Population" = ps."Super_Population" ORDER BY vs."Super_Population", vs.SAMPLES_WITH_VARIANT

MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(qm."Quantity", 'CodeMeaning') AS TEXT) = 'Elongation' THEN qm."Value" END) AS "Elongation", MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(qm."Quantity", 'CodeMeaning') AS CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(qm."Quantity", 'CodeMeaning') AS TEXT) = 'Volume from Voxel Summation' THEN qm."Value" END) AS "Volume_from_Voxel_Summation", MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(qm."Quantity", 'CodeMeaning') AS TEXT) = 'Volume of Mesh' THEN qm."Value" END) AS "Volume_of_Mesh" FROM "IDC"."IDC_V17"."DICOM_ALL" AS da JOIN "IDC"."IDC_V17"."QUANTITATIVE_MEASUREMENTS" AS qm ON WITH stopwords AS (SELECT word FROM (VALUES ('a'), ('about'), ('above'), ('after'), ('again'), ('against'), ('ain'), ('all'), ('am'), ('an'), ('and'), ('any'), ('are'), ('aren'), ('arent'), ('as'), ('have'), ('haven'), ('havent'), ('having'), ('he'), ('her'), ('here'), ('hers'), ('herself'), ('him'), ('himself'), ('his'), ('how'), ('i'), ('if'), ('in'), ('into'), ('is'), ('isn'), ('isnt'), ('it'), ('its'), ('itself'), ('just'), ('ll'), ('m'), ('ma'), ('me'), ('mightn'), ('mightnt'), ('more'), ('most'), ('mustn'), ('mustnt'), ('my'), ('myself'), ('needn'), ('neednt'), ('no'), ('nor'), ('then'), ('there'), ('these'), ('they'), ('this'), ('those'), ('through'), ('to'), ('too'), ('under'), ('until'), ('up'), ('ve'), ('very'), ('was'), ('wasn'), ('wasnt'), ('we'), ('were'), ('weren'), ('werent'), ('what'), ('when'), ('where'), ('which'), ('while'), ('who'), ('whom'), ('why'), ('will'), ('with'), ('won'), ('wont'), ('wouldn'), ('wouldnt'), ('y'), ('you'), ('youd'), ('youll'), ('your'), ('youre'), ('yours'), ('yourself'), ('yourselves'), ('youve')) AS t(word)), target_tokens /* Step 1: Compute the target article's normalized vector */ AS (SELECT LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT)) AS word, COUNT(*) AS word_cnt FROM "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."NATURE" AS n, LATERAL UNNEST(input => REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(n."body", '''s([^a-zA-Z0-9_])', '\1', 'g'), '''', '', 'g'), '[a-zA-Z0-9_]+', 0)) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE n."id" = '8a78ef2d-d5f7-4d2d-9b47-5adb25cbd373' AND LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT)) <> ALL (SELECT word FROM stopwords) GROUP BY LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT))), target_weighted AS (SELECT vi.INDEX AS dim_idx, SUM(CAST(CAST(vi.VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * tt.word_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(wf."frequency", 0.4)) AS weighted_sum FROM target_tokens AS tt JOIN "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."GLOVE_VECTORS" AS g ON tt.word = g."word" JOIN "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_FREQUENCIES" AS wf ON tt.word = wf."word", LATERAL UNNEST(input => g."vector") AS vi(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) GROUP BY vi.INDEX), target_mag AS (SELECT SQRT(SUM(weighted_sum * weighted_sum)) AS magnitude FROM target_weighted), target_norm AS (SELECT tw.dim_idx, CAST(tw.weighted_sum AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tm.magnitude AS norm_val FROM target_weighted AS tw CROSS JOIN target_mag AS tm), all_tokens /* Step 2: Tokenize all other articles, lowercase tokens, aggregate by (article, word) */ AS (SELECT n."id", n."date", n."title", LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT)) AS word, COUNT(*) AS word_cnt FROM "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."NATURE" AS n, LATERAL UNNEST(input => REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(n."body", '''s([^a-zA-Z0-9_])', '\1', 'g'), '''', '', 'g'), '[a-zA-Z0-9_]+', 0)) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE n."id" <> '8a78ef2d-d5f7-4d2d-9b47-5adb25cbd373' AND LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT)) <> ALL (SELECT word FROM stopwords) GROUP BY n."id", n."date", n."title", LOWER(CAST(f.VALUE AS TEXT))), article_components /* Step 3: Flatten vectors, compute weighted sums per article per dimension */ AS (SELECT at."id", at."date", at."title", vi.INDEX AS dim_idx, SUM(CAST(CAST(vi.VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * at.word_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / POWER(wf."frequency", 0.4)) AS weighted_sum FROM all_tokens AS at JOIN "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."GLOVE_VECTORS" AS g ON at.word = g."word" JOIN "WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_VECTORS_US"."WORD_FREQUENCIES" AS wf ON at.word = wf."word", LATERAL UNNEST(input => g."vector") AS vi(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) GROUP BY at."id", at."date", at."title", vi.INDEX), article_stats /* Step 4: Compute dot product with target and magnitude for each article */ AS (SELECT ac."id", ac."date", ac."title", SUM(ac.weighted_sum * tn.norm_val) AS dot_product, SQRT(SUM(ac.weighted_sum * ac.weighted_sum)) AS magnitude FROM article_components AS ac JOIN target_norm AS tn ON ac.dim_idx = tn.dim_idx GROUP BY ac."id", ac."date", ac."title") /* Step 5: Cosine similarity = dot_product / magnitude (target already unit-normalized) */ SELECT "id", "date", "title", CAST(dot_product AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / magnitude AS "COSINE_SIMILARITY" FROM article_stats WHERE magnitude > 0 ORDER BY "COSINE_SIMILARITY" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH scoring_plays AS (SELECT "game_clock", "period", "elapsed_time_sec", "event_id", "event_description", "points_scored", "team_name", "home_name", "away_name" FROM "NCAA_BASKETBALL"."NCAA_BASKETBALL"."MBB_PBP_SR" WHERE "season" = 2014 AND "home_name" = 'Wildcats' AND "away_name" = 'Fighting Irish' AND "points_scored" > 0), cumulative AS (SELECT "game_clock", NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "team_name" = "home_name" THEN "points_scored" ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY "elapsed_time_sec", "points_scored" DESC, "event_description" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS "WILDCATS_SCORE", NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "team_name" = "away_name" THEN "points_scored" ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY "elapsed_time_sec", "points_scored" DESC, "event_description" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS "FIGHTING_IRISH_SCORE", "team_name", "event_description", "elapsed_time_sec", "points_scored" FROM scoring_plays) SELECT "game_clock", "WILDCATS_SCORE", "FIGHTING_IRISH_SCORE", "team_name", "event_description" FROM cumulative ORDER BY "elapsed_time_sec", "points_scored" DESC, "event_description"

CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("event_date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) AS event_dt FROM "FIREBASE"."ANALYTICS_153293282"."EVENTS_20181001" UNION ALL SELECT "user_pseudo_id", "event_name", CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("event_date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) AS event_dt FROM "FIREBASE"."ANALYTICS_153293282"."EVENTS_20181002" UNION ALL SELECT "user_pseudo_id", "event_name", CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("event_date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE) AS event_dt FROM "FIREBASE"."ANALYTICS_153293282"."EVENTS_20181003"), new_users /* Users who had first_open event - these are NEW users */ AS (SELECT "user_pseudo_id", MIN(event_dt) AS first_open_date FROM all_events WHERE "event_name" = 'first_open' GROUP BY "user_pseudo_id"), cohorts /* Assign cohort week (Monday of the week containing first_open_date) */ AS (SELECT "user_pseudo_id", first_open_date, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', first_open_date) AS cohort_week FROM new_users WHERE first_open_date >= '2018-07-02'), user_activity /* Get all distinct user-date combinations for return visits */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT "user_pseudo_id", event_dt FROM all_events), retention /* Calculate retention for each cohort - 4th week = days 22-28 */ AS (SELECT c.cohort_week, COUNT(DISTINCT c."user_pseudo_id") AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CAST(ua.event_dt AS DATE) - CAST(c.first_open_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 22 AND 28 THEN c."user_pseudo_id" END) AS retained_users FROM cohorts AS c LEFT JOIN user_activity AS ua ON c."user_pseudo_id" = ua."user_pseudo_id" AND ua.event_dt > c.first_open_date GROUP BY c.cohort_week) SELECT TO_CHAR(cohort_week, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS COHORT_WEEK FROM retention WHERE cohort_size > 0 ORDER BY (CAST(retained_users * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cohort_size) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH event_data AS (SELECT e."USER_PSEUDO_ID", e."EVENT_TIMESTAMP", MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value', 'int_value') AS TEXT) END) AS session_id, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'page_title' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value', 'string_value') AS TEXT) END) AS page_title, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'entrances' THEN JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value', 'int_value') END) AS entrances FROM "GA4"."GA4_OBFUSCATED_SAMPLE_ECOMMERCE"."EVENTS_20210102" AS e, LATERAL UNNEST(input => e."EVENT_PARAMS") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE e."EVENT_NAME" = 'page_view' GROUP BY e."USER_PSEUDO_ID", e."EVENT_TIMESTAMP"), session_summary AS (SELECT USER_PSEUDO_ID, session_id, MAX(CASE WHEN entrances = 1 AND page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_on_home, MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_home, MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_checkout FROM event_data GROUP BY USER_PSEUDO_ID, session_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN landed_on_home = 1 AND has_home = 1 AND has_checkout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(landed_on_home), 0), 6) AS CONVERSION_RATE FROM session_summary

WITH page_events AS (SELECT e."EVENT_TIMESTAMP", MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'page_title' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value', 'string_value') AS TEXT) END) AS page_title, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'key') AS TEXT) = 'page_location' THEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_PATH(f.value, 'value', 'string_value') AS TEXT) END) AS page_location FROM "GA4"."GA4_OBFUSCATED_SAMPLE_ECOMMERCE"."EVENTS_20210128" AS e, LATERAL UNNEST(input => e."EVENT_PARAMS") AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE e."USER_PSEUDO_ID" = '1362228.4966015575' AND e."EVENT_NAME" = 'page_view' GROUP BY e."EVENT_TIMESTAMP"), classified AS (SELECT "EVENT_TIMESTAMP", CASE WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/'), 1) >= 5 AND CONTAINS(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/'), 1)), '+') AND (REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 5), '+', ' ') IN ('Accessories', 'Apparel', 'Brands', 'Campus Collection', 'Drinkware', 'Electronics', 'Google Redesign', 'Lifestyle', 'Nest', 'New 2015 Logo', 'Notebooks Journals', 'Office', 'Shop by Brand', 'Small Goods', 'Stationery', 'Wearables') OR REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 6), '+', ' ') IN ('Accessories', 'Apparel', 'Brands', 'Campus Collection', 'Drinkware', 'Electronics', 'Google Redesign', 'Lifestyle', 'Nest', 'New 2015 Logo', 'Notebooks Journals', 'Office', 'Shop by Brand', 'Small Goods', 'Stationery', 'Wearables')) THEN 'PDP' WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/'), 1) >= 5 AND NOT CONTAINS(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 5), '+') AND NOT CONTAINS(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 6), '+') AND (REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 5), '+', ' ') IN ('Accessories', 'Apparel', 'Brands', 'Campus Collection', 'Drinkware', 'Electronics', 'Google Redesign', 'Lifestyle', 'Nest', 'New 2015 Logo', 'Notebooks Journals', 'Office', 'Shop by Brand', 'Small Goods', 'Stationery', 'Wearables') OR REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(page_location, '/', 6), '+', ' ') IN ('Accessories', 'Apparel', 'Brands', 'Campus Collection', 'Drinkware', 'Electronics', 'Google Redesign', 'Lifestyle', 'Nest', 'New 2015 Logo', 'Notebooks Journals', 'Office', 'Shop by Brand', 'Small Goods', 'Stationery', 'Wearables')) THEN 'PLP' ELSE page_title END AS display_name FROM page_events), ordered AS (SELECT display_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "EVENT_TIMESTAMP") AS rn, LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY "EVENT_TIMESTAMP") AS prev_name FROM classified), deduped AS (SELECT display_name, rn FROM ordered WHERE prev_name IS NULL OR display_name <> prev_name) SELECT STRING_AGG(display_name, '>>' ORDER BY rn) AS SCREENS_ON_A_VISIT FROM deduped

/* sf_local002: 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales (price) */ /* Using simple linear regression on daily toy sales from 2017-01-01 to 2018-08-29 */ /* Predictions for Dec 5-8, 2018, then sum the 4 moving averages */ WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT CAST(o."order_purchase_timestamp" AS DATE) AS sale_date, SUM(CAST(oi."price" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS sum_price FROM "E_COMMERCE"."E_COMMERCE"."ORDERS" AS o JOIN "E_COMMERCE"."E_COMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON o."order_id" = oi."order_id" JOIN "E_COMMERCE"."E_COMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id" WHERE p."product_category_name" = 'brinquedos' AND CAST(o."order_purchase_timestamp" AS DATE) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29' GROUP BY CAST(o."order_purchase_timestamp" AS DATE)), all_dates AS (SELECT CAST('2017-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * SEQ4() AS DATE) AS sale_date FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(606))), full_data AS (SELECT a.sale_date, (CAST(a.sale_date AS DATE) - CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE)) + 1 AS day_num, COALESCE(d.sum_price, 0) AS y FROM all_dates AS a LEFT JOIN daily_sales AS d ON a.sale_date = d.sale_date), regression AS (SELECT REGR_SLOPE(y, day_num) AS slope, REGR_INTERCEPT(y, day_num) AS intercept FROM full_data), pred_dates AS (SELECT CAST('2017-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * (SEQ4() + (CAST('2018-12-03' AS DATE) - CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE))) AS DATE) AS pred_date, (CAST('2017-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * (SEQ4() + (CAST('2018-12-03' AS DATE) - CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE))) AS DATE) - CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE)) + 1 AS day_num FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(8))), predictions AS (SELECT pd.pred_date, pd.day_num, r.slope * pd.day_num + r.intercept AS pred_price FROM pred_dates AS pd, regression AS r), moving_avg AS (SELECT p.pred_date, AVG(p2.pred_price) AS ma_price FROM predictions AS p JOIN predictions AS p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2 WHERE p.pred_date BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08' GROUP BY p.pred_date) SELECT SUM(ma_price) AS TOTAL FROM moving_avg

SELECT AVG(CAST((CAST("FINAL_GAME" AS DATE) - CAST("DEBUT" AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 365.0) AS "AVG_CAREER_SPAN" FROM "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."PLAYER" WHERE NOT "DEBUT" IS NULL AND NOT "FINAL_GAME" IS NULL

WITH career_g AS (SELECT b."PLAYER_ID", SUM(COALESCE(b."G", 0)) AS total_g FROM "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."BATTING" AS b GROUP BY b."PLAYER_ID" ORDER BY total_g DESC LIMIT 1), career_r AS (SELECT b."PLAYER_ID", SUM(COALESCE(b."R", 0)) AS total_r FROM "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."BATTING" AS b GROUP BY b."PLAYER_ID" ORDER BY total_r DESC LIMIT 1), career_h AS (SELECT b."PLAYER_ID", SUM(COALESCE(b."H", 0)) AS total_h FROM "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."BATTING" AS b GROUP BY b."PLAYER_ID" ORDER BY total_h DESC LIMIT 1), career_hr AS (SELECT b."PLAYER_ID", SUM(COALESCE(b."HR", 0)) AS total_hr FROM "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."BATTING" AS b GROUP BY b."PLAYER_ID" ORDER BY total_hr DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 'Games Played' AS "Category", p."NAME_GIVEN" AS "Player_Name", g.total_g AS "Batting_Table_Topper" FROM career_g AS g JOIN "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."PLAYER" AS p ON g."PLAYER_ID" = p."PLAYER_ID" UNION ALL SELECT 'Runs', p."NAME_GIVEN", r.total_r FROM career_r AS r JOIN "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."PLAYER" AS p ON r."PLAYER_ID" = p."PLAYER_ID" UNION ALL SELECT 'Hits', p."NAME_GIVEN", h.total_h FROM career_h AS h JOIN "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."PLAYER" AS p ON h."PLAYER_ID" = p."PLAYER_ID" UNION ALL SELECT 'Home Runs', p."NAME_GIVEN", hr.total_hr FROM career_hr AS hr JOIN "BASEBALL"."BASEBALL"."PLAYER" AS p ON hr."PLAYER_ID" = p."PLAYER_ID"

WITH yearly_cause_ranked AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("collision_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS yr, "pcf_violation_category" AS cause, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("collision_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM "CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."COLLISIONS" WHERE NOT "pcf_violation_category" IS NULL AND "pcf_violation_category" <> '' GROUP BY yr, cause), top2_per_year AS (SELECT yr, cause FROM yearly_cause_ranked WHERE rn <= 2), year_cause_set AS (SELECT yr, STRING_AGG(cause, ',' ORDER BY cause) AS cause_set FROM top2_per_year GROUP BY yr), cause_set_counts AS (SELECT cause_set, COUNT(*) AS num_years FROM year_cause_set GROUP BY cause_set ORDER BY num_years DESC), majority_set AS (SELECT cause_set FROM cause_set_counts ORDER BY num_years DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ycs.yr AS OUTPUT FROM year_cause_set AS ycs WHERE ycs.cause_set <> (SELECT cause_set FROM majority_set) ORDER BY ycs.yr

WITH most_common_2021 AS (SELECT "pcf_violation_category" FROM "CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."COLLISIONS" WHERE LEFT("collision_date", 4) = '2021' GROUP BY "pcf_violation_category" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1), yearly_shares AS (SELECT CAST(LEFT("collision_date", 4) AS INT) AS COLLISION_YEAR, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "pcf_violation_category" = (SELECT "pcf_violation_category" FROM most_common_2021) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS PERCENTAGE_SHARE FROM "CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."CALIFORNIA_TRAFFIC_COLLISION"."COLLISIONS" WHERE LEFT("collision_date", 4) IN ('2011', '2021') GROUP BY LEFT("collision_date", 4)) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN COLLISION_YEAR = 2011 THEN PERCENTAGE_SHARE END) - MAX(CASE WHEN COLLISION_YEAR = 2021 THEN PERCENTAGE_SHARE END) FROM yearly_shares

SELECT p."player_name" AS "OUTPUT" FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS w ON b."match_id" = w."match_id" AND b."over_id" = w."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = w."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = w."innings_no" JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p ON b."bowler" = p."player_id" GROUP BY b."bowler", p."player_name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT w."match_id" IS NULL THEN w."match_id" || '-' || w."over_id" || '-' || w."ball_id" || '-' || w."innings_no" END) > 0 ORDER BY CAST(SUM(bs."runs_scored") * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT w."match_id" IS NULL THEN w."match_id" || '-' || w."over_id" || '-' || w."ball_id" || '-' || w."innings_no" END) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH striker_match_runs AS (/* Calculate total runs per striker per match */ SELECT b."striker", b."match_id", SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS match_runs FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" GROUP BY b."striker", b."match_id"), qualified_strikers AS (/* Find strikers who scored more than 50 in any single match */ SELECT DISTINCT "striker" FROM striker_match_runs WHERE match_runs > 50), striker_career_totals AS (/* Get total (career) runs for each qualified striker */ SELECT smr."striker", SUM(smr.match_runs) AS total_runs FROM striker_match_runs AS smr INNER JOIN qualified_strikers AS qs ON smr."striker" = qs."striker" GROUP BY smr."striker") /* Calculate the average of total runs across all qualified strikers */ SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS OUTPUT FROM striker_career_totals

WITH player_runs AS (SELECT bb."striker" AS player_id, SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT bb."match_id") AS matches_played FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS bb JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON bb."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND bb."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND bb."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND bb."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."MATCH" AS m ON bb."match_id" = m."match_id" WHERE m."season_id" = 5 GROUP BY bb."striker"), player_dismissals AS (SELECT wt."player_out" AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_dismissed FROM "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS wt JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."MATCH" AS m ON wt."match_id" = m."match_id" WHERE m."season_id" = 5 GROUP BY wt."player_out") SELECT p."player_name", ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / pr.matches_played, 4) AS "AVG_RUNS_PER_MATCH", ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / pd.times_dismissed, 4) AS "BATTING_AVERAGE" FROM player_runs AS pr JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p ON pr.player_id = p."player_id" JOIN player_dismissals AS pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id ORDER BY "AVG_RUNS_PER_MATCH" DESC LIMIT 5

WITH player_total_runs AS (/* Total runs scored by each player in each match (as striker) */ SELECT b."striker" AS player_id, b."match_id", SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS match_runs FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" GROUP BY b."striker", b."match_id"), player_all_matches AS (/* Total matches played by each player (from PLAYER_MATCH) */ SELECT "player_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "match_id") AS total_matches FROM "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER_MATCH" GROUP BY "player_id"), player_total AS (/* Total runs across all matches per player */ SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs FROM player_total_runs GROUP BY player_id), player_avg AS (/* Each player's average runs per match (total runs / all matches played) */ SELECT pt.player_id, CAST(pt.total_runs * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / pam.total_matches AS avg_runs_per_match FROM player_total AS pt JOIN player_all_matches AS pam ON pt.player_id = pam."player_id"), country_avg AS (/* Average of player averages per country */ SELECT p."country_name", AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average FROM player_avg AS pa JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p ON pa.player_id = p."player_id" GROUP BY p."country_name") SELECT "country_name", country_batting_average FROM country_avg ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC LIMIT 5

WITH over_runs AS (SELECT b."match_id", b."over_id", b."innings_no", SUM(COALESCE(bs."runs_scored", 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er."extra_runs", 0)) AS total_runs FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."EXTRA_RUNS" AS er ON b."match_id" = er."match_id" AND b."over_id" = er."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = er."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = er."innings_no" GROUP BY b."match_id", b."over_id", b."innings_no"), ranked_overs AS (SELECT "match_id", "over_id", "innings_no", total_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY total_runs DESC, "innings_no" ASC, "over_id" ASC) AS rn FROM over_runs), best_over AS (SELECT "match_id", "over_id", "innings_no", total_runs FROM ranked_overs WHERE rn = 1), bowler_per_over AS (SELECT "match_id", "over_id", "innings_no", "bowler", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "over_id", "innings_no" ORDER BY MIN("ball_id") ASC) AS rn FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" GROUP BY "match_id", "over_id", "innings_no", "bowler") SELECT bo."match_id", bo."innings_no", bo."over_id", bp."bowler" AS BOWLER_ID, p."player_name" AS BOWLER_NAME, bo.total_runs AS HIGHEST_OVER_RUNS, ROUND(CAST(AVG(bo.total_runs) OVER () AS DECIMAL), 3) AS AVG_HIGHEST_OVER_RUNS_ACROSS_MATCHES FROM best_over AS bo JOIN bowler_per_over AS bp ON bo."match_id" = bp."match_id" AND bo."over_id" = bp."over_id" AND bo."innings_no" = bp."innings_no" AND bp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p ON bp."bowler" = p."player_id" ORDER BY bo."match_id" ASC

WITH delivered_orders AS (SELECT c."customer_unique_id", o."order_id" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDERS" AS o JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_CUSTOMERS" AS c ON o."customer_id" = c."customer_id" WHERE o."order_status" = 'delivered'), order_payments AS (SELECT d."customer_unique_id", d."order_id", SUM(p."payment_value") AS order_payment_total FROM delivered_orders AS d JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_PAYMENTS" AS p ON d."order_id" = p."order_id" GROUP BY d."customer_unique_id", d."order_id"), customer_stats AS (SELECT "customer_unique_id", COUNT("order_id") AS "DELIVERED_ORDERS", AVG(order_payment_total) AS "AVG_PAYMENT_VALUE" FROM order_payments GROUP BY "customer_unique_id" ORDER BY "DELIVERED_ORDERS" DESC, "customer_unique_id" ASC LIMIT 3), customer_location AS (SELECT DISTINCT c."customer_unique_id", c."customer_city", c."customer_state" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_CUSTOMERS" AS c WHERE c."customer_unique_id" IN (SELECT "customer_unique_id" FROM customer_stats)) SELECT cs."customer_unique_id", cs."DELIVERED_ORDERS", cs."AVG_PAYMENT_VALUE", cl."customer_city" AS "CUSTOMER_CITY", cl."customer_state" AS "CUSTOMER_STATE" FROM customer_stats AS cs JOIN customer_location AS cl ON cs."customer_unique_id" = cl."customer_unique_id" ORDER BY cs."DELIVERED_ORDERS" DESC, cs."customer_unique_id" ASC

WITH yearly_volume AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("order_delivered_customer_date")) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS annual_orders FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDERS" WHERE "order_status" = 'delivered' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("order_delivered_customer_date")) IN (2016, 2017, 2018) GROUP BY yr), lowest_year AS (SELECT yr FROM yearly_volume ORDER BY annual_orders ASC LIMIT 1), monthly_volume AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("order_delivered_customer_date")) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS monthly_orders FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDERS" WHERE "order_status" = 'delivered' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("order_delivered_customer_date")) = (SELECT yr FROM lowest_year) GROUP BY mo) SELECT MAX(monthly_orders) AS OUTPUT FROM monthly_volume

WITH delivered_orders AS (SELECT o."order_id", o."customer_id" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDERS" AS o WHERE o."order_status" = 'delivered'), most_customers AS (SELECT 'seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs' AS "ACHIEVEMENT", oi."seller_id" AS "SELLER_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT c."customer_unique_id") AS "VALUE" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi."order_id" = d."order_id" JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_CUSTOMERS" AS c ON d."customer_id" = c."customer_id" GROUP BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY "VALUE" DESC LIMIT 1), highest_profit AS (SELECT 'seller with the highest profit' AS "ACHIEVEMENT", oi."seller_id" AS "SELLER_ID", SUM(oi."price" - oi."freight_value") AS "VALUE" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi."order_id" = d."order_id" GROUP BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY "VALUE" DESC LIMIT 1), most_orders AS (SELECT 'seller with the highest number of distinct orders' AS "ACHIEVEMENT", oi."seller_id" AS "SELLER_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT oi."order_id") AS "VALUE" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi."order_id" = d."order_id" GROUP BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY "VALUE" DESC LIMIT 1), most_5star AS (SELECT 'seller with the most 5-star ratings' AS "ACHIEVEMENT", oi."seller_id" AS "SELLER_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT r."review_id") AS "VALUE" FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_REVIEWS" AS r JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON r."order_id" = d."order_id" JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON r."order_id" = oi."order_id" WHERE r."review_score" = 5 GROUP BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY "VALUE" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM most_customers UNION ALL SELECT * FROM highest_profit UNION ALL SELECT * FROM most_orders UNION ALL SELECT * FROM most_5star

WITH category_payment_counts AS (SELECT pr."product_category_name", pay."payment_type", COUNT(DISTINCT pay."order_id" || '-' || CAST(pay."payment_sequential" AS VARCHAR)) AS payment_count FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_PAYMENTS" AS pay JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi ON pay."order_id" = oi."order_id" JOIN "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_PRODUCTS" AS pr ON oi."product_id" = pr."product_id" WHERE NOT pr."product_category_name" IS NULL GROUP BY pr."product_category_name", pay."payment_type"), most_preferred AS (SELECT "product_category_name", MAX(payment_count) AS top_payment_count FROM category_payment_counts GROUP BY "product_category_name") SELECT AVG(top_payment_count) AS "AVG_TOP_PAYMENT_COUNT" FROM most_preferred

WITH ordered AS (SELECT "geolocation_city", "geolocation_lat", "geolocation_lng", LAG("geolocation_city") OVER (ORDER BY "geolocation_state", "geolocation_city", "geolocation_zip_code_prefix", "geolocation_lat", "geolocation_lng") AS prev_city, LAG("geolocation_lat") OVER (ORDER BY "geolocation_state", "geolocation_city", "geolocation_zip_code_prefix", "geolocation_lat", "geolocation_lng") AS prev_lat, LAG("geolocation_lng") OVER (ORDER BY "geolocation_state", "geolocation_city", "geolocation_zip_code_prefix", "geolocation_lat", "geolocation_lng") AS prev_lng FROM "BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE"."OLIST_GEOLOCATION"), with_distance AS (SELECT "geolocation_city" AS CITY_ONE, prev_city AS CITY_TWO, 6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS("geolocation_lat")) * COS(RADIANS("geolocation_lng") - RADIANS(prev_lng)) + SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS("geolocation_lat"))))) AS distance_km FROM ordered WHERE NOT prev_lat IS NULL AND NOT prev_city IS NULL AND prev_city <> "geolocation_city") SELECT CITY_ONE, CITY_TWO FROM with_distance ORDER BY distance_km DESC LIMIT 1

WITH combined AS (SELECT t."boroname", i."Estimate_Mean_income", i."Estimate_Median_income" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."TREES" AS t LEFT JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."INCOME_TREES" AS i ON t."zipcode" = i."zipcode" WHERE i."Estimate_Median_income" > 0 AND i."Estimate_Mean_income" > 0 AND NOT t."boroname" IS NULL AND t."boroname" <> ''), borough_stats AS (SELECT "boroname", COUNT(*) AS tree_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG("Estimate_Mean_income") AS DECIMAL), 4) AS mean_income FROM combined GROUP BY "boroname" ORDER BY tree_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT "boroname", mean_income FROM borough_stats ORDER BY mean_income DESC

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "health" = 'Good' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "Percentage" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."TREES" WHERE "boroname" = 'Bronx'

/* Calculate average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021 */ WITH top_industry AS (/* Find the top industry by count of distinct companies in 2019-2021 */ SELECT i."industry" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."COMPANIES_DATES" AS d JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."COMPANIES_INDUSTRIES" AS i ON d."company_id" = i."company_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(d."date_joined")) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021 GROUP BY i."industry" ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT d."company_id") DESC LIMIT 1), yearly_counts AS (/* Count distinct new unicorn companies per year in the top industry */ SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(d."date_joined")) AS join_year, COUNT(DISTINCT d."company_id") AS new_unicorns FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."COMPANIES_DATES" AS d JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."COMPANIES_INDUSTRIES" AS i ON d."company_id" = i."company_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(d."date_joined")) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021 AND i."industry" = (SELECT "industry" FROM top_industry) GROUP BY join_year) SELECT AVG(new_unicorns) AS AVG_NEW_UNICORNS_PER_YEAR FROM yearly_counts

WITH monthly_product_sales AS (/* Step 1: Sum sales amounts for each product, month, and year */ SELECT t."calendar_year" AS yr, t."calendar_month_number" AS month_num, s."prod_id", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS total_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS cu ON s."cust_id" = cu."cust_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COUNTRIES" AS co ON cu."country_id" = co."country_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PROMOTIONS" AS p ON s."promo_id" = p."promo_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CHANNELS" AS ch ON s."channel_id" = ch."channel_id" WHERE co."country_name" = 'France' AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND p."promo_total_id" = 1 AND ch."channel_total_id" = 1 GROUP BY t."calendar_year", t."calendar_month_number", s."prod_id"), pivoted AS (/* Step 2: Pivot to get 2019 and 2020 values for each product-month */ /* Only include products with BOTH years of data and non-zero 2019 sales */ SELECT month_num, "prod_id", MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN total_sales END) AS sales_2019, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN total_sales END) AS sales_2020 FROM monthly_product_sales GROUP BY month_num, "prod_id" HAVING NOT MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN total_sales END) IS NULL AND NOT MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN total_sales END) IS NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN total_sales END) > 0), projected AS (/* Step 3: Apply growth rate to project 2021 */ /* Projected Sales 2021 = Monthly Sales 2020 * (1 + Growth Rate) */ /* Growth Rate = (Monthly Sales 2020 - Monthly Sales 2019) / Monthly Sales 2019 */ SELECT month_num, "prod_id", sales_2020 * (1 + CAST((sales_2020 - sales_2019) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / sales_2019) AS projected_2021 FROM pivoted), projected_usd AS (/* Step 4: Convert to USD using currency table */ SELECT p.month_num, p."prod_id", p.projected_2021 * c."to_us" AS projected_2021_usd FROM projected AS p JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CURRENCY" AS c ON c."country" = 'France' AND c."year" = 2021 AND c."month" = p.month_num), monthly_avg AS (/* Step 5: Compute average projected sales for each month across products */ SELECT month_num, AVG(projected_2021_usd) AS avg_projected_sales FROM projected_usd GROUP BY month_num) /* Step 6: Find the median of the 12 monthly average projected sales */ SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_projected_sales) AS median_avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd FROM monthly_avg

WITH best_selling_artist AS (SELECT ar."ArtistId" FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ARTISTS" AS ar JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ALBUMS" AS al ON ar."ArtistId" = al."ArtistId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."TRACKS" AS t ON al."AlbumId" = t."AlbumId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICE_ITEMS" AS ii ON t."TrackId" = ii."TrackId" GROUP BY ar."ArtistId" ORDER BY SUM(ii."UnitPrice" * ii."Quantity") DESC LIMIT 1), customer_spending AS (SELECT c."FirstName" AS FIRSTNAME, SUM(ii."UnitPrice" * ii."Quantity") AS AMOUNT_SPENT FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."CUSTOMERS" AS c JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICES" AS inv ON c."CustomerId" = inv."CustomerId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICE_ITEMS" AS ii ON inv."InvoiceId" = ii."InvoiceId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."TRACKS" AS t ON ii."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ALBUMS" AS al ON t."AlbumId" = al."AlbumId" WHERE al."ArtistId" = (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM best_selling_artist) GROUP BY c."CustomerId", c."FirstName") SELECT FIRSTNAME, AMOUNT_SPENT FROM customer_spending WHERE AMOUNT_SPENT < 1 ORDER BY FIRSTNAME

WITH artist_sales AS (SELECT ar."ArtistId", ar."Name", SUM(ii."UnitPrice" * ii."Quantity") AS total_sales FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ARTISTS" AS ar JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ALBUMS" AS al ON ar."ArtistId" = al."ArtistId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."TRACKS" AS t ON al."AlbumId" = t."AlbumId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICE_ITEMS" AS ii ON t."TrackId" = ii."TrackId" GROUP BY ar."ArtistId", ar."Name"), top_artist AS (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales DESC, "Name" ASC LIMIT 1), low_artist AS (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales ASC, "Name" ASC LIMIT 1), customer_spending_top AS (SELECT i."CustomerId", SUM(ii."UnitPrice" * ii."Quantity") AS spending FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICE_ITEMS" AS ii JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."TRACKS" AS t ON ii."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ALBUMS" AS al ON t."AlbumId" = al."AlbumId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICES" AS i ON ii."InvoiceId" = i."InvoiceId" WHERE al."ArtistId" = (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM top_artist) GROUP BY i."CustomerId"), customer_spending_low AS (SELECT i."CustomerId", SUM(ii."UnitPrice" * ii."Quantity") AS spending FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICE_ITEMS" AS ii JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."TRACKS" AS t ON ii."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."ALBUMS" AS al ON t."AlbumId" = al."AlbumId" JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICES" AS i ON ii."InvoiceId" = i."InvoiceId" WHERE al."ArtistId" = (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM low_artist) GROUP BY i."CustomerId") SELECT ABS((SELECT AVG(spending) FROM customer_spending_top) - (SELECT AVG(spending) FROM customer_spending_low)) AS "OUTPUT"

WITH product_counts AS (SELECT d."segment", f."fiscal_year", COUNT(DISTINCT f."product_code") AS unique_products FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."HARDWARE_FACT_SALES_MONTHLY" AS f JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."HARDWARE_DIM_PRODUCT" AS d ON f."product_code" = d."product_code" WHERE f."fiscal_year" IN (2020, 2021) GROUP BY d."segment", f."fiscal_year"), pct_change AS (SELECT c2020."segment", c2020.unique_products AS PRODUCT_COUNT_2020, CAST((c2021.unique_products - c2020.unique_products) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c2020.unique_products * 100 AS pct_increase FROM product_counts AS c2020 JOIN product_counts AS c2021 ON c2020."segment" = c2021."segment" WHERE c2020."fiscal_year" = 2020 AND c2021."fiscal_year" = 2021) SELECT "segment", PRODUCT_COUNT_2020 FROM pct_change ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

WITH product_code_totals AS (SELECT p."division", f."product_code", SUM(f."sold_quantity") AS total_qty FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."HARDWARE_DIM_PRODUCT" AS p JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."HARDWARE_FACT_SALES_MONTHLY" AS f ON p."product_code" = f."product_code" WHERE f."date" LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY p."division", f."product_code"), ranked AS (SELECT "division", "product_code", total_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "division" ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn FROM product_code_totals) SELECT "division", AVG(total_qty) AS avg_top3_sold_quantity FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY "division" ORDER BY "division"

WITH qualifying_cities AS (/* Step 1: Get city-level sales for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 (no promotions, US only) */ SELECT c."cust_city", t."calendar_year", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS total_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON s."cust_id" = c."cust_id" WHERE c."country_id" = 52790 AND t."calendar_quarter_number" = 4 AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND s."promo_id" = 999 GROUP BY c."cust_city", t."calendar_year"), cities_with_growth AS (/* Step 2: Filter cities with >= 20% sales growth from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020 */ SELECT q19."cust_city" FROM qualifying_cities AS q19 JOIN qualifying_cities AS q20 ON q19."cust_city" = q20."cust_city" WHERE q19."calendar_year" = 2019 AND q20."calendar_year" = 2020 AND CAST((q20.total_sales - q19.total_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / q19.total_sales >= 0.20), product_overall_sales AS (/* Step 3: Compute overall sales per product in qualifying cities (Q4 2019 + Q4 2020, no promo) */ SELECT s."prod_id", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS total_product_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON s."cust_id" = c."cust_id" JOIN cities_with_growth AS cg ON c."cust_city" = cg."cust_city" WHERE c."country_id" = 52790 AND t."calendar_quarter_number" = 4 AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND s."promo_id" = 999 GROUP BY s."prod_id"), all_products_ranked AS (/* Step 4: Rank ALL products (including those with 0 sales) and take top 20% */ SELECT p."prod_id", p."prod_name", COALESCE(ps.total_product_sales, 0) AS total_product_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ps.total_product_sales, 0) DESC) AS rn FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PRODUCTS" AS p LEFT JOIN product_overall_sales AS ps ON p."prod_id" = ps."prod_id"), top_products AS (/* Step 5: Take top 20% = FLOOR(total_products * 0.2) */ SELECT "prod_id", "prod_name" FROM all_products_ranked WHERE rn <= FLOOR((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PRODUCTS") * 0.2)), product_quarterly_sales AS (/* Step 6: Compute each top product's sales per quarter in qualifying cities */ SELECT tp."prod_id", tp."prod_name", t."calendar_year", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS product_quarter_sales FROM top_products AS tp JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s ON tp."prod_id" = s."prod_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON s."cust_id" = c."cust_id" JOIN cities_with_growth AS cg ON c."cust_city" = cg."cust_city" WHERE c."country_id" = 52790 AND t."calendar_quarter_number" = 4 AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND s."promo_id" = 999 GROUP BY tp."prod_id", tp."prod_name", t."calendar_year"), total_quarterly_sales AS (/* Step 7: Total sales per quarter in qualifying cities (denominator for share) */ SELECT t."calendar_year", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS total_quarter_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON s."cust_id" = c."cust_id" JOIN cities_with_growth AS cg ON c."cust_city" = cg."cust_city" WHERE c."country_id" = 52790 AND t."calendar_quarter_number" = 4 AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND s."promo_id" = 999 GROUP BY t."calendar_year"), shares AS (/* Step 8: Compute share per product per quarter */ SELECT pqs."prod_id", pqs."prod_name", pqs."calendar_year", CAST(pqs.product_quarter_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tqs.total_quarter_sales AS share FROM product_quarterly_sales AS pqs JOIN total_quarterly_sales AS tqs ON pqs."calendar_year" = tqs."calendar_year") /* Step 9: Pivot and compute share change */ SELECT s2019."prod_id", s2019."prod_name", s2019.share AS SHARE_2019, s2020.share AS SHARE_2020, (s2020.share - s2019.share) AS SHARE_CHANGE FROM shares AS s2019 JOIN shares AS s2020 ON s2019."prod_id" = s2020."prod_id" WHERE s2019."calendar_year" = 2019 AND s2020."calendar_year" = 2020 ORDER BY SHARE_CHANGE DESC

WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT s."prod_id", t."calendar_month_number", t."calendar_year", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS total_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON s."cust_id" = c."cust_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COUNTRIES" AS co ON c."country_id" = co."country_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PROMOTIONS" AS p ON s."promo_id" = p."promo_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CHANNELS" AS ch ON s."channel_id" = ch."channel_id" WHERE co."country_name" = 'France' AND t."calendar_year" IN (2019, 2020) AND p."promo_total_id" = 1 AND ch."channel_total_id" = 1 GROUP BY s."prod_id", t."calendar_month_number", t."calendar_year"), sales_2019 AS (SELECT "prod_id", "calendar_month_number", total_sales AS sales_2019 FROM monthly_sales WHERE "calendar_year" = 2019), sales_2020 AS (SELECT "prod_id", "calendar_month_number", total_sales AS sales_2020 FROM monthly_sales WHERE "calendar_year" = 2020), projected AS (SELECT s20."calendar_month_number", ((CAST((s20.sales_2020 - s19.sales_2019) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s19.sales_2019) * s20.sales_2020) + s20.sales_2020 AS projected_2021 FROM sales_2019 AS s19 INNER JOIN sales_2020 AS s20 ON s19."prod_id" = s20."prod_id" AND s19."calendar_month_number" = s20."calendar_month_number"), with_currency AS (SELECT p."calendar_month_number", p.projected_2021 * cur."to_us" AS projected_usd FROM projected AS p JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CURRENCY" AS cur ON cur."country" = 'France' AND cur."year" = 2021 AND cur."month" = p."calendar_month_number") SELECT "calendar_month_number", AVG(projected_usd) AS "AVG_PROJECTED_USD_SALES" FROM with_currency GROUP BY "calendar_month_number" ORDER BY "calendar_month_number"

WITH growing_cities AS (/* Cities in the US with promo_id=999 that had >=20% sales increase Q4 2019 to Q4 2020 */ SELECT q4_19."cust_city" FROM (SELECT cu."cust_city", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS cu ON s."cust_id" = cu."cust_id" WHERE s."promo_id" = 999 AND t."calendar_quarter_id" = 1772 AND cu."country_id" = 52790 GROUP BY cu."cust_city") AS q4_19 JOIN (SELECT cu."cust_city", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS cu ON s."cust_id" = cu."cust_id" WHERE s."promo_id" = 999 AND t."calendar_quarter_id" = 1776 AND cu."country_id" = 52790 GROUP BY cu."cust_city") AS q4_20 ON q4_19."cust_city" = q4_20."cust_city" WHERE CAST((q4_20.sales -
