q4_19.sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / q4_19.sales >= 0.20), product_quarter_sales /* Product sales per quarter within qualifying cities */ AS (SELECT s."prod_id", t."calendar_quarter_id", SUM(s."amount_sold") AS prod_sales FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."TIMES" AS t ON s."time_id" = t."time_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS cu ON s."cust_id" = cu."cust_id" WHERE s."promo_id" = 999 AND t."calendar_quarter_id" IN (1772, 1776) AND cu."country_id" = 52790 AND cu."cust_city" IN (SELECT "cust_city" FROM growing_cities) GROUP BY s."prod_id", t."calendar_quarter_id"), quarter_totals /* Total sales per quarter (denominator for share) */ AS (SELECT "calendar_quarter_id", SUM(prod_sales) AS total_sales FROM product_quarter_sales GROUP BY "calendar_quarter_id"), product_shares /* Product share in each quarter (as proportion 0-1) */ AS (SELECT pq."prod_id", MAX(CASE WHEN pq."calendar_quarter_id" = 1772 THEN CAST(pq.prod_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / qt.total_sales END) AS SHARE_2019Q4, MAX(CASE WHEN pq."calendar_quarter_id" = 1776 THEN CAST(pq.prod_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / qt.total_sales END) AS SHARE_2020Q4 FROM product_quarter_sales AS pq JOIN quarter_totals AS qt ON pq."calendar_quarter_id" = qt."calendar_quarter_id" GROUP BY pq."prod_id"), product_ranked /* Product total sales for ranking (combined both quarters) */ AS (SELECT pq."prod_id", SUM(pq.prod_sales) AS total_sales, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pq.prod_sales) DESC) AS ntile_rank FROM product_quarter_sales AS pq GROUP BY pq."prod_id") SELECT pr."prod_id", p."prod_name", ABS(ps.SHARE_2020Q4 - ps.SHARE_2019Q4) AS PP_CHANGE, ps.SHARE_2019Q4, ps.SHARE_2020Q4 FROM product_ranked AS pr JOIN product_shares AS ps ON pr."prod_id" = ps."prod_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON pr."prod_id" = p."prod_id" WHERE pr.ntile_rank = 1 AND NOT ps.SHARE_2019Q4 IS NULL AND NOT ps.SHARE_2020Q4 IS NULL ORDER BY PP_CHANGE ASC LIMIT 1

WITH non_canceled_orders AS (SELECT c."order_id", c."pizza_id" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS" AS c INNER JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_RUNNER_ORDERS" AS r ON c."order_id" = r."order_id" WHERE r."cancellation" IS NULL OR r."cancellation" = ''), pizza_income AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "pizza_id" = 1 THEN 12 WHEN "pizza_id" = 2 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) AS total_pizza_income FROM non_canceled_orders), extras_income AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_extras_income FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_GET_EXTRAS" AS e INNER JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_RUNNER_ORDERS" AS r ON e."order_id" = r."order_id" WHERE r."cancellation" IS NULL OR r."cancellation" = '') SELECT p.total_pizza_income + x.total_extras_income AS output FROM pizza_income AS p CROSS JOIN extras_income AS x

WITH delivered_orders AS (/* Get only delivered (non-cancelled) orders */ SELECT co."order_id", co."customer_id", co."pizza_id", co."exclusions", co."extras", co."order_time" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS" AS co JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_RUNNER_ORDERS" AS ro ON co."order_id" = ro."order_id" WHERE ro."cancellation" IS NULL OR ro."cancellation" = ''), delivered_with_id /* Assign a unique row_id for each pizza item in an order */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "order_id", "pizza_id") AS rn FROM delivered_orders), base_toppings /* Get base recipe toppings for each delivered pizza (flatten comma-separated toppings) */ AS (SELECT d.rn, CAST(TRIM(t.VALUE) AS INT) AS topping_id FROM delivered_with_id AS d JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_RECIPES" AS r ON d."pizza_id" = r."pizza_id", LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(r."toppings", ',') AS t), exclusion_toppings /* Get exclusions for each delivered pizza */ AS (SELECT d.rn, CAST(TRIM(e.VALUE) AS INT) AS topping_id FROM delivered_with_id AS d, LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(d."exclusions", ',') AS e WHERE NOT d."exclusions" IS NULL AND d."exclusions" <> ''), extra_toppings /* Get extras for each delivered pizza */ AS (SELECT d.rn, CAST(TRIM(x.VALUE) AS INT) AS topping_id FROM delivered_with_id AS d, LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(d."extras", ',') AS x WHERE NOT d."extras" IS NULL AND d."extras" <> ''), after_exclusions /* Base toppings minus exclusions */ AS (SELECT b.rn, b.topping_id FROM base_toppings AS b LEFT JOIN exclusion_toppings AS ex ON b.rn = ex.rn AND b.topping_id = ex.topping_id WHERE ex.topping_id IS NULL), all_toppings /* Combine: after_exclusions + extras */ AS (SELECT rn, topping_id FROM after_exclusions UNION ALL SELECT rn, topping_id FROM extra_toppings) SELECT pt."topping_name" AS "TOPPING_NAME", COUNT(*) AS "TOTAL_QUANTITY" FROM all_toppings AS at2 JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_TOPPINGS" AS pt ON at2.topping_id = pt."topping_id" GROUP BY pt."topping_name" ORDER BY pt."topping_name"

WITH customer_profits AS (SELECT cu."cust_id", SUM(s."amount_sold" - c."unit_cost" * s."quantity_sold") AS total_profit FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" AS s JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COSTS" AS c ON s."prod_id" = c."prod_id" AND s."time_id" = c."time_id" AND s."channel_id" = c."channel_id" AND s."promo_id" = c."promo_id" JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."CUSTOMERS" AS cu ON s."cust_id" = cu."cust_id" WHERE cu."country_id" = 52770 AND s."time_id" >= '2021-12-01' AND s."time_id" < '2022-01-01' GROUP BY cu."cust_id"), tiered AS (SELECT total_profit, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS BUCKET FROM customer_profits) SELECT BUCKET, MAX(total_profit) AS MAX_PROFIT, MIN(total_profit) AS MIN_PROFIT FROM tiered GROUP BY BUCKET ORDER BY BUCKET

WITH monthly_counts AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("insert_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS YEAR, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("insert_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS month_num, COUNT(*) AS CITIES_INSERTED FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("insert_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) IN (4, 5, 6) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("insert_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) IN (2021, 2022, 2023) GROUP BY YEAR, month_num), with_running AS (SELECT YEAR, month_num, CITIES_INSERTED, SUM(CITIES_INSERTED) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY YEAR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS RUNNING_TOTAL FROM monthly_counts), with_lag AS (SELECT YEAR, month_num, CITIES_INSERTED, RUNNING_TOTAL, LAG(CITIES_INSERTED) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY YEAR) AS prev_monthly, LAG(RUNNING_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY YEAR) AS prev_running FROM with_running) SELECT YEAR, CASE month_num WHEN 4 THEN 'April' WHEN 5 THEN 'May' WHEN 6 THEN 'June' END AS MONTH_NAME, CITIES_INSERTED, RUNNING_TOTAL, CAST((CITIES_INSERTED - prev_monthly) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / prev_monthly * 100 AS YEAR_OVER_YEAR, CAST((RUNNING_TOTAL - prev_running) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / prev_running * 100 AS TOTAL_YEAR_OVER_YEAR FROM with_lag WHERE YEAR IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY YEAR, month_num

WITH cn_july AS (/* Chinese cities in July 2021 */ SELECT "insert_date", "city_name", "city_id" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" WHERE "country_code_2" = 'cn' AND "insert_date" >= '2021-07-01' AND "insert_date" <= '2021-07-31'), one_per_date AS (/* Exactly one record per date (smallest city_id) */ SELECT "insert_date", "city_name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "insert_date" ORDER BY "city_id") AS rn FROM cn_july), unique_dates AS (SELECT "insert_date", "city_name" FROM one_per_date WHERE rn = 1), streaks AS (/* Gap-and-island: identify consecutive date groups */ SELECT "insert_date", "city_name", "insert_date" + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * -ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "insert_date") AS grp FROM unique_dates), streak_lengths AS (SELECT grp, MIN("insert_date") AS start_date, MAX("insert_date") AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS streak_length FROM streaks GROUP BY grp), target_streaks AS (/* Shortest and longest streaks */ SELECT grp FROM streak_lengths WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MIN(streak_length) FROM streak_lengths) UNION ALL SELECT grp FROM streak_lengths WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM streak_lengths)) SELECT s."insert_date" AS MOST_CONSECUTIVE_DATES, UPPER(LEFT(s."city_name", 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(s."city_name" FROM 2)) AS CITY_NAME FROM streaks AS s INNER JOIN target_streaks AS t ON s.grp = t.grp ORDER BY s."insert_date"

WITH june_dates AS (/* Get distinct insert dates per country in June 2022 */ SELECT DISTINCT "country_code_2", "insert_date" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" WHERE "insert_date" >= '2022-06-01' AND "insert_date" < '2022-07-01'), with_groups AS (/* Gaps-and-islands: subtract row_number days from date to create group ID */ SELECT "country_code_2", "insert_date", "insert_date" + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * -ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "country_code_2" ORDER BY "insert_date") AS grp FROM june_dates), streaks AS (/* Count consecutive days per group per country */ SELECT "country_code_2", grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM with_groups GROUP BY "country_code_2", grp), max_streak_per_country AS (/* Get the longest streak per country */ SELECT "country_code_2", MAX(streak_len) AS longest_streak FROM streaks GROUP BY "country_code_2") /* Return countries with the overall longest streak */ SELECT "country_code_2" AS "COUNTRY" FROM max_streak_per_country WHERE longest_streak = (SELECT MAX(longest_streak) FROM max_streak_per_country) ORDER BY "country_code_2"

/* Step 1: Find the country with data inserted on exactly 9 different days in January 2022 */ WITH country_9days AS (SELECT "country_code_2" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" WHERE "insert_date" >= '2022-01-01' AND "insert_date" <= '2022-01-31' GROUP BY "country_code_2" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "insert_date") = 9), country_dates /* Step 2: Get distinct insert dates for this country in January 2022 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT c."insert_date" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" AS c INNER JOIN country_9days AS cd ON c."country_code_2" = cd."country_code_2" WHERE c."insert_date" >= '2022-01-01' AND c."insert_date" <= '2022-01-31'), date_groups /* Step 3: Identify consecutive groups using date - row_number trick */ AS (SELECT "insert_date", "insert_date" + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * -ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "insert_date") AS grp FROM country_dates), consecutive_runs /* Step 4: Find the longest consecutive group */ AS (SELECT grp, MIN("insert_date") AS start_date, MAX("insert_date") AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS run_length FROM date_groups GROUP BY grp), longest_run AS (SELECT start_date, end_date FROM consecutive_runs ORDER BY run_length DESC LIMIT 1), entries_in_period /* Step 5: Calculate proportion of capital entries within the longest consecutive period */ AS (SELECT c."capital" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITIES" AS c INNER JOIN country_9days AS cd ON c."country_code_2" = cd."country_code_2" CROSS JOIN longest_run AS lr WHERE c."insert_date" >= lr.start_date AND c."insert_date" <= lr.end_date) SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "capital" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_of_capital FROM entries_in_period

WITH numbered_orders AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "order_id", "order_time") AS row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", "pizza_id", "exclusions", "extras", "order_time" FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS"), orders_with_names AS (SELECT o.row_id, o."order_id", o."customer_id", CASE WHEN pn."pizza_name" = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id, pn."pizza_name", o."exclusions", o."extras", o."order_time" FROM numbered_orders AS o JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_NAMES" AS pn ON o."pizza_id" = pn."pizza_id"), recipe_toppings /* Split recipe toppings into individual rows */ AS (SELECT r."pizza_id", CAST(TRIM(rt.VALUE) AS INT) AS topping_id FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_RECIPES" AS r, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => SPLIT(r."toppings", ',')) AS rt(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS)), order_standard_toppings /* For each order row, get standard toppings */ AS (SELECT o.row_id, o."order_id", o."customer_id", o.pizza_id, o."pizza_name", o."order_time", o."exclusions", o."extras", rt.topping_id, 'standard' AS source FROM orders_with_names AS o JOIN recipe_toppings AS rt ON o.pizza_id = rt."pizza_id"), order_exclusions /* Split exclusions for each order row */ AS (SELECT o.row_id, CAST(TRIM(ex.VALUE) AS INT) AS excluded_topping_id FROM orders_with_names AS o, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => SPLIT(o."exclusions", ','), OUTER => TRUE) AS ex(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE NOT o."exclusions" IS NULL AND o."exclusions" <> ''), order_extras /* Split extras for each order row */ AS (SELECT o.row_id, CAST(TRIM(ext.VALUE) AS INT) AS extra_topping_id FROM orders_with_names AS o, LATERAL UNNEST(INPUT => SPLIT(o."extras", ','), OUTER => TRUE) AS ext(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE NOT o."extras" IS NULL AND o."extras" <> ''), standard_minus_exclusions /* Remove excluded toppings from standard */ AS (SELECT st.row_id, st."order_id", st."customer_id", st.pizza_id, st."pizza_name", st."order_time", st.topping_id, st.source FROM order_standard_toppings AS st LEFT JOIN order_exclusions AS ex ON st.row_id = ex.row_id AND st.topping_id = ex.excluded_topping_id WHERE ex.excluded_topping_id IS NULL), all_toppings /* Add extras as separate rows */ AS (SELECT row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", pizza_id, "pizza_name", "order_time", topping_id, source FROM standard_minus_exclusions UNION ALL SELECT o.row_id, o."order_id", o."customer_id", o.pizza_id, o."pizza_name", o."order_time", ext.extra_topping_id AS topping_id, 'extra' AS source FROM orders_with_names AS o JOIN order_extras AS ext ON o.row_id = ext.row_id), topping_counts /* Count each topping per order row */ AS (SELECT at.row_id, at."order_id", at."customer_id", at.pizza_id, at."pizza_name", at."order_time", at.topping_id, t."topping_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM all_toppings AS at JOIN "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."PIZZA_TOPPINGS" AS t ON at.topping_id = t."topping_id" GROUP BY at.row_id, at."order_id", at."customer_id", at.pizza_id, at."pizza_name", at."order_time", at.topping_id, t."topping_name"), formatted_toppings /* Format topping names with 2x prefix where needed */ AS (SELECT row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", pizza_id, "pizza_name", "order_time", topping_id, "topping_name", cnt, CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN '2x ' || "topping_name" ELSE "topping_name" END AS formatted_name, CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group FROM topping_counts), ingredient_strings /* Aggregate into ingredient string: 2x items first (alphabetical), then single items (alphabetical) */ AS (SELECT row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", "pizza_name", "order_time", "pizza_name" || ': ' || STRING_AGG(formatted_name, ', ' ORDER BY sort_group, "topping_name") AS ingredients FROM formatted_toppings GROUP BY row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", "pizza_name", "order_time") SELECT row_id, "order_id", "customer_id", "pizza_name", ingredients FROM ingredient_strings ORDER BY row_id

WITH all_months AS (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS "GENERATED_MONTH" FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS"), all_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT "customer_id" FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS"), customer_months AS (SELECT c."customer_id", m."GENERATED_MONTH" FROM all_customers AS c CROSS JOIN all_months AS m), monthly_activity AS (SELECT "customer_id", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS "GENERATED_MONTH", SUM(CASE WHEN "txn_type" = 'deposit' THEN "txn_amount" ELSE -"txn_amount" END) AS "BALANCE_ACTIVITY" FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS" GROUP BY "customer_id", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE))), filled AS (SELECT cm."customer_id", cm."GENERATED_MONTH", COALESCE(ma."BALANCE_ACTIVITY", 0) AS "BALANCE_ACTIVITY" FROM customer_months AS cm LEFT JOIN monthly_activity AS ma ON cm."customer_id" = ma."customer_id" AND cm."GENERATED_MONTH" = ma."GENERATED_MONTH") SELECT "customer_id", "GENERATED_MONTH", "BALANCE_ACTIVITY", SUM("BALANCE_ACTIVITY") OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY "GENERATED_MONTH" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "MONTH_END_BALANCE" FROM filled ORDER BY "customer_id", "GENERATED_MONTH"

WITH monthly_comp AS (SELECT m."_month", m."_year", im."interest_name", CAST(m."composition" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m."index_value" AS avg_composition, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m."_year", m."_month" ORDER BY CAST(m."composition" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m."index_value" DESC) AS rn FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."INTEREST_METRICS" AS m JOIN "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."INTEREST_MAP" AS im ON m."interest_id" = im."id" WHERE NOT m."interest_id" IS NULL AND NOT m."month_year" IS NULL AND m."month_year" <> ''), monthly_max AS (SELECT "_month", "_year", "interest_name", avg_composition AS max_index_composition FROM monthly_comp WHERE rn = 1), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM monthly_max WHERE ("_year" = 2018 AND "_month" >= 9) OR ("_year" = 2019 AND "_month" <= 8)), with_window AS (SELECT DATE_FROM_PARTS("_year", "_month", 1) AS "MONTH_DATE", "interest_name", max_index_composition AS "MAX_INDEX_COMPOSITION", AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY "_year", "_month" ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "ROLLING_AVG_3MONTH", LAG("interest_name", 1) OVER (ORDER BY "_year", "_month") AS "PREV_MONTH_INTEREST_NAME", LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY "_year", "_month") AS "PREV_MONTH_MAX_COMPOSITION", LAG("interest_name", 2) OVER (ORDER BY "_year", "_month") AS "PREV_2MONTH_INTEREST_NAME", LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY "_year", "_month") AS "PREV_2MONTH_MAX_COMPOSITION" FROM filtered) SELECT "MONTH_DATE", "interest_name", "MAX_INDEX_COMPOSITION", "ROLLING_AVG_3MONTH", "PREV_MONTH_INTEREST_NAME", "PREV_MONTH_MAX_COMPOSITION", "PREV_2MONTH_INTEREST_NAME", "PREV_2MONTH_MAX_COMPOSITION" FROM with_window ORDER BY "MONTH_DATE"

WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT o."customerid", SUM(od."unitprice" * od."quantity") AS total_spending FROM "NORTHWIND"."NORTHWIND"."ORDERS" AS o JOIN "NORTHWIND"."NORTHWIND"."ORDER_DETAILS" AS od ON o."orderid" = od."orderid" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(o."orderdate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) = 1998 GROUP BY o."customerid"), customer_groups AS (SELECT cgt."groupname" AS spending_group, cs."customerid" FROM customer_spending AS cs JOIN "NORTHWIND"."NORTHWIND"."CUSTOMERGROUPTHRESHOLD" AS cgt ON cs.total_spending BETWEEN cgt."rangebottom" AND cgt."rangetop"), total_customers AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM customer_groups) SELECT cg.spending_group AS "group", COUNT(*) AS "total_customer", ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.total, 6) AS "percentage" FROM customer_groups AS cg CROSS JOIN total_customers AS tc GROUP BY cg.spending_group, tc.total ORDER BY "total_customer" DESC

SELECT "employeeid", SUM(CASE WHEN NOT "shippeddate" IS NULL AND "shippeddate" >= "requireddate" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE_ORDER_COUNT, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT "shippeddate" IS NULL AND "shippeddate" >= "requireddate" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS LATE_ORDER_PERCENTAGE FROM "NORTHWIND"."NORTHWIND"."ORDERS" GROUP BY "employeeid" HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY LATE_ORDER_PERCENTAGE DESC LIMIT 3

WITH movie_years AS (SELECT "MID", CAST(RIGHT("year", 4) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS year FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."MOVIE"), exclusively_female AS (SELECT mc."MID" FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS mc JOIN "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."PERSON" AS p ON TRIM(mc."PID") = TRIM(p."PID") GROUP BY mc."MID" HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p."Gender" <> 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) SELECT my.year AS YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT my."MID") AS TOTAL_MOVIES, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ef."MID") * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT my."MID") AS DECIMAL), 2) AS PERCENTAGE_EXCLUSIVELY_FEMALE FROM movie_years AS my LEFT JOIN exclusively_female AS ef ON my."MID" = ef."MID" GROUP BY my.year ORDER BY my.year

WITH actor_years AS (SELECT c."PID", CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(m."year", '\d{4}', 0) AS INT) AS yr FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS c JOIN "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."MOVIE" AS m ON c."MID" = m."MID" WHERE NOT CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(m."year", '\d{4}', 0) AS INT) IS NULL GROUP BY c."PID", CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(m."year", '\d{4}', 0) AS INT)), gaps AS (SELECT "PID", yr, yr - LAG(yr) OVER (PARTITION BY "PID" ORDER BY yr) AS diff FROM actor_years), max_gaps AS (SELECT "PID", MAX(diff) AS max_diff FROM gaps GROUP BY "PID") SELECT COUNT(*) AS ACTOR_COUNT_NO_4YR_GAP FROM max_gaps WHERE max_diff <= 4 OR max_diff IS NULL

WITH actor_director_counts AS (SELECT c."PID" AS actor_pid, d."PID" AS director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT c."MID") AS film_count FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS c JOIN "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_DIRECTOR" AS d ON c."MID" = d."MID" GROUP BY c."PID", d."PID"), yc_actors AS (SELECT actor_pid, film_count AS yc_count FROM actor_director_counts WHERE director_pid = 'nm0007181'), max_other AS (SELECT actor_pid, MAX(film_count) AS max_other_count FROM actor_director_counts WHERE director_pid <> 'nm0007181' GROUP BY actor_pid) SELECT COUNT(*) AS OUTPUT FROM yc_actors AS ya LEFT JOIN max_other AS mo ON ya.actor_pid = mo.actor_pid WHERE ya.yc_count > COALESCE(mo.max_other_count, 0)

WITH srk_movies AS (/* Movies that Shah Rukh Khan acted in */ SELECT "MID" FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" WHERE "PID" = ' nm0451321'), srk_coactors AS (/* Shahrukh number 1: actors who directly acted with SRK */ SELECT DISTINCT mc."PID" FROM "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS mc JOIN srk_movies AS sm ON mc."MID" = sm."MID" WHERE mc."PID" <> ' nm0451321'), srk_number_2 AS (/* Shahrukh number 2: actors who acted with SRK's co-actors */ /* but NOT directly with SRK himself */ SELECT DISTINCT mc2."PID" FROM srk_coactors AS sc JOIN "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS mc1 ON sc."PID" = mc1."PID" JOIN "DB_IMDB"."DB_IMDB"."M_CAST" AS mc2 ON mc1."MID" = mc2."MID" WHERE mc2."PID" <> ALL (SELECT "PID" FROM srk_coactors) AND mc2."PID" <> ' nm0451321') SELECT COUNT(*) AS SHAHRUKH_NUMBER_2_COUNT FROM srk_number_2

WITH region_stats AS (SELECT r."name" AS REGION_NAME, COUNT(o."id") AS TOTAL_REGION_ORDERS, SUM(o."total_amt_usd") AS TOTAL_REGION_SALES FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_ORDERS" AS o JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_ACCOUNTS" AS a ON o."account_id" = a."id" JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_SALES_REPS" AS sr ON a."sales_rep_id" = sr."id" JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_REGION" AS r ON sr."region_id" = r."id" GROUP BY r."name"), rep_sales AS (SELECT r."name" AS REGION_NAME, sr."name" AS REP_NAME, SUM(o."total_amt_usd") AS REP_TOTAL_SALES FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_ORDERS" AS o JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_ACCOUNTS" AS a ON o."account_id" = a."id" JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_SALES_REPS" AS sr ON a."sales_rep_id" = sr."id" JOIN "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."WEB_REGION" AS r ON sr."region_id" = r."id" GROUP BY r."name", sr."name"), max_rep_sales AS (SELECT REGION_NAME, MAX(REP_TOTAL_SALES) AS MAX_SALES FROM rep_sales GROUP BY REGION_NAME), top_reps AS (SELECT rs.REGION_NAME, rs.REP_NAME AS TOP_SALES_REP_NAME, rs.REP_TOTAL_SALES AS TOP_SALES_REP_SALES FROM rep_sales AS rs JOIN max_rep_sales AS mrs ON rs.REGION_NAME = mrs.REGION_NAME AND rs.REP_TOTAL_SALES = mrs.MAX_SALES) SELECT rs.REGION_NAME, rs.TOTAL_REGION_ORDERS, rs.TOTAL_REGION_SALES, tr.TOP_SALES_REP_NAME, tr.TOP_SALES_REP_SALES FROM region_stats AS rs JOIN top_reps AS tr ON rs.REGION_NAME = tr.REGION_NAME ORDER BY rs.REGION_NAME

SELECT ms."StyleID", ms."StyleName", SUM(CASE WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "FirstPreferenceCount", SUM(CASE WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "SecondPreferenceCount", SUM(CASE WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ThirdPreferenceCount" FROM "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_STYLES" AS ms LEFT JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_PREFERENCES" AS mp ON ms."StyleID" = mp."StyleID" GROUP BY ms."StyleID", ms."StyleName" ORDER BY ms."StyleID"

WITH ent_styles AS (SELECT es1."EntertainerID", es1."StyleID" AS style1, es2."StyleID" AS style2 FROM "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINER_STYLES" AS es1 JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINER_STYLES" AS es2 ON es1."EntertainerID" = es2."EntertainerID" WHERE es1."StyleStrength" = 1 AND es2."StyleStrength" = 2), cust_prefs AS (SELECT mp1."CustomerID", mp1."StyleID" AS pref1, mp2."StyleID" AS pref2 FROM "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_PREFERENCES" AS mp1 JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_PREFERENCES" AS mp2 ON mp1."CustomerID" = mp2."CustomerID" WHERE mp1."PreferenceSeq" = 1 AND mp2."PreferenceSeq" = 2) SELECT e."EntStageName" AS "StageName", c."CustLastName" AS "LastName" FROM ent_styles AS es JOIN cust_prefs AS cp ON (cp.pref1 = es.style1 AND cp.pref2 = es.style2) OR (cp.pref1 = es.style2 AND cp.pref2 = es.style1) JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINERS" AS e ON es."EntertainerID" = e."EntertainerID" JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON cp."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID" ORDER BY e."EntStageName", c."CustLastName"

WITH style_scores AS (SELECT ms."StyleName", SUM(CASE WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 1 THEN 3 WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 2 THEN 2 WHEN mp."PreferenceSeq" = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_WEIGHTED_SCORE FROM "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_PREFERENCES" AS mp JOIN "ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."ENTERTAINMENTAGENCY"."MUSICAL_STYLES" AS ms ON mp."StyleID" = ms."StyleID" GROUP BY ms."StyleName"), avg_score AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_WEIGHTED_SCORE) AS AVERAGE_SCORE FROM style_scores) SELECT ss."StyleName", ss.TOTAL_WEIGHTED_SCORE, ROUND(a.AVERAGE_SCORE, 4) AS AVERAGE_SCORE, ROUND(ABS(ss.TOTAL_WEIGHTED_SCORE - a.AVERAGE_SCORE), 4) AS ABSOLUTE_DIFFERENCE_FROM_AVERAGE FROM style_scores AS ss CROSS JOIN avg_score AS a ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_WEIGHTED_SCORE DESC, ss."StyleName"

SELECT CAST(s."salespersonid" AS INT) AS "SalesPersonID", CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(s."orderdate")) AS INT) AS "SalesYear", SUM(s."totaldue") AS "TotalSales", CAST(q."QuotaYear" AS INT) AS "SalesQuotaYear", q."AnnualQuota" AS "SalesQuota", SUM(s."totaldue") - q."AnnualQuota" AS "Amt_Above_or_Below_Quota" FROM "ADVENTUREWORKS"."ADVENTUREWORKS"."SALESORDERHEADER" AS s JOIN (SELECT "BusinessEntityID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP("QuotaDate")) AS "QuotaYear", SUM("SalesQuota") AS "AnnualQuota" FROM "ADVENTUREWORKS"."ADVENTUREWORKS"."SALESPERSONQUOTAHISTORY" GROUP BY "BusinessEntityID", "QuotaYear") AS q ON CAST(s."salespersonid" AS INT) = q."BusinessEntityID" AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(s."orderdate")) = q."QuotaYear" WHERE NOT s."salespersonid" IS NULL AND s."salespersonid" <> '' GROUP BY CAST(s."salespersonid" AS INT), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(s."orderdate")), q."QuotaYear", q."AnnualQuota" ORDER BY "SalesPersonID", "SalesYear"

WITH buy_data AS (SELECT m."region", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(t."txn_date", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS DATE)) AS year_val, t."quantity" * p."price" AS dollar_amount, t."quantity" FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS" AS t JOIN "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BITCOIN_MEMBERS" AS m ON t."member_id" = m."member_id" JOIN "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BITCOIN_PRICES" AS p ON t."txn_date" = p."market_date" AND t."ticker" = p."ticker" WHERE t."txn_type" = 'BUY' AND t."ticker" = 'BTC'), annual_avg AS (SELECT "region", year_val, CAST(SUM(dollar_amount) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM("quantity") AS btc_dca FROM buy_data GROUP BY "region", year_val), first_year AS (SELECT "region", MIN(year_val) AS min_year FROM annual_avg GROUP BY "region"), filtered AS (SELECT a."region", a.year_val, a.btc_dca FROM annual_avg AS a JOIN first_year AS f ON a."region" = f."region" WHERE a.year_val > f.min_year), with_lag AS (SELECT f."region", f.year_val, f.btc_dca, LAG(f.btc_dca) OVER (PARTITION BY f."region" ORDER BY f.year_val) AS prev_btc_dca FROM annual_avg AS f), final AS (SELECT fl.year_val AS "YEAR_START", fl."region" AS "REGION", ROUND(fl.btc_dca, 2) AS "BTC_DCA", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fl.year_val ORDER BY fl.btc_dca ASC) AS "DCA_RANKING", ROUND(CAST((fl.btc_dca - wl.prev_btc_dca) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / wl.prev_btc_dca * 100, 2) AS "DCA_PERCENTAGE_CHANGE" FROM filtered AS fl JOIN with_lag AS wl ON fl."region" = wl."region" AND fl.year_val = wl.year_val) SELECT "YEAR_START", "REGION", "BTC_DCA", "DCA_RANKING", "DCA_PERCENTAGE_CHANGE" FROM final ORDER BY "REGION", "YEAR_START"

WITH rank_avg AS (SELECT "FacRank", AVG("FacSalary") AS avg_salary FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."UNIVERSITY_FACULTY" GROUP BY "FacRank"), ranked AS (SELECT f."FacRank", f."FacFirstName", f."FacLastName", f."FacSalary" AS SALARY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY f."FacRank" ORDER BY ABS(f."FacSalary" - ra.avg_salary)) AS rk FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."UNIVERSITY_FACULTY" AS f JOIN rank_avg AS ra ON f."FacRank" = ra."FacRank") SELECT "FacRank", "FacFirstName", "FacLastName", SALARY FROM ranked WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY "FacRank", SALARY DESC

WITH female_terms AS (SELECT lt."id_bioguide", lt."term_number", lt."state", CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(lt."term_start", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS start_dt, CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(lt."term_end", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS end_dt FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS lt JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS" AS l ON lt."id_bioguide" = l."id_bioguide" WHERE l."gender" = 'F'), first_state AS (SELECT "id_bioguide", "state" FROM (SELECT "id_bioguide", "state", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "id_bioguide" ORDER BY "term_number") AS _w, "term_number" FROM female_terms) AS _t WHERE _w = 1), dec31_legislators AS (SELECT DISTINCT "id_bioguide" FROM female_terms WHERE DATE_FROM_PARTS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_dt), 12, 31) BETWEEN start_dt AND end_dt OR DATE_FROM_PARTS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_dt), 12, 31) BETWEEN start_dt AND end_dt) SELECT fs."state", COUNT(*) AS "NUMBER_OF_LEGISLATORS" FROM first_state AS fs JOIN dec31_legislators AS d ON fs."id_bioguide" = d."id_bioguide" GROUP BY fs."state" ORDER BY "NUMBER_OF_LEGISLATORS" DESC LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_jobs AS (/* Data Analyst, remote, non-null annual average salary */ SELECT j."job_id", j."salary_year_avg" FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."JOB_POSTINGS_FACT" AS j WHERE j."job_title_short" = 'Data Analyst' AND NOT j."salary_year_avg" IS NULL AND j."job_location" = 'Anywhere'), job_skills AS (/* Join filtered jobs with skills */ SELECT fj."job_id", fj."salary_year_avg", s."skills" FROM filtered_jobs AS fj JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."SKILLS_JOB_DIM" AS sj ON fj."job_id" = sj."job_id" JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."SKILLS_DIM" AS s ON sj."skill_id" = s."skill_id"), top_skills AS (/* Top 3 most frequently demanded skills */ SELECT "skills" FROM job_skills GROUP BY "skills" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), jobs_with_top_skills AS (/* Distinct jobs that have any of the top 3 skills */ SELECT DISTINCT js."job_id", js."salary_year_avg" FROM job_skills AS js JOIN top_skills AS ts ON js."skills" = ts."skills") SELECT AVG("salary_year_avg") AS OVERALL_AVG_SALARY FROM jobs_with_top_skills

WITH cohort AS (SELECT "id_bioguide", MIN(CAST("term_start" AS DATE)) AS first_start FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" GROUP BY "id_bioguide" HAVING first_start >= '1917-01-01' AND first_start <= '1999-12-31'), cohort_size AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort), periods AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) AS period FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(20))), retained AS (SELECT p.period, COUNT(DISTINCT c."id_bioguide") AS cnt FROM cohort AS c CROSS JOIN periods AS p INNER JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS t ON t."id_bioguide" = c."id_bioguide" AND DATE_FROM_PARTS(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_start) AS INT) + p.period, 12, 31) >= CAST(t."term_start" AS DATE) AND DATE_FROM_PARTS(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_start) AS INT) + p.period, 12, 31) <= CAST(t."term_end" AS DATE) GROUP BY p.period) SELECT p.period AS "PERIOD", ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cs.total, 6) AS "retention rate" FROM periods AS p CROSS JOIN cohort_size AS cs LEFT JOIN retained AS r ON p.period = r.period ORDER BY p.period

WITH first_terms AS (SELECT "id_bioguide", MIN(CAST("term_start" AS DATE)) AS first_term_date FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" GROUP BY "id_bioguide"), cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT lt."id_bioguide", lt."state", l."gender", ft.first_term_date FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS lt JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS" AS l ON lt."id_bioguide" = l."id_bioguide" JOIN first_terms AS ft ON lt."id_bioguide" = ft."id_bioguide"), years AS (SELECT 0 AS yr UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10), retention_check AS (SELECT c."state", c."gender", y.yr, COUNT(DISTINCT c."id_bioguide") AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS t WHERE t."id_bioguide" = c."id_bioguide" AND t."state" = c."state" AND CAST(t."term_start" AS DATE) <= DATE_FROM_PARTS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_term_date) + y.yr, 12, 31) AND CAST(t."term_end" AS DATE) >= DATE_FROM_PARTS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_term_date) + y.yr, 12, 31)) THEN c."id_bioguide" END) AS retained FROM cohort AS c CROSS JOIN years AS y GROUP BY c."state", c."gender", y.yr), retention_rates AS (SELECT "state", "gender", yr, CAST(retained * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / cohort_size AS retention_rate FROM retention_check), valid_states AS (SELECT "state" FROM retention_rates GROUP BY "state" HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "gender") = 2) SELECT "state" FROM valid_states ORDER BY "state"

WITH first_terms AS (/* First term ACROSS ALL STATES for each male legislator */ SELECT t."id_bioguide", MIN(CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(t."term_start", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS first_term_date FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS t JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS" AS l ON t."id_bioguide" = l."id_bioguide" WHERE l."gender" = 'M' GROUP BY t."id_bioguide"), year_range /* Generate years covering the full data range */ AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) + 1799 AS yr FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(250))), dec31_dates AS (SELECT yr, CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(yr || '-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS dec31 FROM year_range), actively_serving /* Find all male LA legislators actively serving on each Dec 31 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT t."id_bioguide", d.dec31, CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(d.dec31 AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(ft.first_term_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS years_since_first_term FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS_TERMS" AS t JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."LEGISLATORS" AS l ON t."id_bioguide" = l."id_bioguide" JOIN first_terms AS ft ON t."id_bioguide" = ft."id_bioguide" JOIN dec31_dates AS d ON CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(t."term_start", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) <= d.dec31 AND CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(t."term_end", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) >= d.dec31 WHERE l."gender" = 'M' AND t."state" = 'LA'), years_range /* Generate all years_elapsed from 31 to 49 to include zeros */ AS (SELECT 30 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) AS years_elapsed FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(19))), counts /* Count distinct legislators per years_since_first_term */ AS (SELECT years_since_first_term, COUNT(DISTINCT "id_bioguide") AS cnt FROM actively_serving WHERE years_since_first_term > 30 AND years_since_first_term < 50 GROUP BY years_since_first_term) SELECT yr.years_elapsed AS YEARS_ELAPSED, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS DISTINCT_LEGISLATORS_ACTIVE FROM years_range AS yr LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON yr.years_elapsed = c.years_since_first_term ORDER BY yr.years_elapsed

WITH first_payment AS (/* Find earliest payment date per customer */ SELECT "customer_id", MIN("payment_date") AS first_payment_date FROM "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."PAYMENT" GROUP BY "customer_id"), first_movie_rating AS (/* Get the rating of the first movie rented (identified by earliest payment date) */ SELECT fp."customer_id", f."rating" FROM first_payment AS fp JOIN "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."PAYMENT" AS p ON fp."customer_id" = p."customer_id" AND fp.first_payment_date = p."payment_date" JOIN "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."RENTAL" AS r ON p."rental_id" = r."rental_id" JOIN "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."INVENTORY" AS i ON r."inventory_id" = i."inventory_id" JOIN "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."FILM" AS f ON i."film_id" = f."film_id"), customer_total_spend AS (/* Total amount spent per customer (all payments) */ SELECT "customer_id", SUM("amount") AS total_spend FROM "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."PAYMENT" GROUP BY "customer_id"), customer_rental_count AS (/* Total number of rentals per customer */ SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS total_rentals FROM "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."RENTAL" GROUP BY "customer_id") SELECT fmr."rating", AVG(cts.total_spend) AS AVG_TOTAL_SPEND, AVG(crc.total_rentals - 1) AS AVG_SUBSEQUENT_RENTAL_COUNT FROM first_movie_rating AS fmr JOIN customer_total_spend AS cts ON fmr."customer_id" = cts."customer_id" JOIN customer_rental_count AS crc ON fmr."customer_id" = crc."customer_id" GROUP BY fmr."rating" ORDER BY fmr."rating"

WITH top10_customers AS (SELECT "customer_id" FROM "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."PAYMENT" GROUP BY "customer_id" ORDER BY SUM("amount") DESC LIMIT 10), monthly_payments AS (SELECT p."customer_id", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(p."payment_date")) AS payment_month, SUM(p."amount") AS monthly_total FROM "SQLITE_SAKILA"."SQLITE_SAKILA"."PAYMENT" AS p JOIN top10_customers AS t ON p."customer_id" = t."customer_id" GROUP BY p."customer_id", payment_month), with_diff AS (SELECT "customer_id", payment_month, monthly_total, monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY payment_month) AS diff FROM monthly_payments) SELECT TO_CHAR(payment_month, 'MM') AS month, ROUND(ABS(diff), 2) AS max_diff FROM with_diff WHERE NOT diff IS NULL ORDER BY ABS(diff) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH country_sales AS (SELECT i."BillingCountry", SUM(i."Total") AS total_sales FROM "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."INVOICES" AS i JOIN "CHINOOK"."CHINOOK"."CUSTOMERS" AS c ON i."CustomerId" = c."CustomerId" GROUP BY i."BillingCountry" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c."CustomerId") > 4) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales) AS median_total_sales FROM country_sales

WITH all_words AS (SELECT DISTINCT "words" AS word, ARRAY_TO_STRING(SORT_ARRAY(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL("words", '.', 0)), '') AS sorted_letters FROM "MODERN_DATA"."MODERN_DATA"."WORD_LIST" WHERE LENGTH("words") BETWEEN 4 AND 5), r_words AS (SELECT word, sorted_letters FROM all_words WHERE word LIKE 'r%'), anagram_counts AS (SELECT r.word AS WORD, COUNT(a.word) AS ANAGRAM_COUNT FROM r_words AS r JOIN all_words AS a ON r.sorted_letters = a.sorted_letters AND r.word <> a.word GROUP BY r.word HAVING COUNT(a.word) >= 1) SELECT WORD, ANAGRAM_COUNT FROM anagram_counts ORDER BY WORD LIMIT 10

WITH top_states AS (SELECT "state", COUNT(*) AS total_pop FROM "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."ALIEN_DATA" GROUP BY "state" ORDER BY total_pop DESC LIMIT 10), state_stats AS (SELECT ts."state", ts.total_pop, SUM(CASE WHEN ad."aggressive" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friendly_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ad."aggressive" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hostile_count, AVG(ad."age") AS avg_age FROM top_states AS ts JOIN "CITY_LEGISLATION"."CITY_LEGISLATION"."ALIEN_DATA" AS ad ON ts."state" = ad."state" GROUP BY ts."state", ts.total_pop) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "NUMBER_OF_STATES" FROM state_stats WHERE CAST(friendly_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / total_pop > CAST(hostile_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / total_pop AND avg_age > 200

WITH daily_counts AS (SELECT d."driver_id", o."order_created_year", o."order_created_month", o."order_created_day", COUNT(*) AS daily_deliveries FROM "DELIVERY_CENTER"."DELIVERY_CENTER"."DELIVERIES" AS d JOIN "DELIVERY_CENTER"."DELIVERY_CENTER"."ORDERS" AS o ON d."delivery_order_id" = o."delivery_order_id" WHERE NOT d."driver_id" IS NULL GROUP BY d."driver_id", o."order_created_year", o."order_created_month", o."order_created_day"), avg_daily AS (SELECT "driver_id", AVG(daily_deliveries) AS AVG_DAILY_DELIVERIES FROM daily_counts GROUP BY "driver_id") SELECT a."driver_id", dr."driver_modal", dr."driver_type", a.AVG_DAILY_DELIVERIES FROM avg_daily AS a JOIN "DELIVERY_CENTER"."DELIVERY_CENTER"."DRIVERS" AS dr ON a."driver_id" = dr."driver_id" ORDER BY a.AVG_DAILY_DELIVERIES DESC LIMIT 5

WITH team_match_wins AS (/* Home wins */ SELECT "league_id", "home_team_api_id" AS team_api_id, CASE WHEN "home_team_goal" > "away_team_goal" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" UNION ALL /* Away wins */ SELECT "league_id", "away_team_api_id" AS team_api_id, CASE WHEN "away_team_goal" > "home_team_goal" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH"), team_league_wins AS (SELECT "league_id", team_api_id, SUM(win) AS total_wins FROM team_match_wins GROUP BY "league_id", team_api_id), ranked AS (SELECT l."name" AS LEAGUE_NAME, t."team_long_name" AS TEAM_NAME, tw.total_wins AS TOTAL_WINS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw."league_id" ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, t."team_api_id" ASC) AS rn FROM team_league_wins AS tw JOIN "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."LEAGUE" AS l ON tw."league_id" = l."id" JOIN "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."TEAM" AS t ON tw.team_api_id = t."team_api_id") SELECT LEAGUE_NAME, TEAM_NAME, TOTAL_WINS FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY LEAGUE_NAME

WITH player_matches AS (/* Home players in home wins */ SELECT CAST(f.value AS INT) AS player_api_id, 'win' AS result FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" AS m, LATERAL UNNEST(ARRAY[m."home_player_1", m."home_player_2", m."home_player_3", m."home_player_4", m."home_player_5", m."home_player_6", m."home_player_7", m."home_player_8", m."home_player_9", m."home_player_10", m."home_player_11"]) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE m."home_team_goal" > m."away_team_goal" AND NOT f.value IS NULL UNION ALL /* Away players in away wins */ SELECT CAST(f.value AS INT) AS player_api_id, 'win' AS result FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" AS m, LATERAL UNNEST(ARRAY[m."away_player_1", m."away_player_2", m."away_player_3", m."away_player_4", m."away_player_5", m."away_player_6", m."away_player_7", m."away_player_8", m."away_player_9", m."away_player_10", m."away_player_11"]) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE m."away_team_goal" > m."home_team_goal" AND NOT f.value IS NULL UNION ALL /* Home players in home losses */ SELECT CAST(f.value AS INT) AS player_api_id, 'loss' AS result FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" AS m, LATERAL UNNEST(ARRAY[m."home_player_1", m."home_player_2", m."home_player_3", m."home_player_4", m."home_player_5", m."home_player_6", m."home_player_7", m."home_player_8", m."home_player_9", m."home_player_10", m."home_player_11"]) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE m."home_team_goal" < m."away_team_goal" AND NOT f.value IS NULL UNION ALL /* Away players in away losses */ SELECT CAST(f.value AS INT) AS player_api_id, 'loss' AS result FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" AS m, LATERAL UNNEST(ARRAY[m."away_player_1", m."away_player_2", m."away_player_3", m."away_player_4", m."away_player_5", m."away_player_6", m."away_player_7", m."away_player_8", m."away_player_9", m."away_player_10", m."away_player_11"]) AS f(SEQ, KEY, PATH, INDEX, VALUE, THIS) WHERE m."away_team_goal" < m."home_team_goal" AND NOT f.value IS NULL), win_counts AS (SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM player_matches WHERE result = 'win' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1), loss_counts AS (SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM player_matches WHERE result = 'loss' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 'most_wins' AS CATEGORY, p."player_name" AS PLAYER_NAME, w.match_count AS MATCH_COUNT FROM win_counts AS w JOIN "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."PLAYER" AS p ON w.player_api_id = p."player_api_id" UNION ALL SELECT 'most_losses' AS CATEGORY, p."player_name" AS PLAYER_NAME, l.match_count AS MATCH_COUNT FROM loss_counts AS l JOIN "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."PLAYER" AS p ON l.player_api_id = p."player_api_id"

WITH wins AS (/* Home wins: team won as home team */ SELECT "home_team_api_id" AS team_api_id FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" WHERE "home_team_goal" > "away_team_goal" UNION ALL /* Away wins: team won as away team */ SELECT "away_team_api_id" AS team_api_id FROM "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."MATCH" WHERE "away_team_goal" > "home_team_goal") SELECT t."team_long_name", COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_WINS FROM wins AS w JOIN "EU_SOCCER"."EU_SOCCER"."TEAM" AS t ON w.team_api_id = t."team_api_id" GROUP BY t."team_long_name" ORDER BY TOTAL_WINS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH batsman_runs AS (SELECT m."season_id", bb."striker" AS player_id, SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS total_runs FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS bb ON bs."match_id" = bb."match_id" AND bs."over_id" = bb."over_id" AND bs."ball_id" = bb."ball_id" AND bs."innings_no" = bb."innings_no" JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."MATCH" AS m ON bs."match_id" = m."match_id" GROUP BY m."season_id", bb."striker"), batsman_ranked AS (SELECT "season_id", player_id, total_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "season_id" ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn FROM batsman_runs), top_batsmen AS (SELECT "season_id", player_id, total_runs, rn FROM batsman_ranked WHERE rn <= 3), bowler_wickets AS (SELECT m."season_id", bb."bowler" AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_wickets FROM "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS wt JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS bb ON wt."match_id" = bb."match_id" AND wt."over_id" = bb."over_id" AND wt."ball_id" = bb."ball_id" AND wt."innings_no" = bb."innings_no" JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."MATCH" AS m ON wt."match_id" = m."match_id" WHERE NOT wt."kind_out" IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY m."season_id", bb."bowler"), bowler_ranked AS (SELECT "season_id", player_id, total_wickets, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "season_id" ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn FROM bowler_wickets), top_bowlers AS (SELECT "season_id", player_id, total_wickets, rn FROM bowler_ranked WHERE rn <= 3) SELECT tb."season_id" AS season_id, pb."player_name" AS BATSMAN_NAME, tb.total_runs AS TOTAL_RUNS, pw."player_name" AS BOWLER_NAME, tbo.total_wickets AS TOTAL_WICKETS FROM top_batsmen AS tb JOIN top_bowlers AS tbo ON tb."season_id" = tbo."season_id" AND tb.rn = tbo.rn JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS pb ON tb.player_id = pb."player_id" JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS pw ON tbo.player_id = pw."player_id" ORDER BY tb."season_id" ASC, tb.rn ASC

WITH partnership_runs AS (/* Calculate total partnership runs for each pair of batsmen in each match */ SELECT b."match_id", LEAST(b."striker", b."non_striker") AS player_low, GREATEST(b."striker", b."non_striker") AS player_high, SUM(CASE WHEN b."striker" = LEAST(b."striker", b."non_striker") THEN bs."runs_scored" ELSE 0 END) AS runs_player_low, SUM(CASE WHEN b."striker" = GREATEST(b."striker", b."non_striker") THEN bs."runs_scored" ELSE 0 END) AS runs_player_high, SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS pship_runs FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" GROUP BY b."match_id", player_low, player_high), max_partnership AS (/* Find the maximum partnership runs for each match */ SELECT "match_id", MAX(pship_runs) AS max_pship_runs FROM partnership_runs GROUP BY "match_id"), best_partnerships AS (/* Get all partnerships that tie for the max in each match */ SELECT p."match_id", p.player_low, p.player_high, p.runs_player_low, p.runs_player_high, p.pship_runs FROM partnership_runs AS p JOIN max_partnership AS m ON p."match_id" = m."match_id" AND p.pship_runs = m.max_pship_runs), final AS (/* Assign player 1 (higher individual score) and player 2 (lower individual score) */ /* If tied individual scores, higher ID is player 1 */ SELECT "match_id", CASE WHEN runs_player_high > runs_player_low THEN player_high WHEN runs_player_low > runs_player_high THEN player_low ELSE player_high /* tied scores: higher ID is player 1 (player_high is GREATEST) */ END AS PLAYER1_ID, CASE WHEN runs_player_high > runs_player_low THEN player_low WHEN runs_player_low > runs_player_high THEN player_high ELSE player_low /* tied scores: lower ID is player 2 (player_low is LEAST) */ END AS PLAYER2_ID, CASE WHEN runs_player_high > runs_player_low THEN runs_player_high WHEN runs_player_low > runs_player_high THEN runs_player_low ELSE runs_player_high /* tied: higher ID's runs */ END AS RUNS1, CASE WHEN runs_player_high > runs_player_low THEN runs_player_low WHEN runs_player_low > runs_player_high THEN runs_player_high ELSE runs_player_low /* tied: lower ID's runs */ END AS RUNS2, pship_runs AS PSHIP_RUNS FROM best_partnerships) SELECT "match_id", PLAYER1_ID, PLAYER2_ID, RUNS1, RUNS2, PSHIP_RUNS FROM final ORDER BY PSHIP_RUNS DESC, "match_id", PLAYER1_ID DESC

WITH top_genres AS (SELECT g."genre", COUNT(DISTINCT g."movie_id") AS movie_count FROM "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."GENRE" AS g JOIN "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."RATINGS" AS r ON g."movie_id" = r."movie_id" WHERE r."avg_rating" > 8 GROUP BY g."genre" ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3), director_movies AS (SELECT n."name" AS DIRECTOR, COUNT(DISTINCT dm."movie_id") AS MOVIE_COUNT FROM "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."DIRECTOR_MAPPING" AS dm JOIN "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."NAMES" AS n ON dm."name_id" = n."id" JOIN "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."GENRE" AS g ON dm."movie_id" = g."movie_id" JOIN "IMDB_MOVIES"."IMDB_MOVIES"."RATINGS" AS r ON dm."movie_id" = r."movie_id" WHERE r."avg_rating" > 8 AND g."genre" IN (SELECT "genre" FROM top_genres) GROUP BY n."name" ORDER BY MOVIE_COUNT DESC, DIRECTOR ASC LIMIT 4) SELECT DIRECTOR, MOVIE_COUNT FROM director_movies ORDER BY DIRECTOR ASC

WITH cleaned AS (SELECT "Location", "CompanyName", CASE WHEN "Salary" LIKE '%/yr%' THEN CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE("Salary", '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN "Salary" LIKE '%/mo%' THEN CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE("Salary", '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 12 WHEN "Salary" LIKE '%/hr%' THEN CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE("Salary", '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 2080 END AS salary_num FROM "EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."EDUCATION_BUSINESS"."SALARYDATASET"), national_avg AS (SELECT AVG(salary_num) AS avg_salary_country FROM cleaned), city_company_avg AS (SELECT "Location", "CompanyName", AVG(salary_num) AS avg_salary_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Location" ORDER BY AVG(salary_num) DESC) AS rn FROM cleaned WHERE "Location" IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad') GROUP BY "Location", "CompanyName") SELECT c."Location" AS "Location", c."CompanyName" AS "Company Name", c.avg_salary_state AS "Average Salary in State", n.avg_salary_country AS "Average Salary in Country" FROM city_company_avg AS c CROSS JOIN national_avg AS n WHERE c.rn <= 5 ORDER BY c."Location" ASC, c.avg_salary_state DESC

WITH ball_data AS (/* Base: every ball with bowler, bat runs, extra type */ SELECT b."match_id", b."over_id", b."ball_id", b."innings_no", b."bowler", COALESCE(bs."runs_scored", 0) AS runs_scored, e."extra_type" FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."EXTRA_RUNS" AS e ON b."match_id" = e."match_id" AND b."over_id" = e."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = e."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = e."innings_no"), bowler_overall AS (/* Per-bowler aggregates: legal balls, bat runs */ SELECT bd."bowler", SUM(bd.runs_scored) AS total_runs_conceded, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT bd."extra_type" IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR bd."extra_type" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM ball_data AS bd GROUP BY bd."bowler"), wicket_data AS (/* Wickets attributed to bowler (exclude run out, retired hurt, obstructing the field) */ SELECT b."bowler", b."match_id", w."kind_out" FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS w ON b."match_id" = w."match_id" AND b."over_id" = w."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = w."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = w."innings_no" WHERE w."kind_out" IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')), bowler_wickets AS (/* Total wickets per bowler */ SELECT "bowler", COUNT(*) AS total_wickets FROM wicket_data GROUP BY "bowler"), match_wickets /* Per-match stats for best bowling */ AS (SELECT bd."bowler", bd."match_id", SUM(CASE WHEN w."kind_out" IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(bd.runs_scored) AS match_runs FROM ball_data AS bd LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS w ON bd."match_id" = w."match_id" AND bd."over_id" = w."over_id" AND bd."ball_id" = w."ball_id" AND bd."innings_no" = w."innings_no" GROUP BY bd."bowler", bd."match_id"), best_bowling AS (/* Best bowling: most wickets in a match, tiebreak fewest runs */ SELECT "bowler", match_wkts, match_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "bowler" ORDER BY match_wkts DESC, match_runs ASC) AS rn FROM match_wickets) SELECT p."player_name", COALESCE(bw.total_wickets, 0) AS TOTAL_WICKETS, ROUND(CAST(bo.total_runs_conceded * 6.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / bo.legal_balls, 4) AS ECONOMY_RATE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bw.total_wickets, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(bo.legal_balls * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / bw.total_wickets, 4) ELSE NULL END AS STRIKE_RATE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bw.total_wickets, 0) > 0 THEN bb.match_wkts || '-' || bb.match_runs ELSE NULL END AS BEST_BOWLING FROM bowler_overall AS bo JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p ON bo."bowler" = p."player_id" LEFT JOIN bowler_wickets AS bw ON bo."bowler" = bw."bowler" LEFT JOIN best_bowling AS bb ON bo."bowler" = bb."bowler" AND bb.rn = 1 ORDER BY p."player_name"

WITH most_frequent_role AS (SELECT "player_id", "role" FROM (SELECT "player_id", "role", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "role") AS rn FROM "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER_MATCH" GROUP BY "player_id", "role") WHERE rn = 1), total_matches AS (SELECT "player_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "match_id") AS total_matches FROM "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER_MATCH" GROUP BY "player_id"), batting_balls AS (SELECT b."match_id", b."striker" AS player_id, bs."runs_scored" FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b INNER JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no"), batting_stats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs_scored, COUNT(*) AS total_balls_faced FROM batting_balls GROUP BY player_id), per_match_batting AS (SELECT player_id, "match_id", SUM("runs_scored") AS match_runs FROM batting_balls GROUP BY player_id, "match_id"), batting_milestones AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score, SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thirties, SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fifties, SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hundreds FROM per_match_batting GROUP BY player_id), dismissals AS (SELECT "player_out" AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_times_dismissed FROM "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" GROUP BY "player_out"), bowling_stats AS (SELECT b."bowler" AS player_id, SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS total_runs_conceded, COUNT(*) AS total_balls_bowled FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b INNER JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" GROUP BY b."bowler"), bowling_wickets AS (SELECT b."bowler" AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_wickets_taken FROM "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS w JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b ON w."match_id" = b."match_id" AND w."over_id" = b."over_id" AND w."ball_id" = b."ball_id" AND w."innings_no" = b."innings_no" WHERE NOT w."kind_out" IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY b."bowler"), best_bowling_base AS (SELECT b."bowler" AS player_id, b."match_id", COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT w."kind_out" IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS match_wickets, SUM(bs."runs_scored") AS match_runs_conceded FROM "IPL"."IPL"."BALL_BY_BALL" AS b INNER JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."BATSMAN_SCORED" AS bs ON b."match_id" = bs."match_id" AND b."over_id" = bs."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = bs."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = bs."innings_no" LEFT JOIN "IPL"."IPL"."WICKET_TAKEN" AS w ON b."match_id" = w."match_id" AND b."over_id" = w."over_id" AND b."ball_id" = w."ball_id" AND b."innings_no" = w."innings_no" GROUP BY b."bowler", b."match_id"), best_bowling AS (SELECT player_id, match_wickets, match_runs_conceded, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_wickets DESC, match_runs_conceded ASC) AS rn FROM best_bowling_base) SELECT p."player_id" AS "player_id", p."player_name" AS "player_name", mfr."role" AS "most_frequent_role", p."batting_hand" AS "batting_hand", p."bowling_skill" AS "bowling_skill", COALESCE(bat.total_runs_scored, 0) AS "total_runs_scored", COALESCE(tm.total_matches, 0) AS "total_matches", COALESCE(d.total_times_dismissed, 0) AS "total_times_dismissed", CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_times_dismissed, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(bat.total_runs_scored, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / d.total_times_dismissed ELSE NULL END AS "batting_average", COALESCE(bm.highest_score, 0) AS "highest_score", COALESCE(bm.thirties, 0) AS "30s", COALESCE(bm.fifties, 0) AS "50s", COALESCE(bm.hundreds, 0) AS "100s", COALESCE(bat.total_balls_faced, 0) AS "total_balls_faced", CASE WHEN COALESCE(bat.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(bat.total_runs_scored, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / bat.total_balls_faced * 100 ELSE NULL END AS "strike_rate", COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS "total_wickets_taken", CASE WHEN NOT bwl.total_balls_bowled IS NULL AND bwl.total_balls_bowled > 0 THEN CAST(bwl.total_runs_conceded AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / bwl.total_balls_bowled * 6 ELSE NULL END AS "economy_rate", CASE WHEN NOT bb.player_id IS NULL THEN bb.match_wickets || '-' || bb.match_runs_conceded ELSE NULL END AS "best_bowling_performance" FROM "IPL"."IPL"."PLAYER" AS p LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role AS mfr ON p."player_id" = mfr."player_id" LEFT JOIN total_matches AS tm ON p."player_id" = tm."player_id" LEFT JOIN batting_stats AS bat ON p."player_id" = bat.player_id LEFT JOIN batting_milestones AS bm ON p."player_id" = bm.player_id LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON p."player_id" = d.player_id LEFT JOIN bowling_stats AS bwl ON p."player_id" = bwl.player_id LEFT JOIN bowling_wickets AS bw ON p."player_id" = bw.player_id LEFT JOIN best_bowling AS bb ON p."player_id" = bb.player_id AND bb.rn = 1 ORDER BY p."player_id"

WITH stack_scores AS (SELECT "name", "step", "version", "test_score" AS stack_score FROM "STACKING"."STACKING"."MODEL_SCORE" WHERE "model" = 'Stack' AND "step" IN (1, 2, 3)), non_stack_max AS (SELECT "name", "step", "version", MAX("test_score") AS max_non_stack_score FROM "STACKING"."STACKING"."MODEL_SCORE" WHERE "model" <> 'Stack' AND "step" IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY "name", "step", "version"), stack_wins AS (SELECT s."name", COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM stack_scores AS s JOIN non_stack_max AS ns ON s."name" = ns."name" AND s."step" = ns."step" AND s."version" = ns."version" WHERE s.stack_score > ns.max_non_stack_score GROUP BY s."name"), solution_counts AS (SELECT "name", COUNT(*) AS sol_count FROM "STACKING"."STACKING"."SOLUTION" GROUP BY "name") SELECT sw."name" AS "problem" FROM stack_wins AS sw JOIN solution_counts AS sc ON sw."name" = sc."name" WHERE sw.win_count > sc.sol_count ORDER BY sw."name"

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (/* Anchor: start from top-level containers (not contained by anything) */ SELECT p."id" AS root_id, p."name" AS root_name, pr."contains_id" AS current_id, pr."qty" AS total_qty FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING" AS p JOIN "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING_RELATIONS" AS pr ON p."id" = pr."packaging_id" WHERE p."id" <> ALL (SELECT DISTINCT "contains_id" FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING_RELATIONS") UNION ALL /* Recursive: traverse down, multiply quantities at each level */ SELECT h.root_id, h.root_name, pr."contains_id" AS current_id, h.total_qty * pr."qty" AS total_qty FROM hierarchy AS h JOIN "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING_RELATIONS" AS pr ON h.current_id = pr."packaging_id"), item_totals /* Aggregate: sum quantities across all paths from root to same leaf item */ AS (SELECT h.root_name AS CONTAINER_NAME, p."name" AS ITEM_NAME, SUM(h.total_qty) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY FROM hierarchy AS h JOIN "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING" AS p ON h.current_id = p."id" /* Items are leaf nodes: not a parent in any relation */ WHERE h.current_id <> ALL (SELECT DISTINCT "packaging_id" FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PACKAGING_RELATIONS") GROUP BY h.root_name, p."name") SELECT CONTAINER_NAME, ITEM_NAME, TOTAL_QUANTITY FROM item_totals WHERE TOTAL_QUANTITY > 500 ORDER BY TOTAL_QUANTITY DESC

WITH order_products AS (/* Get the required quantity per order per product from picking_line */ SELECT "order_id", "product_id", SUM("qty") AS required_qty FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PICKING_LINE" GROUP BY "order_id", "product_id"), inventory_ranked AS (/* Rank inventory by earliest purchase date and smallest quantity (FIFO) */ SELECT "PRODUCTID", "WAREHOUSEID", "AISLE", "POSITION", "PURCHASEDATE", "QUANTITY", SUM("QUANTITY") OVER (PARTITION BY "PRODUCTID" ORDER BY "PURCHASEDATE", "QUANTITY" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_qty, SUM("QUANTITY") OVER (PARTITION BY "PRODUCTID" ORDER BY "PURCHASEDATE", "QUANTITY" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - "QUANTITY" AS prev_cumulative_qty FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."INVENTORY"), fifo_allocation AS (/* For each order-product, calculate the overlapping range with each inventory slot */ SELECT op."order_id", op."product_id", op.required_qty, ir."QUANTITY" AS inv_quantity, ir."PURCHASEDATE", GREATEST(0, LEAST(op.required_qty, ir.cumulative_qty) - GREATEST(0, ir.prev_cumulative_qty)) AS picked_qty /* The picked quantity is the overlapping range */ FROM order_products AS op LEFT JOIN inventory_ranked AS ir ON op."product_id" = ir."PRODUCTID"), pick_percentage AS (SELECT fa."product_id" AS PRODUCT_NAME, CASE WHEN fa.required_qty > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(SUM(fa.picked_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / fa.required_qty * 100 ELSE 0 END AS pick_pct FROM fifo_allocation AS fa GROUP BY fa."product_id", fa.required_qty, fa."order_id") SELECT PRODUCT_NAME, AVG(pick_pct) AS AVG_PICK_PERCENTAGE FROM pick_percentage GROUP BY PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME

SELECT p."NAME" AS PRODUCT_NAME, AVG(pl."qty") AS AVG_UNITS_PICKED FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PICKING_LINE" AS pl JOIN "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON pl."product_id" = p."ID" WHERE pl."order_id" = 421 GROUP BY p."NAME" ORDER BY AVG_UNITS_PICKED DESC

WITH base AS (SELECT "product_id", "mth", "qty", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "product_id" ORDER BY "mth") AS t FROM "ORACLE_SQL"."ORACLE_SQL"."MONTHLY_SALES" WHERE "product_id" IN (4160, 7790)), cma AS (SELECT a."product_id", a.t, a."qty", CAST((CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.t BETWEEN a.t - 5 AND a.t + 6 THEN b."qty" END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 12.0 + CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.t BETWEEN a.t - 6 AND a.t + 5 THEN b."qty" END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 12.0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 2.0 AS cma_value, ((a.t - 1) % 12) + 1 AS month_num FROM base AS a JOIN base AS b ON a."product_id" = b."product_id" WHERE a.t BETWEEN 7 AND 30 GROUP BY a."product_id", a.t, a."qty"), ratios AS (SELECT "product_id", t, "qty", cma_value, CAST("qty" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(cma_value, 0) AS ratio, month_num FROM cma), seasonal_indices AS (SELECT "product_id", month_num, AVG(ratio) AS seasonal_index FROM ratios GROUP BY "product_id", month_num), deseas AS (SELECT r."product_id", r.t, r.cma_value, r.month_num, si.seasonal_index, CAST(r."qty" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(si.seasonal_index, 0) AS deseasonalized FROM ratios AS r JOIN seasonal_indices AS si ON r."product_id" = si."product_id" AND r.month_num = si.month_num), wls_regression AS (SELECT "product_id", SUM(cma_value) AS sum_w, SUM(cma_value * CAST(t AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS sum_wx, SUM(cma_value * CAST(t AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(t AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS sum_wx2, SUM(cma_value * deseasonalized) AS sum_wy, SUM(cma_value * CAST(t AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * deseasonalized) AS sum_wxy FROM deseas GROUP BY "product_id"), regression_coeffs AS (SELECT "product_id", CAST((sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx, 0) AS slope, CAST((sum_wy - (CAST((sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx, 0)) * sum_wx) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sum_w, 0) AS intercept FROM wls_regression), forecast_2018 AS (SELECT rc."product_id", si.month_num, (rc.intercept + rc.slope * (24.0 + si.month_num)) * si.seasonal_index AS forecasted_sales FROM regression_coeffs AS rc JOIN seasonal_indices AS si ON rc."product_id" = si."product_id") SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(annual_sales) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS AVG_FORECASTED_ANNUAL_SALES_2018 FROM (SELECT "product_id", SUM(forecasted_sales) AS annual_sales FROM forecast_2018 GROUP BY "product_id")

WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_lr, STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_lr FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."VEG_LOSS_RATE_DF") SELECT s.avg_lr AS "avg_loss_rate_%", COUNT(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_lr - s.std_lr AND v."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_lr + s.std_lr THEN 1 END) AS "items_within_stdev", COUNT(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_lr + s.std_lr THEN 1 END) AS "above_stdev", COUNT(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_lr - s.std_lr THEN 1 END) AS "items_below_stdev" FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."VEG_LOSS_RATE_DF" AS v CROSS JOIN stats AS s GROUP BY s.avg_lr

WITH seller_items AS (SELECT oi."seller_id", COUNT(*) AS "TOTAL_QUANTITY_SOLD", SUM(oi."price") AS "TOTAL_SALES", AVG(oi."price") AS "AVERAGE_ITEM_PRICE" FROM "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi GROUP BY oi."seller_id" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100), seller_reviews AS (SELECT oi."seller_id", AVG(CAST(r."review_score" AS DECIMAL(18, 12))) AS "AVERAGE_REVIEW_SCORE" FROM "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDER_REVIEWS" AS r ON oi."order_id" = r."order_id" GROUP BY oi."seller_id"), seller_packing AS (SELECT oi."seller_id", AVG(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(o."order_delivered_carrier_date") AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(o."order_approved_at") AS TIMESTAMP)) / 3600 AS BIGINT)) AS "AVERAGE_PACKING_TIME_HOURS" FROM "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi JOIN "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDERS" AS o ON oi."order_id" = o."order_id" WHERE o."order_approved_at" <> '' AND o."order_delivered_carrier_date" <> '' GROUP BY oi."seller_id"), seller_category AS (SELECT oi."seller_id", COALESCE(t."product_category_name_english", '') AS category_english, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ORDER_ITEMS" AS oi LEFT JOIN "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."PRODUCTS" AS p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id" LEFT JOIN "ELECTRONIC_SALES"."ELECTRONIC_SALES"."PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME_TRANSLATION" AS t ON p."product_category_name" = t."product_category_name" GROUP BY oi."seller_id", COALESCE(t."product_category_name_english", '')) SELECT si."seller_id" AS "SELLER_ID", si."TOTAL_QUANTITY_SOLD", si."TOTAL_SALES", si."AVERAGE_ITEM_PRICE", sr."AVERAGE_REVIEW_SCORE", sp."AVERAGE_PACKING_TIME_HOURS", sc.category_english AS "TOP_CATEGORIES_ENGLISH" FROM seller_items AS si LEFT JOIN seller_reviews AS sr ON si."seller_id" = sr."seller_id" LEFT JOIN seller_packing AS sp ON si."seller_id" = sp."seller_id" LEFT JOIN seller_category AS sc ON si."seller_id" = sc."seller_id" AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY si."TOTAL_SALES" DESC

WITH monthly_net AS (SELECT "customer_id", DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(CASE WHEN "txn_type" = 'deposit' THEN "txn_amount" WHEN "txn_type" = 'withdrawal' THEN -"txn_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS net_amount FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS" GROUP BY "customer_id", month_start), closing_balance AS (SELECT "customer_id", month_start, SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_bal FROM monthly_net), with_prev AS (SELECT "customer_id", month_start, closing_bal, LAG(closing_bal) OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_closing_bal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn_desc FROM closing_balance), most_recent AS (SELECT "customer_id", closing_bal, prev_closing_bal, CASE WHEN prev_closing_bal = 0 THEN closing_bal * 100 ELSE CAST((closing_bal - prev_closing_bal) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / prev_closing_bal * 100 END AS growth_rate FROM with_prev WHERE rn_desc = 1 AND NOT prev_closing_bal IS NULL) SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS PCT_CUSTOMERS_GROWTH_GT_5 FROM most_recent

WITH period_sales AS (SELECT "calendar_year", SUM(CASE WHEN "week_number" BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS BEFORE_EFFECT, SUM(CASE WHEN "week_number" BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS AFTER_EFFECT FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CLEANED_WEEKLY_SALES" WHERE "calendar_year" IN (2018, 2019, 2020) AND "week_number" BETWEEN 21 AND 28 GROUP BY "calendar_year") SELECT BEFORE_EFFECT, AFTER_EFFECT, AFTER_EFFECT - BEFORE_EFFECT AS CHANGE_AMOUNT, ROUND(CAST((AFTER_EFFECT - BEFORE_EFFECT) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / BEFORE_EFFECT, 2) AS PERCENT_CHANGE, "calendar_year" AS YEAR FROM period_sales ORDER BY "calendar_year"

WITH before_after AS (SELECT "region", "platform", "age_band", "demographic", "customer_type", SUM(CASE WHEN "week_date" < '2020-06-15' THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS before_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN "week_date" >= '2020-06-15' THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS after_sales FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CLEANED_WEEKLY_SALES" WHERE "week_date" >= '2020-03-23' AND "week_date" <= '2020-08-31' GROUP BY "region", "platform", "age_band", "demographic", "customer_type"), region_pct /* Compute pct change per attribute value for each attribute type */ AS (SELECT 'region' AS metric, "region" AS attr_value, CAST((SUM(after_sales) - SUM(before_sales)) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(before_sales) AS pct_change FROM before_after GROUP BY "region"), platform_pct AS (SELECT 'platform' AS metric, "platform" AS attr_value, CAST((SUM(after_sales) - SUM(before_sales)) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(before_sales) AS pct_change FROM before_after GROUP BY "platform"), age_band_pct AS (SELECT 'age_band' AS metric, "age_band" AS attr_value, CAST((SUM(after_sales) - SUM(before_sales)) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(before_sales) AS pct_change FROM before_after GROUP BY "age_band"), demographic_pct AS (SELECT 'demographic' AS metric, "demographic" AS attr_value, CAST((SUM(after_sales) - SUM(before_sales)) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(before_sales) AS pct_change FROM before_after GROUP BY "demographic"), customer_type_pct AS (SELECT 'customer_type' AS metric, "customer_type" AS attr_value, CAST((SUM(after_sales) - SUM(before_sales)) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(before_sales) AS pct_change FROM before_after GROUP BY "customer_type"), all_pct AS (SELECT * FROM region_pct UNION ALL SELECT * FROM platform_pct UNION ALL SELECT * FROM age_band_pct UNION ALL SELECT * FROM demographic_pct UNION ALL SELECT * FROM customer_type_pct), avg_by_type AS (SELECT metric AS "METRIC", AVG(pct_change) AS "AVG_PERCENT_CHANGE" FROM all_pct GROUP BY metric) SELECT "METRIC", ROUND("AVG_PERCENT_CHANGE", 6) AS "AVG_PERCENT_CHANGE" FROM avg_by_type ORDER BY "AVG_PERCENT_CHANGE" ASC LIMIT 1

WITH driver_points AS (SELECT r."year", res."driver_id", SUM(res."points") AS total_points FROM "F1"."F1"."RESULTS" AS res JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS r ON res."race_id" = r."race_id" GROUP BY r."year", res."driver_id"), max_driver AS (SELECT "year", MAX(total_points) AS max_driver_points FROM driver_points GROUP BY "year"), constructor_points AS (SELECT r."year", res."constructor_id", SUM(res."points") AS total_points FROM "F1"."F1"."RESULTS" AS res JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS r ON res."race_id" = r."race_id" GROUP BY r."year", res."constructor_id"), max_constructor AS (SELECT "year", MAX(total_points) AS max_constructor_points FROM constructor_points GROUP BY "year") SELECT md."year" FROM max_driver AS md JOIN max_constructor AS mc ON md."year" = mc."year" ORDER BY (md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points) ASC LIMIT 3

WITH session_stamp_path_counts AS (SELECT "session", "stamp", "path", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "LOG"."LOG"."ACTIVITY_LOG" GROUP BY "session", "stamp", "path"), ranked AS (SELECT "session", "stamp", "path", cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "session", "stamp" ORDER BY cnt DESC, "path" ASC) AS rn, MIN("stamp") OVER (PARTITION BY "session") AS first_stamp, MAX("stamp") OVER (PARTITION BY "session") AS last_stamp FROM session_stamp_path_counts), landing AS (SELECT "session", "path" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND "stamp" = first_stamp), exit_p AS (SELECT "session", "path" FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND "stamp" = last_stamp), combined AS (SELECT "session", "path" FROM landing UNION SELECT "session", "path" FROM exit_p) SELECT "path", COUNT(DISTINCT "session") AS session_count FROM combined GROUP BY "path" ORDER BY session_count DESC

WITH ordered_visits AS (SELECT "session", "stamp", CASE WHEN "path" IN ('/detail', '/detail/') THEN '/detail' WHEN "path" IN ('/search_list', '/search_list/') THEN '/search_list' WHEN "path" IN ('/search_input', '/search_input/') THEN '/search_input' WHEN "path" = '/' THEN '/' ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM "path") END AS normalized_path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "session" ORDER BY "stamp") AS rn FROM "LOG"."LOG"."ACTIVITY_LOG"), with_leads AS (SELECT normalized_path, LEAD(normalized_path, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "session" ORDER BY rn) AS next_path, LEAD(normalized_path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY "session" ORDER BY rn) AS third_path FROM ordered_visits) SELECT third_path AS THIRD_PAGE, COUNT(*) AS OCCURRENCES FROM with_leads WHERE normalized_path = '/detail' AND next_path = '/detail' AND NOT third_path IS NULL GROUP BY third_path ORDER BY OCCURRENCES DESC LIMIT 3

WITH position_changes AS (SELECT curr."race_id", curr."driver_id", curr."lap", curr."position" AS curr_position, prev."position" AS prev_position FROM "F1"."F1"."LAP_POSITIONS" AS curr JOIN "F1"."F1"."LAP_POSITIONS" AS prev ON curr."race_id" = prev."race_id" AND curr."driver_id" = prev."driver_id" AND curr."lap" = prev."lap" + 1 WHERE curr."lap" >= 2 AND curr."lap_type" = 'Race' AND prev."lap_type" = 'Race'), overtake_pairs AS (SELECT a."race_id", a."lap", a."driver_id" AS overtaker_id, b."driver_id" AS overtaken_id FROM position_changes AS a JOIN position_changes AS b ON a."race_id" = b."race_id" AND a."lap" = b."lap" AND a."driver_id" <> b."driver_id" WHERE a.prev_position > b.prev_position AND a.curr_position < b.curr_position), on_track_overtakes AS (SELECT op."race_id", op."lap", op.overtaker_id, op.overtaken_id FROM overtake_pairs AS op WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "F1"."F1"."PIT_STOPS" AS ps WHERE ps."race_id" = op."race_id" AND ps."driver_id" = op.overtaken_id AND (ps."lap" = op."lap" OR ps."lap" = op."lap" - 1)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "F1"."F1"."PIT_STOPS" AS ps WHERE ps."race_id" = op."race_id" AND ps."driver_id" = op.overtaker_id AND ps."lap" = op."lap") AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "F1"."F1"."RETIREMENTS" AS r WHERE r."race_id" = op."race_id" AND r."driver_id" = op.overtaken_id AND r."lap" = op."lap")), driver_stats AS (SELECT d."driver_id", d."forename" || ' ' || d."surname" AS "full_name", COALESCE(p.cnt, 0) AS overtakes_performed, COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) AS times_overtaken FROM "F1"."F1"."DRIVERS" AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT overtaker_id AS did, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM on_track_overtakes GROUP BY overtaker_id) AS p ON d."driver_id" = p.did LEFT JOIN (SELECT overtaken_id AS did, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM on_track_overtakes GROUP BY overtaken_id) AS r ON d."driver_id" = r.did WHERE COALESCE(p.cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) > 0) SELECT "full_name" FROM driver_stats WHERE times_overtaken > overtakes_performed ORDER BY "full_name"

SELECT CASE WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s' WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s' WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s' WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s' ELSE 'others' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM (SELECT FLOOR(CAST((CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE) - CAST(CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP("birth_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE) AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 365.25) AS age FROM "LOG"."LOG"."MST_USERS") AS sub GROUP BY category ORDER BY CASE category WHEN '20s' THEN 1 WHEN '30s' THEN 2 WHEN '40s' THEN 3 WHEN '50s' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
